raw.title: Director, Integrated Marketing
raw.description:
Precision AQ is seeking a strategic marketer to drive the integrated marketing strategy, connecting thought leadership, digital activation, demand generation, campaigns, events, account priorities, and sales enablement into a cohesive approach that supports measurable business impact. 

The ideal candidate is a builder, modernizer, and team player who brings a strong commercial mindset, leveraging data, emerging technologies, and AI to enhance marketing effectiveness, improve operational efficiency, and create scalable processes that position Marketing as a strategic growth driver across the organization. 

Main Duties & Responsibilities 

- Lead integrated campaigns aligned with growth priorities, target audiences, and priority accounts; develop briefs, messaging, journeys, channel plans, and activation calendars

- Work with the marketing and practice teams to align the thought leadership strategy and editorial plan. Partner with subject matter experts to develop differentiated perspectives in the span the customer segments and solutions we bring to our customer segments

- Turn expert insight into articles, reports, white papers, webinars, newsletters, executive content, and reusable campaign assets

- Direct digital strategies across the website, email, social media, search, paid media, and marketing automation to increase reach, engagement, and qualified demand

- Connect conference and event marketing to campaigns before, during, and after key industry moments.

- Partner with commercial leaders and the sales team on account-based programs, targeting and segmentation of ICPs, and client engagement strategies.

- Maintain clear, consistent brand storytelling and editorial quality across channels.

- Partner with practice area leaders and subject matter experts to identify, prioritize, and execute paid and earned media strategies that increase brand visibility, promote thought leadership, and drive audience engagement.

- Design and lead segmentation and targeting of priority clients and buying centers, partnering with commercial teams to deliver personalized campaigns and account-specific content that increase penetration, opportunity creation, and client growth.

- Utilize AI tools to orchestrate new workflows in processes, data outputs and scheduling 

- Track and manage KPIs and use HubSpot, Salesforce, and campaign data to report engagement, MQLs, opportunity influence, and funnel progression; optimize based on results.

- Travel Requirement: Up to 10%

Education and Experience

- 8 or more years in integrated marketing, digital marketing, content strategy, or related roles, ideally in healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceutical services, consulting, or complex B2B markets.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

- Proven ability to design and lead multichannel campaigns and thought leadership programs from strategy through execution and measurement.

- Strong marketing, communications, and ability to translate complex subject matter into compelling client-facing narratives.

- Hands-on understanding of email, social, SEO, paid media, websites, marketing automation, and audience journeys.

- Experience partnering with senior executives, subject matter experts, sales, and cross-functional teams.

- Comfort with campaign analytics, lead generation, and commercial funnel reporting; HubSpot and Salesforce experience preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies 

- Hubspot

- Salesforce

- Digital marketing tools such as Demand Base

- Account Based Marketing Program Experience

- AI Marketing Tools

#LI-Remote

 

Precision is required by law in some states or cities to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This compensation range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to: skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Precision, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.  This role is also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, health insurance, retirement savings benefits, life insurance and disability benefits, parental leave, and paid time off for sick leave and vacation, among other benefits.

Reasonable estimate of the current range

$130,000—$160,000 USD

Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice.

Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Precision Medicine Group at myHR@precisionmedicinegrp.com.

Recruitment Fraud Warning: Please be aware that fraudulent individuals and websites may impersonate Precision Medicine Group or its affiliates and attempt to obtain personal, financial, or banking information through fake job postings or employment offers. Precision Medicine Group will never request payment, banking details, or other sensitive financial information as part of the recruitment process. If you believe you have been targeted by a recruitment scam, we encourage you to report the incident to your local law enforcement authorities, consumer protection agency, or relevant cybercrime reporting organization in your country. Please also notify us at myHR@precisionmedicinegrp.com so we can investigate and take appropriate action.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country of employment without employer sponsorship.

# Summary

Join our digital marketing agency as an Ads & SEO Manager to oversee paid advertising campaigns and organic search performance for multiple clients. This role requires full ownership of campaigns and SEO strategy, managing them independently while collaborating with our marketing team to achieve measurable ROI and search visibility gains. The position is remote with flexible hours and potential for full-time growth.

## Deliverables

### Campaign Management

- Plan, launch, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and other relevant platforms
- Take full ownership of campaign performance and results from strategy through execution
- Manage multiple client ad accounts simultaneously with varying budgets and objectives
- Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitive analysis
- Design and execute comprehensive A/B testing strategies for ad copy, creatives, landing pages, and audiences to continuously improve performance
- Implement unit testing methodologies to validate campaign components before launch
- Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimizations
- Manage ad budgets efficiently to maximize ROI for clients

### SEO & SERP Management

- Own on-page, technical, and off-page SEO strategy for multiple client websites
- Conduct keyword research and mapping to identify high-value organic opportunities, aligning with paid search targeting where relevant
- Monitor SERP rankings, visibility, and share-of-voice across target keywords, and track fluctuations tied to algorithm updates
- Perform technical SEO audits (site speed, crawlability, indexation, schema markup, mobile usability, Core Web Vitals) and coordinate fixes with dev/design teams
- Optimize on-page elements (title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, content structure) to improve rankings and CTR
- Analyze competitor SERP positioning and identify content gaps and link-building opportunities
- Develop and guide content briefs that support target keyword rankings, coordinating with content and design teams
- Track local SEO performance (Google Business Profile, citations, reviews) for local service clients
- Monitor and report on organic traffic, rankings, impressions, and CTR trends alongside paid metrics for a unified acquisition view
- Stay current on Google algorithm updates, search engine guidelines, and evolving SERP features (featured snippets, AI Overviews, local packs, etc.)

### Media Creation & Strategy

- Assist with media creation including ad copy writing, creative briefs, and basic graphic design coordination
- Proactively research and recommend new media opportunities and platforms to expand client reach
- Lead discussions with clients and team about emerging advertising and search channels and innovative campaign approaches
- Develop advertising and SEO strategies aligned with client business goals
- Stay current on platform updates, best practices, and industry trends
- Identify opportunities for campaign expansion and improvement across both paid and organic channels
- Recommend budget adjustments based on performance data
- Collaborate with content and design teams on ad creative and SEO content needs

### Reporting & Communication

- Create clear, actionable monthly performance reports for clients covering both paid and organic search performance
- Provide strategic recommendations based on campaign and SEO data and market insights
- Communicate campaign and SERP performance, insights, and recommendations to account managers
- Participate in client calls when needed to discuss strategy and results
- Track and report on key metrics: CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion rates, organic rankings, organic traffic, and keyword visibility
- Available during 9am-5pm Central Time at least 4-6 hours presence for team collaboration

## Required Qualifications

- 5+ years managing paid advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Meta Ads required)
- 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, including technical, on-page, and content-driven SEO
- Proven track record of managing $10K+ monthly ad budgets
- Demonstrated experience improving organic search rankings and visibility for multiple websites
- Demonstrated experience with A/B testing methodologies and statistical significance analysis
- Experience assisting with or directing media creation for digital campaigns
- Experience working in an agency environment managing multiple client accounts
- Google Ads certification (required)
- Meta Blueprint certification (preferred)
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console
- Proficiency with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or similar for keyword research, rank tracking, and audits
- Ability to take full ownership of accounts with minimal supervision
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Self-motivated and able to work independently
- Experience with reporting tools (Google Data Studio, Looker Studio, or similar)

## Nice-to-Have Skills

- LinkedIn Ads experience
- Microsoft Ads (Bing) experience
- Experience with landing page optimization and CRO
- Experience with unit testing frameworks for digital marketing campaigns
- Basic design skills (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite basics)
- Familiarity with CRM systems (particularly lead tracking and attribution)
- E-commerce advertising and SEO experience (Shopify, WooCommerce)
- Local service business advertising and local SEO experience
- Experience with link-building outreach and digital PR
- Familiarity with structured data / schema markup implementation
- Experience with JIRA or project management tools

## What We're Looking For

Someone who can hit the ground running, take full ownership of client advertising campaigns and SEO strategy, and free up our team to focus on strategic growth initiatives. You should be comfortable working independently across both paid and organic search channels while keeping stakeholders informed of progress and results. We need someone who thinks like an owner - proactively identifying opportunities across paid and organic search, recommending new approaches, and driving results without constant oversight.

metadata.title: Ads & SEO Manager (TN)
metadata.description:
Summary

Join our digital marketing agency as an Ads & SEO Manager to oversee paid advertising campaigns and organic search performance for multiple clients. This role requires full ownership of campaigns and SEO strategy, managing them independently while collaborating with our marketing team to achieve measurable ROI and search visibility gains. The position is remote with flexible hours and potential for full-time growth.

Deliverables

Campaign Management

  • Plan, launch, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and other relevant platforms
  • Take full ownership of campaign performance and results from strategy through execution
  • Manage multiple client ad accounts simultaneously with varying budgets and objectives
  • Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitive analysis
  • Design and execute comprehensive A/B testing strategies for ad copy, creatives, landing pages, and audiences to continuously improve performance
  • Implement unit testing methodologies to validate campaign components before launch
  • Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimizations
  • Manage ad budgets efficiently to maximize ROI for clients

SEO & SERP Management

  • Own on-page, technical, and off-page SEO strategy for multiple client websites
  • Conduct keyword research and mapping to identify high-value organic opportunities, aligning with paid search targeting where relevant
  • Monitor SERP rankings, visibility, and share-of-voice across target keywords, and track fluctuations tied to algorithm updates
  • Perform technical SEO audits (site speed, crawlability, indexation, schema markup, mobile usability, Core Web Vitals) and coordinate fixes with dev/design teams
  • Optimize on-page elements (title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, content structure) to improve rankings and CTR
  • Analyze competitor SERP positioning and identify content gaps and link-building opportunities
  • Develop and guide content briefs that support target keyword rankings, coordinating with content and design teams
  • Track local SEO performance (Google Business Profile, citations, reviews) for local service clients
  • Monitor and report on organic traffic, rankings, impressions, and CTR trends alongside paid metrics for a unified acquisition view
  • Stay current on Google algorithm updates, search engine guidelines, and evolving SERP features (featured snippets, AI Overviews, local packs, etc.)

Media Creation & Strategy

  • Assist with media creation including ad copy writing, creative briefs, and basic graphic design coordination
  • Proactively research and recommend new media opportunities and platforms to expand client reach
  • Lead discussions with clients and team about emerging advertising and search channels and innovative campaign approaches
  • Develop advertising and SEO strategies aligned with client business goals
  • Stay current on platform updates, best practices, and industry trends
  • Identify opportunities for campaign expansion and improvement across both paid and organic channels
  • Recommend budget adjustments based on performance data
  • Collaborate with content and design teams on ad creative and SEO content needs

Reporting & Communication

  • Create clear, actionable monthly performance reports for clients covering both paid and organic search performance
  • Provide strategic recommendations based on campaign and SEO data and market insights
  • Communicate campaign and SERP performance, insights, and recommendations to account managers
  • Participate in client calls when needed to discuss strategy and results
  • Track and report on key metrics: CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion rates, organic rankings, organic traffic, and keyword visibility
  • Available during 9am-5pm Central Time at least 4-6 hours presence for team collaboration

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years managing paid advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Meta Ads required)
  • 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, including technical, on-page, and content-driven SEO
  • Proven track record of managing $10K+ monthly ad budgets
  • Demonstrated experience improving organic search rankings and visibility for multiple websites
  • Demonstrated experience with A/B testing methodologies and statistical significance analysis
  • Experience assisting with or directing media creation for digital campaigns
  • Experience working in an agency environment managing multiple client accounts
  • Google Ads certification (required)
  • Meta Blueprint certification (preferred)
  • Strong analytical skills and proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console
  • Proficiency with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or similar for keyword research, rank tracking, and audits
  • Ability to take full ownership of accounts with minimal supervision
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently
  • Experience with reporting tools (Google Data Studio, Looker Studio, or similar)

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • LinkedIn Ads experience
  • Microsoft Ads (Bing) experience
  • Experience with landing page optimization and CRO
  • Experience with unit testing frameworks for digital marketing campaigns
  • Basic design skills (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite basics)
  • Familiarity with CRM systems (particularly lead tracking and attribution)
  • E-commerce advertising and SEO experience (Shopify, WooCommerce)
  • Local service business advertising and local SEO experience
  • Experience with link-building outreach and digital PR
  • Familiarity with structured data / schema markup implementation
  • Experience with JIRA or project management tools

What We're Looking For

Someone who can hit the ground running, take full ownership of client advertising campaigns and SEO strategy, and free up our team to focus on strategic growth initiatives. You should be comfortable working independently across both paid and organic search channels while keeping stakeholders informed of progress and results. We need someone who thinks like an owner - proactively identifying opportunities across paid and organic search, recommending new approaches, and driving results without constant oversight.

# Summary

Join our digital marketing agency as an Ads & SEO Manager to oversee paid advertising campaigns and organic search performance for multiple clients. This role requires full ownership of campaigns and SEO strategy, managing them independently while collaborating with our marketing team to achieve measurable ROI and search visibility gains. The position is remote with flexible hours and potential for full-time growth.

## Deliverables

### Campaign Management

- Plan, launch, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and other relevant platforms
- Take full ownership of campaign performance and results from strategy through execution
- Manage multiple client ad accounts simultaneously with varying budgets and objectives
- Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitive analysis
- Design and execute comprehensive A/B testing strategies for ad copy, creatives, landing pages, and audiences to continuously improve performance
- Implement unit testing methodologies to validate campaign components before launch
- Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimizations
- Manage ad budgets efficiently to maximize ROI for clients

### SEO & SERP Management

- Own on-page, technical, and off-page SEO strategy for multiple client websites
- Conduct keyword research and mapping to identify high-value organic opportunities, aligning with paid search targeting where relevant
- Monitor SERP rankings, visibility, and share-of-voice across target keywords, and track fluctuations tied to algorithm updates
- Perform technical SEO audits (site speed, crawlability, indexation, schema markup, mobile usability, Core Web Vitals) and coordinate fixes with dev/design teams
- Optimize on-page elements (title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, content structure) to improve rankings and CTR
- Analyze competitor SERP positioning and identify content gaps and link-building opportunities
- Develop and guide content briefs that support target keyword rankings, coordinating with content and design teams
- Track local SEO performance (Google Business Profile, citations, reviews) for local service clients
- Monitor and report on organic traffic, rankings, impressions, and CTR trends alongside paid metrics for a unified acquisition view
- Stay current on Google algorithm updates, search engine guidelines, and evolving SERP features (featured snippets, AI Overviews, local packs, etc.)

### Media Creation & Strategy

- Assist with media creation including ad copy writing, creative briefs, and basic graphic design coordination
- Proactively research and recommend new media opportunities and platforms to expand client reach
- Lead discussions with clients and team about emerging advertising and search channels and innovative campaign approaches
- Develop advertising and SEO strategies aligned with client business goals
- Stay current on platform updates, best practices, and industry trends
- Identify opportunities for campaign expansion and improvement across both paid and organic channels
- Recommend budget adjustments based on performance data
- Collaborate with content and design teams on ad creative and SEO content needs

### Reporting & Communication

- Create clear, actionable monthly performance reports for clients covering both paid and organic search performance
- Provide strategic recommendations based on campaign and SEO data and market insights
- Communicate campaign and SERP performance, insights, and recommendations to account managers
- Participate in client calls when needed to discuss strategy and results
- Track and report on key metrics: CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion rates, organic rankings, organic traffic, and keyword visibility
- Available during 9am-5pm Central Time at least 4-6 hours presence for team collaboration

## Required Qualifications

- 5+ years managing paid advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Meta Ads required)
- 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, including technical, on-page, and content-driven SEO
- Proven track record of managing $10K+ monthly ad budgets
- Demonstrated experience improving organic search rankings and visibility for multiple websites
- Demonstrated experience with A/B testing methodologies and statistical significance analysis
- Experience assisting with or directing media creation for digital campaigns
- Experience working in an agency environment managing multiple client accounts
- Google Ads certification (required)
- Meta Blueprint certification (preferred)
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console
- Proficiency with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or similar for keyword research, rank tracking, and audits
- Ability to take full ownership of accounts with minimal supervision
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Self-motivated and able to work independently
- Experience with reporting tools (Google Data Studio, Looker Studio, or similar)

## Nice-to-Have Skills

- LinkedIn Ads experience
- Microsoft Ads (Bing) experience
- Experience with landing page optimization and CRO
- Experience with unit testing frameworks for digital marketing campaigns
- Basic design skills (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite basics)
- Familiarity with CRM systems (particularly lead tracking and attribution)
- E-commerce advertising and SEO experience (Shopify, WooCommerce)
- Local service business advertising and local SEO experience
- Experience with link-building outreach and digital PR
- Familiarity with structured data / schema markup implementation
- Experience with JIRA or project management tools

## What We're Looking For

Someone who can hit the ground running, take full ownership of client advertising campaigns and SEO strategy, and free up our team to focus on strategic growth initiatives. You should be comfortable working independently across both paid and organic search channels while keeping stakeholders informed of progress and results. We need someone who thinks like an owner - proactively identifying opportunities across paid and organic search, recommending new approaches, and driving results without constant oversight.

# Summary

Join our digital marketing agency as an Ads & SEO Manager to oversee paid advertising campaigns and organic search performance for multiple clients. This role requires full ownership of campaigns and SEO strategy, managing them independently while collaborating with our marketing team to achieve measurable ROI and search visibility gains. The position is remote with flexible hours and potential for full-time growth.

## Deliverables

### Campaign Management

- Plan, launch, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and other relevant platforms
- Take full ownership of campaign performance and results from strategy through execution
- Manage multiple client ad accounts simultaneously with varying budgets and objectives
- Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitive analysis
- Design and execute comprehensive A/B testing strategies for ad copy, creatives, landing pages, and audiences to continuously improve performance
- Implement unit testing methodologies to validate campaign components before launch
- Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimizations
- Manage ad budgets efficiently to maximize ROI for clients

### SEO & SERP Management

- Own on-page, technical, and off-page SEO strategy for multiple client websites
- Conduct keyword research and mapping to identify high-value organic opportunities, aligning with paid search targeting where relevant
- Monitor SERP rankings, visibility, and share-of-voice across target keywords, and track fluctuations tied to algorithm updates
- Perform technical SEO audits (site speed, crawlability, indexation, schema markup, mobile usability, Core Web Vitals) and coordinate fixes with dev/design teams
- Optimize on-page elements (title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, content structure) to improve rankings and CTR
- Analyze competitor SERP positioning and identify content gaps and link-building opportunities
- Develop and guide content briefs that support target keyword rankings, coordinating with content and design teams
- Track local SEO performance (Google Business Profile, citations, reviews) for local service clients
- Monitor and report on organic traffic, rankings, impressions, and CTR trends alongside paid metrics for a unified acquisition view
- Stay current on Google algorithm updates, search engine guidelines, and evolving SERP features (featured snippets, AI Overviews, local packs, etc.)

### Media Creation & Strategy

- Assist with media creation including ad copy writing, creative briefs, and basic graphic design coordination
- Proactively research and recommend new media opportunities and platforms to expand client reach
- Lead discussions with clients and team about emerging advertising and search channels and innovative campaign approaches
- Develop advertising and SEO strategies aligned with client business goals
- Stay current on platform updates, best practices, and industry trends
- Identify opportunities for campaign expansion and improvement across both paid and organic channels
- Recommend budget adjustments based on performance data
- Collaborate with content and design teams on ad creative and SEO content needs

### Reporting & Communication

- Create clear, actionable monthly performance reports for clients covering both paid and organic search performance
- Provide strategic recommendations based on campaign and SEO data and market insights
- Communicate campaign and SERP performance, insights, and recommendations to account managers
- Participate in client calls when needed to discuss strategy and results
- Track and report on key metrics: CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion rates, organic rankings, organic traffic, and keyword visibility
- Available during 9am-5pm Central Time at least 4-6 hours presence for team collaboration

## Required Qualifications

- 5+ years managing paid advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Meta Ads required)
- 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, including technical, on-page, and content-driven SEO
- Proven track record of managing $10K+ monthly ad budgets
- Demonstrated experience improving organic search rankings and visibility for multiple websites
- Demonstrated experience with A/B testing methodologies and statistical significance analysis
- Experience assisting with or directing media creation for digital campaigns
- Experience working in an agency environment managing multiple client accounts
- Google Ads certification (required)
- Meta Blueprint certification (preferred)
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console
- Proficiency with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or similar for keyword research, rank tracking, and audits
- Ability to take full ownership of accounts with minimal supervision
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Self-motivated and able to work independently
- Experience with reporting tools (Google Data Studio, Looker Studio, or similar)

## Nice-to-Have Skills

- LinkedIn Ads experience
- Microsoft Ads (Bing) experience
- Experience with landing page optimization and CRO
- Experience with unit testing frameworks for digital marketing campaigns
- Basic design skills (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite basics)
- Familiarity with CRM systems (particularly lead tracking and attribution)
- E-commerce advertising and SEO experience (Shopify, WooCommerce)
- Local service business advertising and local SEO experience
- Experience with link-building outreach and digital PR
- Familiarity with structured data / schema markup implementation
- Experience with JIRA or project management tools

## What We're Looking For

Someone who can hit the ground running, take full ownership of client advertising campaigns and SEO strategy, and free up our team to focus on strategic growth initiatives. You should be comfortable working independently across both paid and organic search channels while keeping stakeholders informed of progress and results. We need someone who thinks like an owner - proactively identifying opportunities across paid and organic search, recommending new approaches, and driving results without constant oversight.

# Summary

Join our digital marketing agency as an Ads & SEO Manager to oversee paid advertising campaigns and organic search performance for multiple clients. This role requires full ownership of campaigns and SEO strategy, managing them independently while collaborating with our marketing team to achieve measurable ROI and search visibility gains. The position is remote with flexible hours and potential for full-time growth.

## Deliverables

### Campaign Management

- Plan, launch, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and other relevant platforms
- Take full ownership of campaign performance and results from strategy through execution
- Manage multiple client ad accounts simultaneously with varying budgets and objectives
- Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitive analysis
- Design and execute comprehensive A/B testing strategies for ad copy, creatives, landing pages, and audiences to continuously improve performance
- Implement unit testing methodologies to validate campaign components before launch
- Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimizations
- Manage ad budgets efficiently to maximize ROI for clients

### SEO & SERP Management

- Own on-page, technical, and off-page SEO strategy for multiple client websites
- Conduct keyword research and mapping to identify high-value organic opportunities, aligning with paid search targeting where relevant
- Monitor SERP rankings, visibility, and share-of-voice across target keywords, and track fluctuations tied to algorithm updates
- Perform technical SEO audits (site speed, crawlability, indexation, schema markup, mobile usability, Core Web Vitals) and coordinate fixes with dev/design teams
- Optimize on-page elements (title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, content structure) to improve rankings and CTR
- Analyze competitor SERP positioning and identify content gaps and link-building opportunities
- Develop and guide content briefs that support target keyword rankings, coordinating with content and design teams
- Track local SEO performance (Google Business Profile, citations, reviews) for local service clients
- Monitor and report on organic traffic, rankings, impressions, and CTR trends alongside paid metrics for a unified acquisition view
- Stay current on Google algorithm updates, search engine guidelines, and evolving SERP features (featured snippets, AI Overviews, local packs, etc.)

### Media Creation & Strategy

- Assist with media creation including ad copy writing, creative briefs, and basic graphic design coordination
- Proactively research and recommend new media opportunities and platforms to expand client reach
- Lead discussions with clients and team about emerging advertising and search channels and innovative campaign approaches
- Develop advertising and SEO strategies aligned with client business goals
- Stay current on platform updates, best practices, and industry trends
- Identify opportunities for campaign expansion and improvement across both paid and organic channels
- Recommend budget adjustments based on performance data
- Collaborate with content and design teams on ad creative and SEO content needs

### Reporting & Communication

- Create clear, actionable monthly performance reports for clients covering both paid and organic search performance
- Provide strategic recommendations based on campaign and SEO data and market insights
- Communicate campaign and SERP performance, insights, and recommendations to account managers
- Participate in client calls when needed to discuss strategy and results
- Track and report on key metrics: CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion rates, organic rankings, organic traffic, and keyword visibility
- Available during 9am-5pm Central Time at least 4-6 hours presence for team collaboration

## Required Qualifications

- 5+ years managing paid advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Meta Ads required)
- 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, including technical, on-page, and content-driven SEO
- Proven track record of managing $10K+ monthly ad budgets
- Demonstrated experience improving organic search rankings and visibility for multiple websites
- Demonstrated experience with A/B testing methodologies and statistical significance analysis
- Experience assisting with or directing media creation for digital campaigns
- Experience working in an agency environment managing multiple client accounts
- Google Ads certification (required)
- Meta Blueprint certification (preferred)
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console
- Proficiency with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or similar for keyword research, rank tracking, and audits
- Ability to take full ownership of accounts with minimal supervision
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Self-motivated and able to work independently
- Experience with reporting tools (Google Data Studio, Looker Studio, or similar)

## Nice-to-Have Skills

- LinkedIn Ads experience
- Microsoft Ads (Bing) experience
- Experience with landing page optimization and CRO
- Experience with unit testing frameworks for digital marketing campaigns
- Basic design skills (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite basics)
- Familiarity with CRM systems (particularly lead tracking and attribution)
- E-commerce advertising and SEO experience (Shopify, WooCommerce)
- Local service business advertising and local SEO experience
- Experience with link-building outreach and digital PR
- Familiarity with structured data / schema markup implementation
- Experience with JIRA or project management tools

## What We're Looking For

Someone who can hit the ground running, take full ownership of client advertising campaigns and SEO strategy, and free up our team to focus on strategic growth initiatives. You should be comfortable working independently across both paid and organic search channels while keeping stakeholders informed of progress and results. We need someone who thinks like an owner - proactively identifying opportunities across paid and organic search, recommending new approaches, and driving results without constant oversight.

# Summary

Join our digital marketing agency as an Ads & SEO Manager to oversee paid advertising campaigns and organic search performance for multiple clients. This role requires full ownership of campaigns and SEO strategy, managing them independently while collaborating with our marketing team to achieve measurable ROI and search visibility gains. The position is remote with flexible hours and potential for full-time growth.

## Deliverables

### Campaign Management

- Plan, launch, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and other relevant platforms
- Take full ownership of campaign performance and results from strategy through execution
- Manage multiple client ad accounts simultaneously with varying budgets and objectives
- Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitive analysis
- Design and execute comprehensive A/B testing strategies for ad copy, creatives, landing pages, and audiences to continuously improve performance
- Implement unit testing methodologies to validate campaign components before launch
- Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimizations
- Manage ad budgets efficiently to maximize ROI for clients

### SEO & SERP Management

- Own on-page, technical, and off-page SEO strategy for multiple client websites
- Conduct keyword research and mapping to identify high-value organic opportunities, aligning with paid search targeting where relevant
- Monitor SERP rankings, visibility, and share-of-voice across target keywords, and track fluctuations tied to algorithm updates
- Perform technical SEO audits (site speed, crawlability, indexation, schema markup, mobile usability, Core Web Vitals) and coordinate fixes with dev/design teams
- Optimize on-page elements (title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, content structure) to improve rankings and CTR
- Analyze competitor SERP positioning and identify content gaps and link-building opportunities
- Develop and guide content briefs that support target keyword rankings, coordinating with content and design teams
- Track local SEO performance (Google Business Profile, citations, reviews) for local service clients
- Monitor and report on organic traffic, rankings, impressions, and CTR trends alongside paid metrics for a unified acquisition view
- Stay current on Google algorithm updates, search engine guidelines, and evolving SERP features (featured snippets, AI Overviews, local packs, etc.)

### Media Creation & Strategy

- Assist with media creation including ad copy writing, creative briefs, and basic graphic design coordination
- Proactively research and recommend new media opportunities and platforms to expand client reach
- Lead discussions with clients and team about emerging advertising and search channels and innovative campaign approaches
- Develop advertising and SEO strategies aligned with client business goals
- Stay current on platform updates, best practices, and industry trends
- Identify opportunities for campaign expansion and improvement across both paid and organic channels
- Recommend budget adjustments based on performance data
- Collaborate with content and design teams on ad creative and SEO content needs

### Reporting & Communication

- Create clear, actionable monthly performance reports for clients covering both paid and organic search performance
- Provide strategic recommendations based on campaign and SEO data and market insights
- Communicate campaign and SERP performance, insights, and recommendations to account managers
- Participate in client calls when needed to discuss strategy and results
- Track and report on key metrics: CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion rates, organic rankings, organic traffic, and keyword visibility
- Available during 9am-5pm Central Time at least 4-6 hours presence for team collaboration

## Required Qualifications

- 5+ years managing paid advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Meta Ads required)
- 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, including technical, on-page, and content-driven SEO
- Proven track record of managing $10K+ monthly ad budgets
- Demonstrated experience improving organic search rankings and visibility for multiple websites
- Demonstrated experience with A/B testing methodologies and statistical significance analysis
- Experience assisting with or directing media creation for digital campaigns
- Experience working in an agency environment managing multiple client accounts
- Google Ads certification (required)
- Meta Blueprint certification (preferred)
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console
- Proficiency with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or similar for keyword research, rank tracking, and audits
- Ability to take full ownership of accounts with minimal supervision
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Self-motivated and able to work independently
- Experience with reporting tools (Google Data Studio, Looker Studio, or similar)

## Nice-to-Have Skills

- LinkedIn Ads experience
- Microsoft Ads (Bing) experience
- Experience with landing page optimization and CRO
- Experience with unit testing frameworks for digital marketing campaigns
- Basic design skills (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite basics)
- Familiarity with CRM systems (particularly lead tracking and attribution)
- E-commerce advertising and SEO experience (Shopify, WooCommerce)
- Local service business advertising and local SEO experience
- Experience with link-building outreach and digital PR
- Familiarity with structured data / schema markup implementation
- Experience with JIRA or project management tools

## What We're Looking For

Someone who can hit the ground running, take full ownership of client advertising campaigns and SEO strategy, and free up our team to focus on strategic growth initiatives. You should be comfortable working independently across both paid and organic search channels while keeping stakeholders informed of progress and results. We need someone who thinks like an owner - proactively identifying opportunities across paid and organic search, recommending new approaches, and driving results without constant oversight.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Develop and execute cross-channel media plans that connect audience, budget, and channel choices to campaign goals
- Plan and buy out-of-home media, including billboards, transit, place-based, and digital out-of-home
- Plan and buy video and audio across linear and streaming channels, including broadcast and cable TV, connected TV, terrestrial radio, streaming audio, and podcasts
- Write and manage vendor RFPs, evaluate proposals, and recommend buys based on reach, cost, and fit
- Negotiate rates, added value, makegoods, and contract terms with media vendors
- Manage vendor relationships and day-to-day execution, including insertion orders, creative specs and deadlines, trafficking, proof of performance, and invoice reconciliation
- Monitor pacing and delivery, resolve under-delivery, and deliver clear, actionable performance reporting
- Present and defend media recommendations to clients and prime contractors
- Partner with the digital media lead, strategists, and creatives to ensure integrated execution across channels
- Support proposal development with media strategy, sample plans, and past performance content
- Leverage AI-enabled platforms and features for planning, audience insights, and efficiency where appropriate
- May be responsible for other duties as assigned

- 8–10 years of paid media experience, including hands-on planning and buying across multiple channels
- Demonstrated experience buying across traditional and digital media channels
- Proven experience running vendor RFPs and negotiating media buys
- Strong vendor management skills and attention to detail with contracts, orders, and billing
- Experience managing budgets and multiple campaigns at once
- Familiarity with media planning and research tools such as Nielsen, Comscore, Geopath, or MRI-Simmons
- Federal government experience strongly preferred, including familiarity with government procurement, invoicing, and approval processes

At Red Carrot, we empower you to be a leader. We attract and develop talent from all backgrounds because we believe there’s strength in diversity, offering different perspectives and skills. - Training and Development – Tuition reimbursement and professional trainings for eligible employees.
- Healthcare – Top-tier medical, dental, vision, life insurance and long-term disability coverage.
- 401(k) Plan – 401(k)-retirement and Roth plan with company matching and no vesting period.
- Profit Sharing – Discretionary profit-sharing plan to all eligible employees after one year of employment.
- Paid Time Off – Provides flexible work hours, paid time off, and 11 federal holidays.

_**About Us:**_

Red Carrot is an award-winning, woman-owned small business built for the complexity of federal government work. We partner with clients to advance their goals — powered by a team fueled by passion, backed by intelligence, and grounded in expertise.

From day one, we've applied industrial engineering principles and data analytics to solve complex problems with precision. Our approach is research-centric, data-informed, and audience-oriented — and it's how we deliver work that actually moves the needle.

We exist to strengthen the organizations and communities we serve through trusted, purposeful communication. That's not a tagline — it's the standard we hold ourselves to on every engagement.

Headquartered in Miami, Florida, with a strong and growing presence in Washington, D.C., our team works with clients across the country. Distance doesn't dilute our service. We build capacity where our clients need it, delivering Strategic Communications, Customer Experience, Management Consulting, and Human Capital Solutions that fit their mission — and their moment.

We're the partner organizations turn to when communication challenges are real, the stakes are high, and the work has to matter.

**Paid Media Manager**

Level: Senior \| Work Location: Remote

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Red Carrot is seeking a Paid Media Manager to lead cross-channel media planning, buying, and vendor management for federal programs. This role brings deep hands-on experience with traditional and streaming media, including out-of-home, video, and audio. The Paid Media Manager works closely with our digital media lead and contributes to overall media strategy under the guidance of the Director.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Develop and execute cross-channel media plans that connect audience, budget, and channel choices to campaign goals
- Plan and buy out-of-home media, including billboards, transit, place-based, and digital out-of-home
- Plan and buy video and audio across linear and streaming channels, including broadcast and cable TV, connected TV, terrestrial radio, streaming audio, and podcasts
- Write and manage vendor RFPs, evaluate proposals, and recommend buys based on reach, cost, and fit
- Negotiate rates, added value, makegoods, and contract terms with media vendors
- Manage vendor relationships and day-to-day execution, including insertion orders, creative specs and deadlines, trafficking, proof of performance, and invoice reconciliation
- Monitor pacing and delivery, resolve under-delivery, and deliver clear, actionable performance reporting
- Present and defend media recommendations to clients and prime contractors
- Partner with the digital media lead, strategists, and creatives to ensure integrated execution across channels
- Support proposal development with media strategy, sample plans, and past performance content
- Leverage AI-enabled platforms and features for planning, audience insights, and efficiency where appropriate
- May be responsible for other duties as assigned

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

- 8–10 years of paid media experience, including hands-on planning and buying across multiple channels
- Demonstrated experience buying across traditional and digital media channels
- Proven experience running vendor RFPs and negotiating media buys
- Strong vendor management skills and attention to detail with contracts, orders, and billing
- Experience managing budgets and multiple campaigns at once
- Familiarity with media planning and research tools such as Nielsen, Comscore, Geopath, or MRI-Simmons
- Federal government experience strongly preferred, including familiarity with government procurement, invoicing, and approval processes

_**Benefits at Red Carrot:**_

At Red Carrot, we empower you to be a leader. We attract and develop talent from all backgrounds because we believe there’s strength in diversity, offering different perspectives and skills. Together, we can solve our client’s biggest challenges. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package.

- Training and Development – Tuition reimbursement and professional trainings for eligible employees.
- Healthcare – Top-tier medical, dental, vision, life insurance and long-term disability coverage.
- 401(k) Plan – 401(k)-retirement and Roth plan with company matching and no vesting period.
- Profit Sharing – Discretionary profit-sharing plan to all eligible employees after one year of employment.
- Paid Time Off – Provides flexible work hours, paid time off, and 11 federal holidays.

_**About Us:**_

Red Carrot is an award-winning, woman-owned small business built for the complexity of federal government work. We partner with clients to advance their goals — powered by a team fueled by passion, backed by intelligence, and grounded in expertise.

From day one, we've applied industrial engineering principles and data analytics to solve complex problems with precision. Our approach is research-centric, data-informed, and audience-oriented — and it's how we deliver work that actually moves the needle.

We exist to strengthen the organizations and communities we serve through trusted, purposeful communication. That's not a tagline — it's the standard we hold ourselves to on every engagement.

Headquartered in Miami, Florida, with a strong and growing presence in Washington, D.C., our team works with clients across the country. Distance doesn't dilute our service. We build capacity where our clients need it, delivering Strategic Communications, Customer Experience, Management Consulting, and Human Capital Solutions that fit their mission — and their moment.

We're the partner organizations turn to when communication challenges are real, the stakes are high, and the work has to matter.

                            <div id="resumator-new-veteran-message">
                                <div class="text-center"><strong>Invitation for Job Applicants to Self-Identify as a U.S. Veteran</strong></div>
                                <div class="resumator-input" id="veteran-content">
                                    <ul>
                                        <li>A “disabled veteran” is one of the following:
                                            <ul>
                                                <li>a veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs; or</li>
                                                <li>a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.</li>
                                            </ul>
                                        </li>
                                        <li>A “recently separated veteran” means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.</li>
                                        <li>An “active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran” means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.</li>
                                        <li>An “Armed forces service medal veteran” means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.</li>
                                    </ul>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div id="resumator-new-disability-message">
                                <div class="text-center"><strong>Voluntary Self-Identification of Disability</strong></div>
                                <div class="text-right" style="margin: 10px 0 10px 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15.6px;">
                                    Voluntary Self-Identification of Disability Form CC-305<br>
                                    OMB Control Number 1250-0005<br>
                                    Expires 07/31/2029
                                </div>
                                <div id="disability-content">
                                    <div class="box-message" style="text-align:center;">Why are you being asked to complete this form?</div>
                                    <div class="resumator-input">
                                        <p>We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified
                                            people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we
                                            must measure our progress towards this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability
                                            or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.</p>

                                        <p>Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who
                                            makes hiring decisions will see it. Your decision to complete the form and your answer will not harm you in any way. If you
                                            want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance
                                            Programs (OFCCP) website at <a href="https://www.dol.gov/ofccp" target="_blank">www.dol.gov/ofccp</a>.</p>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="centered-message box-message">
                                        <div class="resumator-label" style="text-align:center;">How do you know if you have a disability?</div>
                                    </div>

                                    <div class="resumator-input">
                                        <p>A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had
                                            such a condition, you are a person with a disability. <strong>Disabilities include, but are not limited to:</strong></p>
                                        <ul id="disabilities-list">
                                            <li>Alcohol or other substance use
                                                disorder (not currently using
                                                drugs illegally)</li>
                                            <li>Autoimmune disorder, for
                                                example, lupus, fibromyalgia,
                                                rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS</li>
                                            <li>Blind or low vision</li>
                                            <li>Cancer (past or present)</li>
                                            <li>Cardiovascular or heart
                                                disease</li>
                                            <li>Celiac disease</li>
                                            <li>Cerebral palsy</li>
                                            <li>Deaf or serious difficulty
                                                hearing</li>
                                            <li>Diabetes</li>
                                            <li>Disfigurement, for example,
                                                disfigurement caused by burns,
                                                wounds, accidents, or congenital
                                                disorders</li>
                                            <li>Epilepsy or other seizure disorder</li>
                                            <li>Gastrointestinal disorders, for example,
                                                Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel
                                                syndrome</li>
                                            <li>Intellectual or developmental disability</li>
                                            <li>Mental health conditions, for example,
                                                depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety
                                                disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD</li>
                                            <li>Missing limbs or partially missing limbs</li>
                                            <li>Mobility impairment, benefiting from the
                                                use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker,
                                                leg brace(s) and/or other supports</li>
                                            <li>Nervous system condition, for example,
                                                migraine headaches, Parkinson’s
                                                disease, multiple sclerosis (MS)</li>
                                            <li>Neurodivergence, for example,
                                                attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder
                                                (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder,
                                                dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning
                                                disabilities</li>
                                            <li>Partial or complete paralysis (any
                                                cause)</li>
                                            <li>Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for
                                                example, tuberculosis, asthma,
                                                emphysema</li>
                                            <li>Short stature (dwarfism)</li>
                                            <li>Traumatic brain injury</li>
                                        </ul>
                                    </div>

                                    <div id="disability-input-area">
                                        <div class="centered-message box-message">
                                            <div class="resumator-label" style="text-align:center;">Please check one of the boxes below:</div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="resumator-input">

                                            </div>

This survey should take about 5 minutes to complete.</p>

## Thanks for visiting our Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications.

## Paid Media Manager

Remote

Full Time

Experienced

[Share](https://redcarrot.applytojob.com/app/share/nq99HRqLqH)

**Paid Media Manager**

Level: Senior \| Work Location: Remote

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Red Carrot is seeking a Paid Media Manager to lead cross-channel media planning, buying, and vendor management for federal programs. This role brings deep hands-on experience with traditional and streaming media, including out-of-home, video, and audio. The Paid Media Manager works closely with our digital media lead and contributes to overall media strategy under the guidance of the Director.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Develop and execute cross-channel media plans that connect audience, budget, and channel choices to campaign goals
- Plan and buy out-of-home media, including billboards, transit, place-based, and digital out-of-home
- Plan and buy video and audio across linear and streaming channels, including broadcast and cable TV, connected TV, terrestrial radio, streaming audio, and podcasts
- Write and manage vendor RFPs, evaluate proposals, and recommend buys based on reach, cost, and fit
- Negotiate rates, added value, makegoods, and contract terms with media vendors
- Manage vendor relationships and day-to-day execution, including insertion orders, creative specs and deadlines, trafficking, proof of performance, and invoice reconciliation
- Monitor pacing and delivery, resolve under-delivery, and deliver clear, actionable performance reporting
- Present and defend media recommendations to clients and prime contractors
- Partner with the digital media lead, strategists, and creatives to ensure integrated execution across channels
- Support proposal development with media strategy, sample plans, and past performance content
- Leverage AI-enabled platforms and features for planning, audience insights, and efficiency where appropriate
- May be responsible for other duties as assigned

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

- 8–10 years of paid media experience, including hands-on planning and buying across multiple channels
- Demonstrated experience buying across traditional and digital media channels
- Proven experience running vendor RFPs and negotiating media buys
- Strong vendor management skills and attention to detail with contracts, orders, and billing
- Experience managing budgets and multiple campaigns at once
- Familiarity with media planning and research tools such as Nielsen, Comscore, Geopath, or MRI-Simmons
- Federal government experience strongly preferred, including familiarity with government procurement, invoicing, and approval processes

_**Benefits at Red Carrot:**_

At Red Carrot, we empower you to be a leader. We attract and develop talent from all backgrounds because we believe there’s strength in diversity, offering different perspectives and skills. Together, we can solve our client’s biggest challenges. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package.

- Training and Development – Tuition reimbursement and professional trainings for eligible employees.
- Healthcare – Top-tier medical, dental, vision, life insurance and long-term disability coverage.
- 401(k) Plan – 401(k)-retirement and Roth plan with company matching and no vesting period.
- Profit Sharing – Discretionary profit-sharing plan to all eligible employees after one year of employment.
- Paid Time Off – Provides flexible work hours, paid time off, and 11 federal holidays.

_**About Us:**_

Red Carrot is an award-winning, woman-owned small business built for the complexity of federal government work. We partner with clients to advance their goals — powered by a team fueled by passion, backed by intelligence, and grounded in expertise.

From day one, we've applied industrial engineering principles and data analytics to solve complex problems with precision. Our approach is research-centric, data-informed, and audience-oriented — and it's how we deliver work that actually moves the needle.

We exist to strengthen the organizations and communities we serve through trusted, purposeful communication. That's not a tagline — it's the standard we hold ourselves to on every engagement.

Headquartered in Miami, Florida, with a strong and growing presence in Washington, D.C., our team works with clients across the country. Distance doesn't dilute our service. We build capacity where our clients need it, delivering Strategic Communications, Customer Experience, Management Consulting, and Human Capital Solutions that fit their mission — and their moment.

We're the partner organizations turn to when communication challenges are real, the stakes are high, and the work has to matter.

Apply

  - a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
- A “recently separated veteran” means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.

Voluntary Self-Identification of Disability Form CC-305

Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified
people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we
must measure our progress towards this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability
or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who
makes hiring decisions will see it. Your decision to complete the form and your answer will not harm you in any way. If you
want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance
Programs (OFCCP) website at [www.dol.gov/ofccp](https://www.dol.gov/ofccp).

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had
such a condition, you are a person with a disability. **Disabilities include, but are not limited to:**

- Alcohol or other substance use
disorder (not currently using
drugs illegally)
- Autoimmune disorder, for
example, lupus, fibromyalgia,
rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
- Blind or low vision
- Cancer (past or present)
- Cardiovascular or heart
disease
- Celiac disease
- Cerebral palsy
- Deaf or serious difficulty
hearing
- Diabetes
- Disfigurement, for example,
disfigurement caused by burns,
wounds, accidents, or congenital
disorders
- Epilepsy or other seizure disorder
- Gastrointestinal disorders, for example,
Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel
syndrome
- Intellectual or developmental disability
- Mental health conditions, for example,
depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety
disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD
- Missing limbs or partially missing limbs
- Mobility impairment, benefiting from the
use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker,
leg brace(s) and/or other supports
- Nervous system condition, for example,
migraine headaches, Parkinson’s
disease, multiple sclerosis (MS)
- Neurodivergence, for example,
attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder
(ADHD), autism spectrum disorder,
dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning
disabilities
- Partial or complete paralysis (any
cause)
- Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for
example, tuberculosis, asthma,
emphysema
- Short stature (dwarfism)
- Traumatic brain injury

Paid Media Manager
Level: Senior | Work Location: Remote

ABOUT THE ROLE
Red Carrot is seeking a Paid Media Manager to lead cross-channel media planning, buying, and vendor management for federal programs. This role brings deep hands-on experience with traditional and streaming media, including out-of-home, video, and audio. The Paid Media Manager works closely with our digital media lead and contributes to overall media strategy under the guidance of the Director.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and execute cross-channel media plans that connect audience, budget, and channel choices to campaign goals
  • Plan and buy out-of-home media, including billboards, transit, place-based, and digital out-of-home
  • Plan and buy video and audio across linear and streaming channels, including broadcast and cable TV, connected TV, terrestrial radio, streaming audio, and podcasts
  • Write and manage vendor RFPs, evaluate proposals, and recommend buys based on reach, cost, and fit
  • Negotiate rates, added value, makegoods, and contract terms with media vendors
  • Manage vendor relationships and day-to-day execution, including insertion orders, creative specs and deadlines, trafficking, proof of performance, and invoice reconciliation
  • Monitor pacing and delivery, resolve under-delivery, and deliver clear, actionable performance reporting
  • Present and defend media recommendations to clients and prime contractors
  • Partner with the digital media lead, strategists, and creatives to ensure integrated execution across channels
  • Support proposal development with media strategy, sample plans, and past performance content
  • Leverage AI-enabled platforms and features for planning, audience insights, and efficiency where appropriate
  • May be responsible for other duties as assigned

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8–10 years of paid media experience, including hands-on planning and buying across multiple channels
  • Demonstrated experience buying across traditional and digital media channels
  • Proven experience running vendor RFPs and negotiating media buys
  • Strong vendor management skills and attention to detail with contracts, orders, and billing
  • Experience managing budgets and multiple campaigns at once
  • Familiarity with media planning and research tools such as Nielsen, Comscore, Geopath, or MRI-Simmons
  • Federal government experience strongly preferred, including familiarity with government procurement, invoicing, and approval processes

Benefits at Red Carrot:    

At Red Carrot, we empower you to be a leader. We attract and develop talent from all backgrounds because we believe there’s strength in diversity, offering different perspectives and skills. Together, we can solve our client’s biggest challenges. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package.     

  • Training and Development – Tuition reimbursement and professional trainings for eligible employees.
  • Healthcare – Top-tier medical, dental, vision, life insurance and long-term disability coverage.     
  • 401(k) Plan – 401(k)-retirement and Roth plan with company matching and no vesting period.     
  • Profit Sharing – Discretionary profit-sharing plan to all eligible employees after one year of employment.          
  • Paid Time Off – Provides flexible work hours, paid time off, and 11 federal holidays.   

About Us:

Red Carrot is an award-winning, woman-owned small business built for the complexity of federal government work. We partner with clients to advance their goals — powered by a team fueled by passion, backed by intelligence, and grounded in expertise.

From day one, we've applied industrial engineering principles and data analytics to solve complex problems with precision. Our approach is research-centric, data-informed, and audience-oriented — and it's how we deliver work that actually moves the needle.

We exist to strengthen the organizations and communities we serve through trusted, purposeful communication. That's not a tagline — it's the standard we hold ourselves to on every engagement.

Headquartered in Miami, Florida, with a strong and growing presence in Washington, D.C., our team works with clients across the country. Distance doesn't dilute our service. We build capacity where our clients need it, delivering Strategic Communications, Customer Experience, Management Consulting, and Human Capital Solutions that fit their mission — and their moment.

We're the partner organizations turn to when communication challenges are real, the stakes are high, and the work has to matter.

The Paid Media Manager works closely with our digital media lead and contributes to overall media strategy under the guidance of the Director.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Develop and execute cross-channel media plans that connect audience, budget, and channel choices to campaign goals
- Plan and buy out-of-home media, including billboards, transit, place-based, and digital out-of-home
- Plan and buy video and audio across linear and streaming channels, including broadcast and cable TV, connected TV, terrestrial radio, streaming audio, and podcasts
- Write and manage vendor RFPs, evaluate proposals, and recommend buys based on reach, cost, and fit
- Negotiate rates, added value, makegoods, and contract terms with media vendors
- Manage vendor relationships and day-to-day execution, including insertion orders, creative specs and deadlines, trafficking, proof of performance, and invoice reconciliation
- Monitor pacing and delivery, resolve under-delivery, and deliver clear, actionable performance reporting
- Present and defend media recommendations to clients and prime contractors
- Partner with the digital media lead, strategists, and creatives to ensure integrated execution across channels
- Support proposal development with media strategy, sample plans, and past performance content
- Leverage AI-enabled platforms and features for planning, audience insights, and efficiency where appropriate
- May be responsible for other duties as assigned

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

- 8–10 years of paid media experience, including hands-on planning and buying across multiple channels
- Demonstrated experience buying across traditional and digital media channels
- Proven experience running vendor RFPs and negotiating media buys
- Strong vendor management skills and attention to detail with contracts, orders, and billing
- Experience managing budgets and multiple campaigns at once
- Familiarity with media planning and research tools such as Nielsen, Comscore, Geopath, or MRI-Simmons
- Federal government experience strongly preferred, including familiarity with government procurement, invoicing, and approval processes

_**Benefits at Red Carrot:**_

At Red Carrot, we empower you to be a leader. We attract and develop talent from all backgrounds because we believe there’s strength in diversity, offering different perspectives and skills. - Training and Development – Tuition reimbursement and professional trainings for eligible employees.

- Paid Time Off – Provides flexible work hours, paid time off, and 11 federal holidays.

_**About Us:**_

Red Carrot is an award-winning, woman-owned small business built for the complexity of federal government work. We partner with clients to advance their goals — powered by a team fueled by passion, backed by intelligence, and grounded in expertise.

From day one, we've applied industrial engineering principles and data analytics to solve complex problems with precision. Our approach is research-centric, data-informed, and audience-oriented — and it's how we deliver work that actually moves the needle.

We exist to strengthen the organizations and communities we serve through trusted, purposeful communication. That's not a tagline — it's the standard we hold ourselves to on every engagement.

Headquartered in Miami, Florida, with a strong and growing presence in Washington, D.C., our team works with clients across the country. Distance doesn't dilute our service. We build capacity where our clients need it, delivering Strategic Communications, Customer Experience, Management Consulting, and Human Capital Solutions that fit their mission — and their moment.

We're the partner organizations turn to when communication challenges are real, the stakes are high, and the work has to matter.

	<li><span style="font-size:12px">Training and Development – Tuition reimbursement and professional trainings for eligible employees. </span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12px">Healthcare – Top-tier medical, dental, vision, life insurance and long-term disability coverage.      </span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12px">401(k) Plan – 401(k)-retirement and Roth plan with company matching and no vesting period.      </span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12px">Profit Sharing – Discretionary profit-sharing plan to all eligible employees after one year of employment.           </span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12px">Paid Time Off – Provides flexible work hours, paid time off, and 11 federal holidays.   </span></li>
</ul>

<p><span style="font-size:12px"><em><span style="font-family:arial,helvetica,sans-serif"><strong>About Us:</strong></span></em></span></p>

<p>Red Carrot is an award-winning, woman-owned small business built for the complexity of federal government work. We partner with clients to advance their goals — powered by a team fueled by passion, backed by intelligence, and grounded in expertise.</p>

<p>From day one, we've applied industrial engineering principles and data analytics to solve complex problems with precision. Our approach is research-centric, data-informed, and audience-oriented — and it's how we deliver work that actually moves the needle.</p>

<p>We exist to strengthen the organizations and communities we serve through trusted, purposeful communication. That's not a tagline — it's the standard we hold ourselves to on every engagement.</p>

<p>Headquartered in Miami, Florida, with a strong and growing presence in Washington, D.C., our team works with clients across the country. Distance doesn't dilute our service. We build capacity where our clients need it, delivering Strategic Communications, Customer Experience, Management Consulting, and Human Capital Solutions that fit their mission — and their moment.</p>

<p>We're the partner organizations turn to when communication challenges are real, the stakes are high, and the work has to matter.</p>
