                                <div class="text-center"><strong>Voluntary Self-Identification of Disability</strong></div>
                                <div class="text-right" style="margin: 10px 0 10px 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15.6px;">
                                    Voluntary Self-Identification of Disability Form CC-305<br>
                                    OMB Control Number 1250-0005<br>
                                    Expires 07/31/2029
                                </div>
                                <div id="disability-content">
                                    <div class="box-message" style="text-align:center;">Why are you being asked to complete this form?</div>
                                    <div class="resumator-input">
                                        <p>We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified
                                            people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we
                                            must measure our progress towards this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability
                                            or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.</p>

                                        <p>Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who
                                            makes hiring decisions will see it. Your decision to complete the form and your answer will not harm you in any way. If you
                                            want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance
                                            Programs (OFCCP) website at <a href="https://www.dol.gov/ofccp" target="_blank">www.dol.gov/ofccp</a>.</p>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="centered-message box-message">
                                        <div class="resumator-label" style="text-align:center;">How do you know if you have a disability?</div>
                                    </div>

                                    <div class="resumator-input">
                                        <p>A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had
                                            such a condition, you are a person with a disability. <strong>Disabilities include, but are not limited to:</strong></p>
                                        <ul id="disabilities-list">
                                            <li>Alcohol or other substance use
                                                disorder (not currently using
                                                drugs illegally)</li>
                                            <li>Autoimmune disorder, for
                                                example, lupus, fibromyalgia,
                                                rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS</li>
                                            <li>Blind or low vision</li>
                                            <li>Cancer (past or present)</li>
                                            <li>Cardiovascular or heart
                                                disease</li>
                                            <li>Celiac disease</li>
                                            <li>Cerebral palsy</li>
                                            <li>Deaf or serious difficulty
                                                hearing</li>
                                            <li>Diabetes</li>
                                            <li>Disfigurement, for example,
                                                disfigurement caused by burns,
                                                wounds, accidents, or congenital
                                                disorders</li>
                                            <li>Epilepsy or other seizure disorder</li>
                                            <li>Gastrointestinal disorders, for example,
                                                Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel
                                                syndrome</li>
                                            <li>Intellectual or developmental disability</li>
                                            <li>Mental health conditions, for example,
                                                depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety
                                                disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD</li>
                                            <li>Missing limbs or partially missing limbs</li>
                                            <li>Mobility impairment, benefiting from the
                                                use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker,
                                                leg brace(s) and/or other supports</li>
                                            <li>Nervous system condition, for example,
                                                migraine headaches, Parkinson’s
                                                disease, multiple sclerosis (MS)</li>
                                            <li>Neurodivergence, for example,
                                                attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder
                                                (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder,
                                                dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning
                                                disabilities</li>
                                            <li>Partial or complete paralysis (any
                                                cause)</li>
                                            <li>Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for
                                                example, tuberculosis, asthma,
                                                emphysema</li>
                                            <li>Short stature (dwarfism)</li>
                                            <li>Traumatic brain injury</li>
                                        </ul>
                                    </div>

raw.description:
[Skip To Job Description](https://marketbridge.applytojob.com/apply/TORPvd4IsL/Director-Marketing-Analytics#job-description)

## Thank you for your interest in a career at Marketbridge. Please review our open positions and apply to the one that matches your qualifications.

## Director, Marketing Analytics

Remote

Full Time

Agency Services North America

Senior Manager/Supervisor

[Share](https://marketbridge.applytojob.com/app/share/TORPvd4IsL)

**This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours.**

Job Description

Job Title: Director, Marketing Analytics

Level: 6 (Director)

Dept: Agency, Marketing Technology & Operations

Location: Canada

Base Salary Range: CAD $115k – $130k,

Bonus (if applicable): 0-10% based on EBITDA and personal performance

Who We Are

Marketbridge partners with leading B2B brands to create unified Go-to-Market® systems that connect strategy, AI, creativity, activation and measurement. With a team of 350+ across North America and Europe, Marketbridge supports clients worldwide, ranging from Fortune 1000 enterprises to venture-backed, high-growth companies across technology, financial services, healthcare, industrial and consumer sectors. For more information, please visit [www.marketbridge.com](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmarketbridge.com%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cmjayatillake%40marketbridge.com%7C3f86758322fc43272bb508de965db3bc%7C2f0f75c5488d4df5b20e251bac7750fe%7C0%7C0%7C639113526362295137%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=JQD%2BhgnOX2B2lhYwK4P%2B62OXHQzvwtmFDXSyinzzY30%3D&reserved=0) and follow [www.linkedin.com/company/marketbridge/](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fmarketbridge%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cmjayatillake%40marketbridge.com%7C3f86758322fc43272bb508de965db3bc%7C2f0f75c5488d4df5b20e251bac7750fe%7C0%7C0%7C639113526362341818%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Xl4ZQw2EPy9rwoYJJyeKqWCif%2BpIUSqtSI7c7ftJa48%3D&reserved=0).

Who We're Looking For

Marketbridge is seeking a Director, Marketing Analytics to advance the measurement, reporting, and analytics capabilities that support modern B2B marketing programs.

This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, media, digital analytics, marketing technology & operations, reporting, and measurement. The Director will help clients and internal teams establish the data and measurement foundations needed to understand marketing performance, identify meaningful trends and anomalies, and quickly surface areas that warrant deeper investigation.

The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in B2B performance marketing, web analytics, tag management, reporting, and measurement with a practical understanding of how marketing data is captured and moves across media, web, marketing automation, CRM, ABM, and business intelligence platforms and environments.

This role is not responsible for owning the client performance narrative or determining the strategic “so what” from the data. Instead, Marketing Analytics provides the reliable reporting, analytical evidence, trend identification, and investigative support that enables strategy, media, creative and account management teams assess and explain performance, identify contributing factors, and recommend what to do next.

Success in this role requires strong analytical judgment, technical fluency, curiosity, collaborative problem-solving, and a demonstrated ability to use AI and automation to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of analytics work.

Key Responsibilities

- Serve as the Analytics partner to Strategy in the development of measurement approaches and KPI frameworks, providing guidance on data availability, technical feasibility, tracking requirements, and alternative KPIs where appropriate, then translating the agreed framework into actionable reporting, measurement, and technical requirements


- Support B2B marketing performance analysis across paid media, web, CRM, marketing automation, email, and other ABM and demand-generation channels, ensuring teams have accurate and consistent views of campaign and funnel performance.


- Surface meaningful trends, anomalies, correlations, and areas for deeper investigation across marketing data to accelerate the identification of potential insights and performance questions.


- Partner with Strategy teams to support performance storytelling by providing accurate reporting, analytical evidence, trend identification, hypothesis validation, and targeted analysis, while Strategy retains ownership of the client-facing performance narrative and optimization recommendations.


- Define and oversee web analytics tracking requirements, including event and conversion tracking, tagging plans, data layer requirements, taxonomy standards, consent considerations, implementation QA, troubleshooting, and ongoing measurement governance.


- Provide expertise across web analytics and tag management platforms, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, Adobe Analytics, and related digital measurement technologies.


- Guide reporting and dashboard solutions that bring together data from marketing, media, CRM, web, ABM, and other sources in a way that is accurate, scalable, and useful to internal and external stakeholders.


- Partner with Marketing Technology & Operations, and client technical teams to define the data requirements and integrations needed for reporting and analytics, ensuring required data is accessible, reliable, and fit for analytical use.


- Establish and maintain data quality and analytics QA standards that improve the consistency, accuracy, and reliability of reporting and measurement outputs.


- Apply AI-enabled tools and workflows to Marketing Analytics, using AI to improve areas such as data exploration, anomaly detection, reporting, QA, visualization, analytical investigation, documentation, and workflow efficiency.


- Identify, test, and operationalize AI and automation opportunities that improve the speed, consistency, scalability, and quality of analytics delivery while maintaining appropriate human oversight and data governance.


- Collaborate with leaders and subject-matter experts across Marketing Technology & Operations, Strategy, Media, Creative, and other practice areas to design and deliver more robust and scalable analytics and measurement solutions for internal teams and clients.


- Identify recurring analytics challenges and opportunities and bring an innovative, solutions-oriented mindset to improving tools, workflows, reporting approaches, measurement practices, and reusable analytical frameworks.


- Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, helping define measurement requirements, reporting approaches, analytical needs, and opportunities to improve marketing-data visibility.


- Lead discovery and solution-design discussions for analytics and measurement engagements, translating business questions into clear reporting, tracking, and analytical requirements.


- Develop and coach Marketing Analytics talent, providing technical guidance, performance feedback, career development, and support for continued growth in measurement, reporting, digital analytics, AI, and marketing performance analysis.


- Support team resourcing and delivery quality across analytics engagements, helping ensure work is appropriately staffed and delivered against established analytical and technical standards.


- Support new business and organic growth by contributing to analytics discovery, solution design, scoping, estimation, proposals, capabilities presentations, and client conversations.


Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, digital analytics, performance analytics, marketing measurement, business intelligence, marketing operations, or a related discipline, ideally within an agency, consulting, or complex client-service environment.


- Deep understanding of B2B performance marketing and media measurement, with experience analyzing performance across channels such as paid search, paid social, programmatic/display, email, web, and other ABM and demand-generation programs.


- Strong understanding of B2B funnel and performance metrics, including lead generation, conversion rates, MQL/SQL/MQA progression, pipeline contribution, account engagement, CPL/CAC, attribution, and the relationship between media, web, marketing automation, CRM, and revenue data.


- Deep expertise in web analytics and tag management, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Adobe Analytics, with experience assessing measurement frameworks and defining tagging plans, data layer requirements, event taxonomies, conversion tracking, implementation standards, QA processes, and governance.


- Experience working with data from major performance marketing and demand-generation platforms, such as Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta, programmatic/DSP platforms, 6sense, Demandbase, CRM (e.g. Salesforce) systems, and marketing automation platforms (e.g. HubSpot, Marketo).


- Strong experience developing marketing reporting and dashboard solutions using BI and visualization platforms such as Looker, Looker Studio, Tableau, Domo, Power BI or equivalent tools.


- Demonstrated ability to identify trends, anomalies, data-quality issues, and areas for further investigation across complex marketing datasets.


- Demonstrated experience applying AI-enabled tools and workflows to marketing analytics, including use cases such as data exploration, anomaly detection, reporting, QA, visualization, analysis support, or workflow automation.


- Ability to evaluate where AI can materially improve analytical quality, speed, and scalability while applying appropriate judgment, validation, and governance.


- Strong working knowledge of SQL and an understanding of data integration, transformation, and automation concepts sufficient to work effectively with technical teams and interrogate data when needed.


- Familiarity with APIs, ETL/ELT concepts, cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake, and modern data automation approaches is preferred; hands-on data engineering expertise is not required.


- Strong understanding of marketing data quality, governance, tracking, attribution, and cross-platform measurement.


- Ability to translate complex analytical and technical concepts into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.


- Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, with experience working with senior marketing, media, analytics, operations, and technology stakeholders.


- Proven ability to work through ambiguous problems, identify practical solutions, and collaborate across disciplines to improve analytics capabilities and delivery.


- Experience managing and developing analytics talent, including coaching individual contributors and supporting skill development.


- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively with Strategy, Media, Marketing Technology & Operations, Creative, Client Success, and other teams.


- Experience supporting new business, organic growth, or solution-scoping efforts.


Our Culture

Marketbridge supports Fortune 50 companies and global brands in redefining how they go to market.

How we work together matters just as much as the work itself. Our values shape how we operate day to day. Be Kind means treating teammates with respect and showing up for one another. Be Open reflects how we collaborate, share perspectives, and give clear, honest feedback. Be Real speaks to a culture of authenticity, where people can speak up and be themselves. Be Brave pushes us to challenge assumptions, think critically, and pursue ideas that lead to real results.

You’ll join a collaborative team focused on solving real problems for complex clients. From day one, you’ll gain hands-on experience, work closely with supportive leaders, and continue developing through meaningful client work and ongoing learning. We value accountability, curiosity, and ownership, and we trust people to take initiative and follow through.

Here, you’ll do meaningful work, alongside smart people, with room to grow as the business grows.

Benefits & Perks

At Marketbridge, we support our team with benefits that prioritize well-being, flexibility, and growth. Here’s what you can look forward to:

- 🏖️ Time Off & Flexibility – Flexible PTO, summer Fridays, and paid parental leave (up to 16 weeks for birthing parents). Plus, we’re closed from Christmas to New Year’s so you can fully unplug.


- 💙 Health & Wellness – Comprehensive medical benefits and free premium access to the Calm app for relaxation and mindfulness.


- 💰 Financial Security – 401(k) with a 3% company contribution\* (US Only), life insurance, long-term disability, and AD&D coverage for extra peace of mind.


- 📚 Learning & Growth – A professional development fund ($500) and continuous learning programs to invest in your career.


- 💻 Tech & Perks – Company-provided laptop & accessories, monthly Wi-Fi & cell stipend, and exclusive discounts through Perkopolis.


Note: This position requires candidates to be eligible to work in the United States or Canada without visa sponsorship. Marketbridge is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours.

We aim to offer competitive and fair compensation based on experience, location, and market benchmarks. The salary range for this role is $125,000 – $130,000.

Final compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s qualifications, and additional flexibility may be considered for candidates whose experience and expertise significantly exceed the role’s core requirements.

- Guide reporting and dashboard solutions that bring together data from marketing, media, CRM, web, ABM, and other sources in a way that is accurate, scalable, and useful to internal and external stakeholders.


- Partner with Marketing Technology & Operations, and client technical teams to define the data requirements and integrations needed for reporting and analytics, ensuring required data is accessible, reliable, and fit for analytical use.


- Establish and maintain data quality and analytics QA standards that improve the consistency, accuracy, and reliability of reporting and measurement outputs.


- Apply AI-enabled tools and workflows to Marketing Analytics, using AI to improve areas such as data exploration, anomaly detection, reporting, QA, visualization, analytical investigation, documentation, and workflow efficiency.


- Identify, test, and operationalize AI and automation opportunities that improve the speed, consistency, scalability, and quality of analytics delivery while maintaining appropriate human oversight and data governance.


- Collaborate with leaders and subject-matter experts across Marketing Technology & Operations, Strategy, Media, Creative, and other practice areas to design and deliver more robust and scalable analytics and measurement solutions for internal teams and clients.


- Identify recurring analytics challenges and opportunities and bring an innovative, solutions-oriented mindset to improving tools, workflows, reporting approaches, measurement practices, and reusable analytical frameworks.

- Lead discovery and solution-design discussions for analytics and measurement engagements, translating business questions into clear reporting, tracking, and analytical requirements.

- Support team resourcing and delivery quality across analytics engagements, helping ensure work is appropriately staffed and delivered against established analytical and technical standards.


- Support new business and organic growth by contributing to analytics discovery, solution design, scoping, estimation, proposals, capabilities presentations, and client conversations.

## Thank you for your interest in a career at Marketbridge. Please review our open positions and apply to the one that matches your qualifications.

## Director, Marketing Analytics

Remote

Full Time

Agency Services North America

Senior Manager/Supervisor

[Share](https://marketbridge.applytojob.com/app/share/TORPvd4IsL)

**This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours.**

Job Description

Job Title: Director, Marketing Analytics

Level: 6 (Director)

Dept: Agency, Marketing Technology & Operations

Location: Canada

Base Salary Range: CAD $115k – $130k,

Bonus (if applicable): 0-10% based on EBITDA and personal performance

Who We Are

Marketbridge partners with leading B2B brands to create unified Go-to-Market® systems that connect strategy, AI, creativity, activation and measurement. With a team of 350+ across North America and Europe, Marketbridge supports clients worldwide, ranging from Fortune 1000 enterprises to venture-backed, high-growth companies across technology, financial services, healthcare, industrial and consumer sectors. For more information, please visit [www.marketbridge.com](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmarketbridge.com%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cmjayatillake%40marketbridge.com%7C3f86758322fc43272bb508de965db3bc%7C2f0f75c5488d4df5b20e251bac7750fe%7C0%7C0%7C639113526362295137%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=JQD%2BhgnOX2B2lhYwK4P%2B62OXHQzvwtmFDXSyinzzY30%3D&reserved=0) and follow [www.linkedin.com/company/marketbridge/](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fmarketbridge%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cmjayatillake%40marketbridge.com%7C3f86758322fc43272bb508de965db3bc%7C2f0f75c5488d4df5b20e251bac7750fe%7C0%7C0%7C639113526362341818%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Xl4ZQw2EPy9rwoYJJyeKqWCif%2BpIUSqtSI7c7ftJa48%3D&reserved=0).

Who We're Looking For

Marketbridge is seeking a Director, Marketing Analytics to advance the measurement, reporting, and analytics capabilities that support modern B2B marketing programs.

This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, media, digital analytics, marketing technology & operations, reporting, and measurement. The Director will help clients and internal teams establish the data and measurement foundations needed to understand marketing performance, identify meaningful trends and anomalies, and quickly surface areas that warrant deeper investigation.

The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in B2B performance marketing, web analytics, tag management, reporting, and measurement with a practical understanding of how marketing data is captured and moves across media, web, marketing automation, CRM, ABM, and business intelligence platforms and environments.

This role is not responsible for owning the client performance narrative or determining the strategic “so what” from the data. Instead, Marketing Analytics provides the reliable reporting, analytical evidence, trend identification, and investigative support that enables strategy, media, creative and account management teams assess and explain performance, identify contributing factors, and recommend what to do next.

Success in this role requires strong analytical judgment, technical fluency, curiosity, collaborative problem-solving, and a demonstrated ability to use AI and automation to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of analytics work.

Key Responsibilities

- Serve as the Analytics partner to Strategy in the development of measurement approaches and KPI frameworks, providing guidance on data availability, technical feasibility, tracking requirements, and alternative KPIs where appropriate, then translating the agreed framework into actionable reporting, measurement, and technical requirements


- Support B2B marketing performance analysis across paid media, web, CRM, marketing automation, email, and other ABM and demand-generation channels, ensuring teams have accurate and consistent views of campaign and funnel performance.


- Surface meaningful trends, anomalies, correlations, and areas for deeper investigation across marketing data to accelerate the identification of potential insights and performance questions.


- Partner with Strategy teams to support performance storytelling by providing accurate reporting, analytical evidence, trend identification, hypothesis validation, and targeted analysis, while Strategy retains ownership of the client-facing performance narrative and optimization recommendations.


- Define and oversee web analytics tracking requirements, including event and conversion tracking, tagging plans, data layer requirements, taxonomy standards, consent considerations, implementation QA, troubleshooting, and ongoing measurement governance.


- Provide expertise across web analytics and tag management platforms, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, Adobe Analytics, and related digital measurement technologies.


- Guide reporting and dashboard solutions that bring together data from marketing, media, CRM, web, ABM, and other sources in a way that is accurate, scalable, and useful to internal and external stakeholders.


- Partner with Marketing Technology & Operations, and client technical teams to define the data requirements and integrations needed for reporting and analytics, ensuring required data is accessible, reliable, and fit for analytical use.


- Establish and maintain data quality and analytics QA standards that improve the consistency, accuracy, and reliability of reporting and measurement outputs.


- Apply AI-enabled tools and workflows to Marketing Analytics, using AI to improve areas such as data exploration, anomaly detection, reporting, QA, visualization, analytical investigation, documentation, and workflow efficiency.


- Identify, test, and operationalize AI and automation opportunities that improve the speed, consistency, scalability, and quality of analytics delivery while maintaining appropriate human oversight and data governance.


- Collaborate with leaders and subject-matter experts across Marketing Technology & Operations, Strategy, Media, Creative, and other practice areas to design and deliver more robust and scalable analytics and measurement solutions for internal teams and clients.


- Identify recurring analytics challenges and opportunities and bring an innovative, solutions-oriented mindset to improving tools, workflows, reporting approaches, measurement practices, and reusable analytical frameworks.


- Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, helping define measurement requirements, reporting approaches, analytical needs, and opportunities to improve marketing-data visibility.


- Lead discovery and solution-design discussions for analytics and measurement engagements, translating business questions into clear reporting, tracking, and analytical requirements.


- Develop and coach Marketing Analytics talent, providing technical guidance, performance feedback, career development, and support for continued growth in measurement, reporting, digital analytics, AI, and marketing performance analysis.


- Support team resourcing and delivery quality across analytics engagements, helping ensure work is appropriately staffed and delivered against established analytical and technical standards.


- Support new business and organic growth by contributing to analytics discovery, solution design, scoping, estimation, proposals, capabilities presentations, and client conversations.


Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, digital analytics, performance analytics, marketing measurement, business intelligence, marketing operations, or a related discipline, ideally within an agency, consulting, or complex client-service environment.


- Deep understanding of B2B performance marketing and media measurement, with experience analyzing performance across channels such as paid search, paid social, programmatic/display, email, web, and other ABM and demand-generation programs.


- Strong understanding of B2B funnel and performance metrics, including lead generation, conversion rates, MQL/SQL/MQA progression, pipeline contribution, account engagement, CPL/CAC, attribution, and the relationship between media, web, marketing automation, CRM, and revenue data.


- Deep expertise in web analytics and tag management, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Adobe Analytics, with experience assessing measurement frameworks and defining tagging plans, data layer requirements, event taxonomies, conversion tracking, implementation standards, QA processes, and governance.


- Experience working with data from major performance marketing and demand-generation platforms, such as Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta, programmatic/DSP platforms, 6sense, Demandbase, CRM (e.g. Salesforce) systems, and marketing automation platforms (e.g. HubSpot, Marketo).


- Strong experience developing marketing reporting and dashboard solutions using BI and visualization platforms such as Looker, Looker Studio, Tableau, Domo, Power BI or equivalent tools.


- Demonstrated ability to identify trends, anomalies, data-quality issues, and areas for further investigation across complex marketing datasets.


- Demonstrated experience applying AI-enabled tools and workflows to marketing analytics, including use cases such as data exploration, anomaly detection, reporting, QA, visualization, analysis support, or workflow automation.


- Ability to evaluate where AI can materially improve analytical quality, speed, and scalability while applying appropriate judgment, validation, and governance.


- Strong working knowledge of SQL and an understanding of data integration, transformation, and automation concepts sufficient to work effectively with technical teams and interrogate data when needed.


- Familiarity with APIs, ETL/ELT concepts, cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake, and modern data automation approaches is preferred; hands-on data engineering expertise is not required.


- Strong understanding of marketing data quality, governance, tracking, attribution, and cross-platform measurement.


- Ability to translate complex analytical and technical concepts into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.


- Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, with experience working with senior marketing, media, analytics, operations, and technology stakeholders.


- Proven ability to work through ambiguous problems, identify practical solutions, and collaborate across disciplines to improve analytics capabilities and delivery.


- Experience managing and developing analytics talent, including coaching individual contributors and supporting skill development.


- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively with Strategy, Media, Marketing Technology & Operations, Creative, Client Success, and other teams.


- Experience supporting new business, organic growth, or solution-scoping efforts.


Our Culture

Marketbridge supports Fortune 50 companies and global brands in redefining how they go to market.

How we work together matters just as much as the work itself. Our values shape how we operate day to day. Be Kind means treating teammates with respect and showing up for one another. Be Open reflects how we collaborate, share perspectives, and give clear, honest feedback. Be Real speaks to a culture of authenticity, where people can speak up and be themselves. Be Brave pushes us to challenge assumptions, think critically, and pursue ideas that lead to real results.

You’ll join a collaborative team focused on solving real problems for complex clients. From day one, you’ll gain hands-on experience, work closely with supportive leaders, and continue developing through meaningful client work and ongoing learning. We value accountability, curiosity, and ownership, and we trust people to take initiative and follow through.

Here, you’ll do meaningful work, alongside smart people, with room to grow as the business grows.

Benefits & Perks

At Marketbridge, we support our team with benefits that prioritize well-being, flexibility, and growth. Here’s what you can look forward to:

- 🏖️ Time Off & Flexibility – Flexible PTO, summer Fridays, and paid parental leave (up to 16 weeks for birthing parents). Plus, we’re closed from Christmas to New Year’s so you can fully unplug.


- 💙 Health & Wellness – Comprehensive medical benefits and free premium access to the Calm app for relaxation and mindfulness.


- 💰 Financial Security – 401(k) with a 3% company contribution\* (US Only), life insurance, long-term disability, and AD&D coverage for extra peace of mind.


- 📚 Learning & Growth – A professional development fund ($500) and continuous learning programs to invest in your career.


- 💻 Tech & Perks – Company-provided laptop & accessories, monthly Wi-Fi & cell stipend, and exclusive discounts through Perkopolis.


Note: This position requires candidates to be eligible to work in the United States or Canada without visa sponsorship. Marketbridge is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours.

We aim to offer competitive and fair compensation based on experience, location, and market benchmarks. The salary range for this role is $125,000 – $130,000.

Final compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s qualifications, and additional flexibility may be considered for candidates whose experience and expertise significantly exceed the role’s core requirements.

    "title": "Director, Marketing Analytics",
    "description": "<p><strong>This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours. <\/strong><\/p><br><p>Job Description <\/p><p>Job Title: Director, Marketing Analytics <br>Level: 6 (Director) <br>Dept: Agency, Marketing Technology & Operations <br>Location: Canada  <br>Base Salary Range: CAD $115k – $130k,  <br>Bonus (if applicable): 0-10% based on EBITDA and personal performance <br> <br> <br>Who We Are  <\/p><p>Marketbridge partners with leading B2B brands to create unified Go-to-Market® systems that connect strategy, AI, creativity, activation and measurement. With a team of 350+ across North America and Europe, Marketbridge supports clients worldwide, ranging from Fortune 1000 enterprises to venture-backed, high-growth companies across technology, financial services, healthcare, industrial and consumer sectors. For more information, please visit <a href=\"https:\/\/nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com\/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmarketbridge.com%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cmjayatillake%40marketbridge.com%7C3f86758322fc43272bb508de965db3bc%7C2f0f75c5488d4df5b20e251bac7750fe%7C0%7C0%7C639113526362295137%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=JQD%2BhgnOX2B2lhYwK4P%2B62OXHQzvwtmFDXSyinzzY30%3D&reserved=0\" target=\"_blank\">www.marketbridge.com<\/a> and follow <a href=\"https:\/\/nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com\/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fmarketbridge%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cmjayatillake%40marketbridge.com%7C3f86758322fc43272bb508de965db3bc%7C2f0f75c5488d4df5b20e251bac7750fe%7C0%7C0%7C639113526362341818%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Xl4ZQw2EPy9rwoYJJyeKqWCif%2BpIUSqtSI7c7ftJa48%3D&reserved=0\" target=\"_blank\">www.linkedin.com\/company\/marketbridge\/<\/a>. <\/p><p>  <br>Who We're Looking For <\/p><p>Marketbridge is seeking a Director, Marketing Analytics to advance the measurement, reporting, and analytics capabilities that support modern B2B marketing programs. <\/p><p>This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, media, digital analytics, marketing technology & operations, reporting, and measurement. The Director will help clients and internal teams establish the data and measurement foundations needed to understand marketing performance, identify meaningful trends and anomalies, and quickly surface areas that warrant deeper investigation. <\/p><p>The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in B2B performance marketing, web analytics, tag management, reporting, and measurement with a practical understanding of how marketing data is captured and moves across media, web, marketing automation, CRM, ABM, and business intelligence platforms and environments. <\/p><p>This role is not responsible for owning the client performance narrative or determining the strategic “so what” from the data. Instead, Marketing Analytics provides the reliable reporting, analytical evidence, trend identification, and investigative support that enables strategy, media, creative and account management teams assess and explain performance, identify contributing factors, and recommend what to do next. <\/p><p>Success in this role requires strong analytical judgment, technical fluency, curiosity, collaborative problem-solving, and a demonstrated ability to use AI and automation to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of analytics work. <\/p><p><\/p><p>Key Responsibilities <\/p><ul><li><p>Serve as the Analytics partner to Strategy in the development of measurement approaches and KPI frameworks, providing guidance on data availability, technical feasibility, tracking requirements, and alternative KPIs where appropriate, then translating the agreed framework into actionable reporting, measurement, and technical requirements <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Support B2B marketing performance analysis across paid media, web, CRM, marketing automation, email, and other ABM and demand-generation channels, ensuring teams have accurate and consistent views of campaign and funnel performance. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Surface meaningful trends, anomalies, correlations, and areas for deeper investigation across marketing data to accelerate the identification of potential insights and performance questions. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Partner with Strategy teams to support performance storytelling by providing accurate reporting, analytical evidence, trend identification, hypothesis validation, and targeted analysis, while Strategy retains ownership of the client-facing performance narrative and optimization recommendations. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Define and oversee web analytics tracking requirements, including event and conversion tracking, tagging plans, data layer requirements, taxonomy standards, consent considerations, implementation QA, troubleshooting, and ongoing measurement governance. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Provide expertise across web analytics and tag management platforms, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, Adobe Analytics, and related digital measurement technologies. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Guide reporting and dashboard solutions that bring together data from marketing, media, CRM, web, ABM, and other sources in a way that is accurate, scalable, and useful to internal and external stakeholders. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Partner with Marketing Technology & Operations, and client technical teams to define the data requirements and integrations needed for reporting and analytics, ensuring required data is accessible, reliable, and fit for analytical use. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Establish and maintain data quality and analytics QA standards that improve the consistency, accuracy, and reliability of reporting and measurement outputs. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Apply AI-enabled tools and workflows to Marketing Analytics, using AI to improve areas such as data exploration, anomaly detection, reporting, QA, visualization, analytical investigation, documentation, and workflow efficiency. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Identify, test, and operationalize AI and automation opportunities that improve the speed, consistency, scalability, and quality of analytics delivery while maintaining appropriate human oversight and data governance. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Collaborate with leaders and subject-matter experts across Marketing Technology & Operations, Strategy, Media, Creative, and other practice areas to design and deliver more robust and scalable analytics and measurement solutions for internal teams and clients. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Identify recurring analytics challenges and opportunities and bring an innovative, solutions-oriented mindset to improving tools, workflows, reporting approaches, measurement practices, and reusable analytical frameworks. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, helping define measurement requirements, reporting approaches, analytical needs, and opportunities to improve marketing-data visibility. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Lead discovery and solution-design discussions for analytics and measurement engagements, translating business questions into clear reporting, tracking, and analytical requirements. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Develop and coach Marketing Analytics talent, providing technical guidance, performance feedback, career development, and support for continued growth in measurement, reporting, digital analytics, AI, and marketing performance analysis. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Support team resourcing and delivery quality across analytics engagements, helping ensure work is appropriately staffed and delivered against established analytical and technical standards. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Support new business and organic growth by contributing to analytics discovery, solution design, scoping, estimation, proposals, capabilities presentations, and client conversations. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><p><\/p><p><\/p><p>Qualifications <\/p><ul><li><p>8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, digital analytics, performance analytics, marketing measurement, business intelligence, marketing operations, or a related discipline, ideally within an agency, consulting, or complex client-service environment. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Deep understanding of B2B performance marketing and media measurement, with experience analyzing performance across channels such as paid search, paid social, programmatic\/display, email, web, and other ABM and demand-generation programs. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Strong understanding of B2B funnel and performance metrics, including lead generation, conversion rates, MQL\/SQL\/MQA progression, pipeline contribution, account engagement, CPL\/CAC, attribution, and the relationship between media, web, marketing automation, CRM, and revenue data. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Deep expertise in web analytics and tag management, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Adobe Analytics, with experience assessing measurement frameworks and defining tagging plans, data layer requirements, event taxonomies, conversion tracking, implementation standards, QA processes, and governance. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Experience working with data from major performance marketing and demand-generation platforms, such as Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta, programmatic\/DSP platforms, 6sense, Demandbase, CRM (e.g. Salesforce) systems, and marketing automation platforms (e.g. HubSpot, Marketo). <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Strong experience developing marketing reporting and dashboard solutions using BI and visualization platforms such as Looker, Looker Studio, Tableau, Domo, Power BI or equivalent tools. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Demonstrated ability to identify trends, anomalies, data-quality issues, and areas for further investigation across complex marketing datasets. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Demonstrated experience applying AI-enabled tools and workflows to marketing analytics, including use cases such as data exploration, anomaly detection, reporting, QA, visualization, analysis support, or workflow automation. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Ability to evaluate where AI can materially improve analytical quality, speed, and scalability while applying appropriate judgment, validation, and governance. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Strong working knowledge of SQL and an understanding of data integration, transformation, and automation concepts sufficient to work effectively with technical teams and interrogate data when needed. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Familiarity with APIs, ETL\/ELT concepts, cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake, and modern data automation approaches is preferred; hands-on data engineering expertise is not required. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Strong understanding of marketing data quality, governance, tracking, attribution, and cross-platform measurement. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Ability to translate complex analytical and technical concepts into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, with experience working with senior marketing, media, analytics, operations, and technology stakeholders. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Proven ability to work through ambiguous problems, identify practical solutions, and collaborate across disciplines to improve analytics capabilities and delivery. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Experience managing and developing analytics talent, including coaching individual contributors and supporting skill development. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively with Strategy, Media, Marketing Technology & Operations, Creative, Client Success, and other teams. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>Experience supporting new business, organic growth, or solution-scoping efforts. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><p>Our Culture <\/p><p>Marketbridge supports Fortune 50 companies and global brands in redefining how they go to market.  <\/p><p><\/p><p>How we work together matters just as much as the work itself. Our values shape how we operate day to day. Be Kind means treating teammates with respect and showing up for one another. Be Open reflects how we collaborate, share perspectives, and give clear, honest feedback. Be Real speaks to a culture of authenticity, where people can speak up and be themselves. Be Brave pushes us to challenge assumptions, think critically, and pursue ideas that lead to real results.  <\/p><p>You’ll join a collaborative team focused on solving real problems for complex clients. From day one, you’ll gain hands-on experience, work closely with supportive leaders, and continue developing through meaningful client work and ongoing learning. We value accountability, curiosity, and ownership, and we trust people to take initiative and follow through. <\/p><p><\/p><p>Here, you’ll do meaningful work, alongside smart people, with room to grow as the business grows. <\/p><p><\/p><p>Benefits & Perks <\/p><p>At Marketbridge, we support our team with benefits that prioritize well-being, flexibility, and growth. Here’s what you can look forward to: <\/p><ul><li><p>🏖️ Time Off & Flexibility – Flexible PTO, summer Fridays, and paid parental leave (up to 16 weeks for birthing parents). Plus, we’re closed from Christmas to New Year’s so you can fully unplug. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>💙 Health & Wellness – Comprehensive medical benefits and free premium access to the Calm app for relaxation and mindfulness. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>💰 Financial Security – 401(k) with a 3% company contribution* (US Only), life insurance, long-term disability, and AD&D coverage for extra peace of mind. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>📚 Learning & Growth – A professional development fund ($500) and continuous learning programs to invest in your career. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><ul><li><p>💻 Tech & Perks – Company-provided laptop & accessories, monthly Wi-Fi & cell stipend, and exclusive discounts through Perkopolis. <br> <\/p><\/li><\/ul><p>Note: This position requires candidates to be eligible to work in the United States or Canada without visa sponsorship. Marketbridge is an Equal Opportunity Employer. <br> <br>This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours. <\/p><p><\/p><p>We aim to offer competitive and fair compensation based on experience, location, and market benchmarks. The salary range for this role is $125,000 – $130,000. <br> <br>Final compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s qualifications, and additional flexibility may be considered for candidates whose experience and expertise significantly exceed the role’s core requirements. <\/p><p lang=\"en-us\"><\/p>",

                    <p><strong>This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours. </strong></p><br><p>Job Description </p><p>Job Title: Director, Marketing Analytics <br>Level: 6 (Director) <br>Dept: Agency, Marketing Technology & Operations <br>Location: Canada  <br>Base Salary Range: CAD $115k – $130k,  <br>Bonus (if applicable): 0-10% based on EBITDA and personal performance <br> <br> <br>Who We Are  </p><p>Marketbridge partners with leading B2B brands to create unified Go-to-Market® systems that connect strategy, AI, creativity, activation and measurement. With a team of 350+ across North America and Europe, Marketbridge supports clients worldwide, ranging from Fortune 1000 enterprises to venture-backed, high-growth companies across technology, financial services, healthcare, industrial and consumer sectors. For more information, please visit <a href="https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmarketbridge.com%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cmjayatillake%40marketbridge.com%7C3f86758322fc43272bb508de965db3bc%7C2f0f75c5488d4df5b20e251bac7750fe%7C0%7C0%7C639113526362295137%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=JQD%2BhgnOX2B2lhYwK4P%2B62OXHQzvwtmFDXSyinzzY30%3D&reserved=0" target="_blank">www.marketbridge.com</a> and follow <a href="https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fmarketbridge%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cmjayatillake%40marketbridge.com%7C3f86758322fc43272bb508de965db3bc%7C2f0f75c5488d4df5b20e251bac7750fe%7C0%7C0%7C639113526362341818%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Xl4ZQw2EPy9rwoYJJyeKqWCif%2BpIUSqtSI7c7ftJa48%3D&reserved=0" target="_blank">www.linkedin.com/company/marketbridge/</a>. </p><p>  <br>Who We're Looking For </p><p>Marketbridge is seeking a Director, Marketing Analytics to advance the measurement, reporting, and analytics capabilities that support modern B2B marketing programs. </p><p>This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, media, digital analytics, marketing technology & operations, reporting, and measurement. The Director will help clients and internal teams establish the data and measurement foundations needed to understand marketing performance, identify meaningful trends and anomalies, and quickly surface areas that warrant deeper investigation. </p><p>The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in B2B performance marketing, web analytics, tag management, reporting, and measurement with a practical understanding of how marketing data is captured and moves across media, web, marketing automation, CRM, ABM, and business intelligence platforms and environments. </p><p>This role is not responsible for owning the client performance narrative or determining the strategic “so what” from the data. Instead, Marketing Analytics provides the reliable reporting, analytical evidence, trend identification, and investigative support that enables strategy, media, creative and account management teams assess and explain performance, identify contributing factors, and recommend what to do next. </p><p>Success in this role requires strong analytical judgment, technical fluency, curiosity, collaborative problem-solving, and a demonstrated ability to use AI and automation to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of analytics work. </p><p></p><p>Key Responsibilities </p><ul><li><p>Serve as the Analytics partner to Strategy in the development of measurement approaches and KPI frameworks, providing guidance on data availability, technical feasibility, tracking requirements, and alternative KPIs where appropriate, then translating the agreed framework into actionable reporting, measurement, and technical requirements </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Support B2B marketing performance analysis across paid media, web, CRM, marketing automation, email, and other ABM and demand-generation channels, ensuring teams have accurate and consistent views of campaign and funnel performance. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Surface meaningful trends, anomalies, correlations, and areas for deeper investigation across marketing data to accelerate the identification of potential insights and performance questions. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Partner with Strategy teams to support performance storytelling by providing accurate reporting, analytical evidence, trend identification, hypothesis validation, and targeted analysis, while Strategy retains ownership of the client-facing performance narrative and optimization recommendations. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Define and oversee web analytics tracking requirements, including event and conversion tracking, tagging plans, data layer requirements, taxonomy standards, consent considerations, implementation QA, troubleshooting, and ongoing measurement governance. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Provide expertise across web analytics and tag management platforms, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, Adobe Analytics, and related digital measurement technologies. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Guide reporting and dashboard solutions that bring together data from marketing, media, CRM, web, ABM, and other sources in a way that is accurate, scalable, and useful to internal and external stakeholders. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Partner with Marketing Technology & Operations, and client technical teams to define the data requirements and integrations needed for reporting and analytics, ensuring required data is accessible, reliable, and fit for analytical use. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Establish and maintain data quality and analytics QA standards that improve the consistency, accuracy, and reliability of reporting and measurement outputs. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Apply AI-enabled tools and workflows to Marketing Analytics, using AI to improve areas such as data exploration, anomaly detection, reporting, QA, visualization, analytical investigation, documentation, and workflow efficiency. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Identify, test, and operationalize AI and automation opportunities that improve the speed, consistency, scalability, and quality of analytics delivery while maintaining appropriate human oversight and data governance. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Collaborate with leaders and subject-matter experts across Marketing Technology & Operations, Strategy, Media, Creative, and other practice areas to design and deliver more robust and scalable analytics and measurement solutions for internal teams and clients. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Identify recurring analytics challenges and opportunities and bring an innovative, solutions-oriented mindset to improving tools, workflows, reporting approaches, measurement practices, and reusable analytical frameworks. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, helping define measurement requirements, reporting approaches, analytical needs, and opportunities to improve marketing-data visibility. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Lead discovery and solution-design discussions for analytics and measurement engagements, translating business questions into clear reporting, tracking, and analytical requirements. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Develop and coach Marketing Analytics talent, providing technical guidance, performance feedback, career development, and support for continued growth in measurement, reporting, digital analytics, AI, and marketing performance analysis. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Support team resourcing and delivery quality across analytics engagements, helping ensure work is appropriately staffed and delivered against established analytical and technical standards. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Support new business and organic growth by contributing to analytics discovery, solution design, scoping, estimation, proposals, capabilities presentations, and client conversations. </p></li></ul><p></p><p></p><p>Qualifications </p><ul><li><p>8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, digital analytics, performance analytics, marketing measurement, business intelligence, marketing operations, or a related discipline, ideally within an agency, consulting, or complex client-service environment. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Deep understanding of B2B performance marketing and media measurement, with experience analyzing performance across channels such as paid search, paid social, programmatic/display, email, web, and other ABM and demand-generation programs. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Strong understanding of B2B funnel and performance metrics, including lead generation, conversion rates, MQL/SQL/MQA progression, pipeline contribution, account engagement, CPL/CAC, attribution, and the relationship between media, web, marketing automation, CRM, and revenue data. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Deep expertise in web analytics and tag management, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Adobe Analytics, with experience assessing measurement frameworks and defining tagging plans, data layer requirements, event taxonomies, conversion tracking, implementation standards, QA processes, and governance. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Experience working with data from major performance marketing and demand-generation platforms, such as Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta, programmatic/DSP platforms, 6sense, Demandbase, CRM (e.g. Salesforce) systems, and marketing automation platforms (e.g. HubSpot, Marketo). </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Strong experience developing marketing reporting and dashboard solutions using BI and visualization platforms such as Looker, Looker Studio, Tableau, Domo, Power BI or equivalent tools. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Demonstrated ability to identify trends, anomalies, data-quality issues, and areas for further investigation across complex marketing datasets. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Demonstrated experience applying AI-enabled tools and workflows to marketing analytics, including use cases such as data exploration, anomaly detection, reporting, QA, visualization, analysis support, or workflow automation. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Ability to evaluate where AI can materially improve analytical quality, speed, and scalability while applying appropriate judgment, validation, and governance. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Strong working knowledge of SQL and an understanding of data integration, transformation, and automation concepts sufficient to work effectively with technical teams and interrogate data when needed. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Familiarity with APIs, ETL/ELT concepts, cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake, and modern data automation approaches is preferred; hands-on data engineering expertise is not required. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Strong understanding of marketing data quality, governance, tracking, attribution, and cross-platform measurement. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Ability to translate complex analytical and technical concepts into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, with experience working with senior marketing, media, analytics, operations, and technology stakeholders. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Proven ability to work through ambiguous problems, identify practical solutions, and collaborate across disciplines to improve analytics capabilities and delivery. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Experience managing and developing analytics talent, including coaching individual contributors and supporting skill development. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively with Strategy, Media, Marketing Technology & Operations, Creative, Client Success, and other teams. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Experience supporting new business, organic growth, or solution-scoping efforts. </p></li></ul><p>Our Culture </p><p>Marketbridge supports Fortune 50 companies and global brands in redefining how they go to market.  </p><p></p><p>How we work together matters just as much as the work itself. Our values shape how we operate day to day. Be Kind means treating teammates with respect and showing up for one another. Be Open reflects how we collaborate, share perspectives, and give clear, honest feedback. Be Real speaks to a culture of authenticity, where people can speak up and be themselves. Be Brave pushes us to challenge assumptions, think critically, and pursue ideas that lead to real results.  </p><p>You’ll join a collaborative team focused on solving real problems for complex clients. From day one, you’ll gain hands-on experience, work closely with supportive leaders, and continue developing through meaningful client work and ongoing learning. We value accountability, curiosity, and ownership, and we trust people to take initiative and follow through. </p><p></p><p>Here, you’ll do meaningful work, alongside smart people, with room to grow as the business grows. </p><p></p><p>Benefits & Perks </p><p>At Marketbridge, we support our team with benefits that prioritize well-being, flexibility, and growth. Here’s what you can look forward to: </p><ul><li><p>🏖️ Time Off & Flexibility – Flexible PTO, summer Fridays, and paid parental leave (up to 16 weeks for birthing parents). Plus, we’re closed from Christmas to New Year’s so you can fully unplug. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>💙 Health & Wellness – Comprehensive medical benefits and free premium access to the Calm app for relaxation and mindfulness. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>💰 Financial Security – 401(k) with a 3% company contribution* (US Only), life insurance, long-term disability, and AD&D coverage for extra peace of mind. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>📚 Learning & Growth – A professional development fund ($500) and continuous learning programs to invest in your career. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>💻 Tech & Perks – Company-provided laptop & accessories, monthly Wi-Fi & cell stipend, and exclusive discounts through Perkopolis. <br> </p></li></ul><p>Note: This position requires candidates to be eligible to work in the United States or Canada without visa sponsorship. Marketbridge is an Equal Opportunity Employer. <br> <br>This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours. </p><p></p><p>We aim to offer competitive and fair compensation based on experience, location, and market benchmarks. The salary range for this role is $125,000 – $130,000. <br> <br>Final compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s qualifications, and additional flexibility may be considered for candidates whose experience and expertise significantly exceed the role’s core requirements. </p><p lang="en-us"></p>                </div>
