## Thank you for your interest in a career at Marketbridge. Please review our open positions and apply to the one that matches your qualifications.

## Director, Marketing Analytics

Remote

Full Time

Agency Services North America

Senior Manager/Supervisor

[Share](https://marketbridge.applytojob.com/app/share/TORPvd4IsL)

**This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours.**

Job Description

Job Title: Director, Marketing Analytics

Level: 6 (Director)

Dept: Agency, Marketing Technology & Operations

Location: Canada

Base Salary Range: CAD $115k – $130k,

Bonus (if applicable): 0-10% based on EBITDA and personal performance

Who We Are

Marketbridge partners with leading B2B brands to create unified Go-to-Market® systems that connect strategy, AI, creativity, activation and measurement. With a team of 350+ across North America and Europe, Marketbridge supports clients worldwide, ranging from Fortune 1000 enterprises to venture-backed, high-growth companies across technology, financial services, healthcare, industrial and consumer sectors. For more information, please visit [www.marketbridge.com](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmarketbridge.com%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cmjayatillake%40marketbridge.com%7C3f86758322fc43272bb508de965db3bc%7C2f0f75c5488d4df5b20e251bac7750fe%7C0%7C0%7C639113526362295137%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=JQD%2BhgnOX2B2lhYwK4P%2B62OXHQzvwtmFDXSyinzzY30%3D&reserved=0) and follow [www.linkedin.com/company/marketbridge/](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fmarketbridge%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cmjayatillake%40marketbridge.com%7C3f86758322fc43272bb508de965db3bc%7C2f0f75c5488d4df5b20e251bac7750fe%7C0%7C0%7C639113526362341818%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Xl4ZQw2EPy9rwoYJJyeKqWCif%2BpIUSqtSI7c7ftJa48%3D&reserved=0).

Who We're Looking For

Marketbridge is seeking a Director, Marketing Analytics to advance the measurement, reporting, and analytics capabilities that support modern B2B marketing programs.

This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, media, digital analytics, marketing technology & operations, reporting, and measurement. The Director will help clients and internal teams establish the data and measurement foundations needed to understand marketing performance, identify meaningful trends and anomalies, and quickly surface areas that warrant deeper investigation.

The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in B2B performance marketing, web analytics, tag management, reporting, and measurement with a practical understanding of how marketing data is captured and moves across media, web, marketing automation, CRM, ABM, and business intelligence platforms and environments.

This role is not responsible for owning the client performance narrative or determining the strategic “so what” from the data. Instead, Marketing Analytics provides the reliable reporting, analytical evidence, trend identification, and investigative support that enables strategy, media, creative and account management teams assess and explain performance, identify contributing factors, and recommend what to do next.

Success in this role requires strong analytical judgment, technical fluency, curiosity, collaborative problem-solving, and a demonstrated ability to use AI and automation to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of analytics work.

Key Responsibilities

- Serve as the Analytics partner to Strategy in the development of measurement approaches and KPI frameworks, providing guidance on data availability, technical feasibility, tracking requirements, and alternative KPIs where appropriate, then translating the agreed framework into actionable reporting, measurement, and technical requirements


- Support B2B marketing performance analysis across paid media, web, CRM, marketing automation, email, and other ABM and demand-generation channels, ensuring teams have accurate and consistent views of campaign and funnel performance.


- Surface meaningful trends, anomalies, correlations, and areas for deeper investigation across marketing data to accelerate the identification of potential insights and performance questions.


- Partner with Strategy teams to support performance storytelling by providing accurate reporting, analytical evidence, trend identification, hypothesis validation, and targeted analysis, while Strategy retains ownership of the client-facing performance narrative and optimization recommendations.


- Define and oversee web analytics tracking requirements, including event and conversion tracking, tagging plans, data layer requirements, taxonomy standards, consent considerations, implementation QA, troubleshooting, and ongoing measurement governance.


- Provide expertise across web analytics and tag management platforms, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, Adobe Analytics, and related digital measurement technologies.


- Guide reporting and dashboard solutions that bring together data from marketing, media, CRM, web, ABM, and other sources in a way that is accurate, scalable, and useful to internal and external stakeholders.


- Partner with Marketing Technology & Operations, and client technical teams to define the data requirements and integrations needed for reporting and analytics, ensuring required data is accessible, reliable, and fit for analytical use.


- Establish and maintain data quality and analytics QA standards that improve the consistency, accuracy, and reliability of reporting and measurement outputs.


- Apply AI-enabled tools and workflows to Marketing Analytics, using AI to improve areas such as data exploration, anomaly detection, reporting, QA, visualization, analytical investigation, documentation, and workflow efficiency.


- Identify, test, and operationalize AI and automation opportunities that improve the speed, consistency, scalability, and quality of analytics delivery while maintaining appropriate human oversight and data governance.


- Collaborate with leaders and subject-matter experts across Marketing Technology & Operations, Strategy, Media, Creative, and other practice areas to design and deliver more robust and scalable analytics and measurement solutions for internal teams and clients.


- Identify recurring analytics challenges and opportunities and bring an innovative, solutions-oriented mindset to improving tools, workflows, reporting approaches, measurement practices, and reusable analytical frameworks.


- Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, helping define measurement requirements, reporting approaches, analytical needs, and opportunities to improve marketing-data visibility.


- Lead discovery and solution-design discussions for analytics and measurement engagements, translating business questions into clear reporting, tracking, and analytical requirements.


- Develop and coach Marketing Analytics talent, providing technical guidance, performance feedback, career development, and support for continued growth in measurement, reporting, digital analytics, AI, and marketing performance analysis.


- Support team resourcing and delivery quality across analytics engagements, helping ensure work is appropriately staffed and delivered against established analytical and technical standards.


- Support new business and organic growth by contributing to analytics discovery, solution design, scoping, estimation, proposals, capabilities presentations, and client conversations.


Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, digital analytics, performance analytics, marketing measurement, business intelligence, marketing operations, or a related discipline, ideally within an agency, consulting, or complex client-service environment.


- Deep understanding of B2B performance marketing and media measurement, with experience analyzing performance across channels such as paid search, paid social, programmatic/display, email, web, and other ABM and demand-generation programs.


- Strong understanding of B2B funnel and performance metrics, including lead generation, conversion rates, MQL/SQL/MQA progression, pipeline contribution, account engagement, CPL/CAC, attribution, and the relationship between media, web, marketing automation, CRM, and revenue data.


- Deep expertise in web analytics and tag management, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Adobe Analytics, with experience assessing measurement frameworks and defining tagging plans, data layer requirements, event taxonomies, conversion tracking, implementation standards, QA processes, and governance.


- Experience working with data from major performance marketing and demand-generation platforms, such as Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta, programmatic/DSP platforms, 6sense, Demandbase, CRM (e.g. Salesforce) systems, and marketing automation platforms (e.g. HubSpot, Marketo).


- Strong experience developing marketing reporting and dashboard solutions using BI and visualization platforms such as Looker, Looker Studio, Tableau, Domo, Power BI or equivalent tools.


- Demonstrated ability to identify trends, anomalies, data-quality issues, and areas for further investigation across complex marketing datasets.


- Demonstrated experience applying AI-enabled tools and workflows to marketing analytics, including use cases such as data exploration, anomaly detection, reporting, QA, visualization, analysis support, or workflow automation.


- Ability to evaluate where AI can materially improve analytical quality, speed, and scalability while applying appropriate judgment, validation, and governance.


- Strong working knowledge of SQL and an understanding of data integration, transformation, and automation concepts sufficient to work effectively with technical teams and interrogate data when needed.


- Familiarity with APIs, ETL/ELT concepts, cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake, and modern data automation approaches is preferred; hands-on data engineering expertise is not required.


- Strong understanding of marketing data quality, governance, tracking, attribution, and cross-platform measurement.


- Ability to translate complex analytical and technical concepts into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.


- Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, with experience working with senior marketing, media, analytics, operations, and technology stakeholders.


- Proven ability to work through ambiguous problems, identify practical solutions, and collaborate across disciplines to improve analytics capabilities and delivery.


- Experience managing and developing analytics talent, including coaching individual contributors and supporting skill development.


- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively with Strategy, Media, Marketing Technology & Operations, Creative, Client Success, and other teams.


- Experience supporting new business, organic growth, or solution-scoping efforts.


Our Culture

Marketbridge supports Fortune 50 companies and global brands in redefining how they go to market.

How we work together matters just as much as the work itself. Our values shape how we operate day to day. Be Kind means treating teammates with respect and showing up for one another. Be Open reflects how we collaborate, share perspectives, and give clear, honest feedback. Be Real speaks to a culture of authenticity, where people can speak up and be themselves. Be Brave pushes us to challenge assumptions, think critically, and pursue ideas that lead to real results.

You’ll join a collaborative team focused on solving real problems for complex clients. From day one, you’ll gain hands-on experience, work closely with supportive leaders, and continue developing through meaningful client work and ongoing learning. We value accountability, curiosity, and ownership, and we trust people to take initiative and follow through.

Here, you’ll do meaningful work, alongside smart people, with room to grow as the business grows.

Benefits & Perks

At Marketbridge, we support our team with benefits that prioritize well-being, flexibility, and growth. Here’s what you can look forward to:

- 🏖️ Time Off & Flexibility – Flexible PTO, summer Fridays, and paid parental leave (up to 16 weeks for birthing parents). Plus, we’re closed from Christmas to New Year’s so you can fully unplug.


- 💙 Health & Wellness – Comprehensive medical benefits and free premium access to the Calm app for relaxation and mindfulness.


- 💰 Financial Security – 401(k) with a 3% company contribution\* (US Only), life insurance, long-term disability, and AD&D coverage for extra peace of mind.


- 📚 Learning & Growth – A professional development fund ($500) and continuous learning programs to invest in your career.


- 💻 Tech & Perks – Company-provided laptop & accessories, monthly Wi-Fi & cell stipend, and exclusive discounts through Perkopolis.


Note: This position requires candidates to be eligible to work in the United States or Canada without visa sponsorship. Marketbridge is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours.

We aim to offer competitive and fair compensation based on experience, location, and market benchmarks. The salary range for this role is $125,000 – $130,000.

Final compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s qualifications, and additional flexibility may be considered for candidates whose experience and expertise significantly exceed the role’s core requirements.

## Thank you for your interest in a career at Marketbridge. Please review our open positions and apply to the one that matches your qualifications.

## Director, Marketing Analytics

Remote

Full Time

Agency Services North America

Senior Manager/Supervisor

[Share](https://marketbridge.applytojob.com/app/share/TORPvd4IsL)

**This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours.**

Job Description

Job Title: Director, Marketing Analytics

Level: 6 (Director)

Dept: Agency, Marketing Technology & Operations

Location: Canada

Base Salary Range: CAD $115k – $130k,

Bonus (if applicable): 0-10% based on EBITDA and personal performance

Who We Are

Marketbridge partners with leading B2B brands to create unified Go-to-Market® systems that connect strategy, AI, creativity, activation and measurement. With a team of 350+ across North America and Europe, Marketbridge supports clients worldwide, ranging from Fortune 1000 enterprises to venture-backed, high-growth companies across technology, financial services, healthcare, industrial and consumer sectors. For more information, please visit [www.marketbridge.com](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmarketbridge.com%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cmjayatillake%40marketbridge.com%7C3f86758322fc43272bb508de965db3bc%7C2f0f75c5488d4df5b20e251bac7750fe%7C0%7C0%7C639113526362295137%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=JQD%2BhgnOX2B2lhYwK4P%2B62OXHQzvwtmFDXSyinzzY30%3D&reserved=0) and follow [www.linkedin.com/company/marketbridge/](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fmarketbridge%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cmjayatillake%40marketbridge.com%7C3f86758322fc43272bb508de965db3bc%7C2f0f75c5488d4df5b20e251bac7750fe%7C0%7C0%7C639113526362341818%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Xl4ZQw2EPy9rwoYJJyeKqWCif%2BpIUSqtSI7c7ftJa48%3D&reserved=0).

Who We're Looking For

Marketbridge is seeking a Director, Marketing Analytics to advance the measurement, reporting, and analytics capabilities that support modern B2B marketing programs.

This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, media, digital analytics, marketing technology & operations, reporting, and measurement. The Director will help clients and internal teams establish the data and measurement foundations needed to understand marketing performance, identify meaningful trends and anomalies, and quickly surface areas that warrant deeper investigation.

The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in B2B performance marketing, web analytics, tag management, reporting, and measurement with a practical understanding of how marketing data is captured and moves across media, web, marketing automation, CRM, ABM, and business intelligence platforms and environments.

This role is not responsible for owning the client performance narrative or determining the strategic “so what” from the data. Instead, Marketing Analytics provides the reliable reporting, analytical evidence, trend identification, and investigative support that enables strategy, media, creative and account management teams assess and explain performance, identify contributing factors, and recommend what to do next.

Success in this role requires strong analytical judgment, technical fluency, curiosity, collaborative problem-solving, and a demonstrated ability to use AI and automation to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of analytics work.

Key Responsibilities

- Serve as the Analytics partner to Strategy in the development of measurement approaches and KPI frameworks, providing guidance on data availability, technical feasibility, tracking requirements, and alternative KPIs where appropriate, then translating the agreed framework into actionable reporting, measurement, and technical requirements


- Support B2B marketing performance analysis across paid media, web, CRM, marketing automation, email, and other ABM and demand-generation channels, ensuring teams have accurate and consistent views of campaign and funnel performance.


- Surface meaningful trends, anomalies, correlations, and areas for deeper investigation across marketing data to accelerate the identification of potential insights and performance questions.


- Partner with Strategy teams to support performance storytelling by providing accurate reporting, analytical evidence, trend identification, hypothesis validation, and targeted analysis, while Strategy retains ownership of the client-facing performance narrative and optimization recommendations.


- Define and oversee web analytics tracking requirements, including event and conversion tracking, tagging plans, data layer requirements, taxonomy standards, consent considerations, implementation QA, troubleshooting, and ongoing measurement governance.


- Provide expertise across web analytics and tag management platforms, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, Adobe Analytics, and related digital measurement technologies.


- Guide reporting and dashboard solutions that bring together data from marketing, media, CRM, web, ABM, and other sources in a way that is accurate, scalable, and useful to internal and external stakeholders.


- Partner with Marketing Technology & Operations, and client technical teams to define the data requirements and integrations needed for reporting and analytics, ensuring required data is accessible, reliable, and fit for analytical use.


- Establish and maintain data quality and analytics QA standards that improve the consistency, accuracy, and reliability of reporting and measurement outputs.


- Apply AI-enabled tools and workflows to Marketing Analytics, using AI to improve areas such as data exploration, anomaly detection, reporting, QA, visualization, analytical investigation, documentation, and workflow efficiency.


- Identify, test, and operationalize AI and automation opportunities that improve the speed, consistency, scalability, and quality of analytics delivery while maintaining appropriate human oversight and data governance.


- Collaborate with leaders and subject-matter experts across Marketing Technology & Operations, Strategy, Media, Creative, and other practice areas to design and deliver more robust and scalable analytics and measurement solutions for internal teams and clients.


- Identify recurring analytics challenges and opportunities and bring an innovative, solutions-oriented mindset to improving tools, workflows, reporting approaches, measurement practices, and reusable analytical frameworks.


- Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, helping define measurement requirements, reporting approaches, analytical needs, and opportunities to improve marketing-data visibility.


- Lead discovery and solution-design discussions for analytics and measurement engagements, translating business questions into clear reporting, tracking, and analytical requirements.


- Develop and coach Marketing Analytics talent, providing technical guidance, performance feedback, career development, and support for continued growth in measurement, reporting, digital analytics, AI, and marketing performance analysis.


- Support team resourcing and delivery quality across analytics engagements, helping ensure work is appropriately staffed and delivered against established analytical and technical standards.


- Support new business and organic growth by contributing to analytics discovery, solution design, scoping, estimation, proposals, capabilities presentations, and client conversations.


Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, digital analytics, performance analytics, marketing measurement, business intelligence, marketing operations, or a related discipline, ideally within an agency, consulting, or complex client-service environment.


- Deep understanding of B2B performance marketing and media measurement, with experience analyzing performance across channels such as paid search, paid social, programmatic/display, email, web, and other ABM and demand-generation programs.


- Strong understanding of B2B funnel and performance metrics, including lead generation, conversion rates, MQL/SQL/MQA progression, pipeline contribution, account engagement, CPL/CAC, attribution, and the relationship between media, web, marketing automation, CRM, and revenue data.


- Deep expertise in web analytics and tag management, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Adobe Analytics, with experience assessing measurement frameworks and defining tagging plans, data layer requirements, event taxonomies, conversion tracking, implementation standards, QA processes, and governance.


- Experience working with data from major performance marketing and demand-generation platforms, such as Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta, programmatic/DSP platforms, 6sense, Demandbase, CRM (e.g. Salesforce) systems, and marketing automation platforms (e.g. HubSpot, Marketo).


- Strong experience developing marketing reporting and dashboard solutions using BI and visualization platforms such as Looker, Looker Studio, Tableau, Domo, Power BI or equivalent tools.


- Demonstrated ability to identify trends, anomalies, data-quality issues, and areas for further investigation across complex marketing datasets.


- Demonstrated experience applying AI-enabled tools and workflows to marketing analytics, including use cases such as data exploration, anomaly detection, reporting, QA, visualization, analysis support, or workflow automation.


- Ability to evaluate where AI can materially improve analytical quality, speed, and scalability while applying appropriate judgment, validation, and governance.


- Strong working knowledge of SQL and an understanding of data integration, transformation, and automation concepts sufficient to work effectively with technical teams and interrogate data when needed.


- Familiarity with APIs, ETL/ELT concepts, cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake, and modern data automation approaches is preferred; hands-on data engineering expertise is not required.


- Strong understanding of marketing data quality, governance, tracking, attribution, and cross-platform measurement.


- Ability to translate complex analytical and technical concepts into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.


- Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, with experience working with senior marketing, media, analytics, operations, and technology stakeholders.


- Proven ability to work through ambiguous problems, identify practical solutions, and collaborate across disciplines to improve analytics capabilities and delivery.


- Experience managing and developing analytics talent, including coaching individual contributors and supporting skill development.


- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively with Strategy, Media, Marketing Technology & Operations, Creative, Client Success, and other teams.


- Experience supporting new business, organic growth, or solution-scoping efforts.


Our Culture

Marketbridge supports Fortune 50 companies and global brands in redefining how they go to market.

How we work together matters just as much as the work itself. Our values shape how we operate day to day. Be Kind means treating teammates with respect and showing up for one another. Be Open reflects how we collaborate, share perspectives, and give clear, honest feedback. Be Real speaks to a culture of authenticity, where people can speak up and be themselves. Be Brave pushes us to challenge assumptions, think critically, and pursue ideas that lead to real results.

You’ll join a collaborative team focused on solving real problems for complex clients. From day one, you’ll gain hands-on experience, work closely with supportive leaders, and continue developing through meaningful client work and ongoing learning. We value accountability, curiosity, and ownership, and we trust people to take initiative and follow through.

Here, you’ll do meaningful work, alongside smart people, with room to grow as the business grows.

Benefits & Perks

At Marketbridge, we support our team with benefits that prioritize well-being, flexibility, and growth. Here’s what you can look forward to:

- 🏖️ Time Off & Flexibility – Flexible PTO, summer Fridays, and paid parental leave (up to 16 weeks for birthing parents). Plus, we’re closed from Christmas to New Year’s so you can fully unplug.


- 💙 Health & Wellness – Comprehensive medical benefits and free premium access to the Calm app for relaxation and mindfulness.


- 💰 Financial Security – 401(k) with a 3% company contribution\* (US Only), life insurance, long-term disability, and AD&D coverage for extra peace of mind.


- 📚 Learning & Growth – A professional development fund ($500) and continuous learning programs to invest in your career.


- 💻 Tech & Perks – Company-provided laptop & accessories, monthly Wi-Fi & cell stipend, and exclusive discounts through Perkopolis.


Note: This position requires candidates to be eligible to work in the United States or Canada without visa sponsorship. Marketbridge is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours.

We aim to offer competitive and fair compensation based on experience, location, and market benchmarks. The salary range for this role is $125,000 – $130,000.

Final compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s qualifications, and additional flexibility may be considered for candidates whose experience and expertise significantly exceed the role’s core requirements.

- Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, helping define measurement requirements, reporting approaches, analytical needs, and opportunities to improve marketing-data visibility.


- Lead discovery and solution-design discussions for analytics and measurement engagements, translating business questions into clear reporting, tracking, and analytical requirements.


- Develop and coach Marketing Analytics talent, providing technical guidance, performance feedback, career development, and support for continued growth in measurement, reporting, digital analytics, AI, and marketing performance analysis.


- Support team resourcing and delivery quality across analytics engagements, helping ensure work is appropriately staffed and delivered against established analytical and technical standards.


- Support new business and organic growth by contributing to analytics discovery, solution design, scoping, estimation, proposals, capabilities presentations, and client conversations.


Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, digital analytics, performance analytics, marketing measurement, business intelligence, marketing operations, or a related discipline, ideally within an agency, consulting, or complex client-service environment.


- Deep understanding of B2B performance marketing and media measurement, with experience analyzing performance across channels such as paid search, paid social, programmatic/display, email, web, and other ABM and demand-generation programs.


- Strong understanding of B2B funnel and performance metrics, including lead generation, conversion rates, MQL/SQL/MQA progression, pipeline contribution, account engagement, CPL/CAC, attribution, and the relationship between media, web, marketing automation, CRM, and revenue data.


- Deep expertise in web analytics and tag management, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Adobe Analytics, with experience assessing measurement frameworks and defining tagging plans, data layer requirements, event taxonomies, conversion tracking, implementation standards, QA processes, and governance.


- Experience working with data from major performance marketing and demand-generation platforms, such as Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta, programmatic/DSP platforms, 6sense, Demandbase, CRM (e.g. Salesforce) systems, and marketing automation platforms (e.g. HubSpot, Marketo).


- Strong experience developing marketing reporting and dashboard solutions using BI and visualization platforms such as Looker, Looker Studio, Tableau, Domo, Power BI or equivalent tools.


- Demonstrated ability to identify trends, anomalies, data-quality issues, and areas for further investigation across complex marketing datasets.


- Demonstrated experience applying AI-enabled tools and workflows to marketing analytics, including use cases such as data exploration, anomaly detection, reporting, QA, visualization, analysis support, or workflow automation.


- Ability to evaluate where AI can materially improve analytical quality, speed, and scalability while applying appropriate judgment, validation, and governance.


- Strong working knowledge of SQL and an understanding of data integration, transformation, and automation concepts sufficient to work effectively with technical teams and interrogate data when needed.


- Familiarity with APIs, ETL/ELT concepts, cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake, and modern data automation approaches is preferred; hands-on data engineering expertise is not required.


- Strong understanding of marketing data quality, governance, tracking, attribution, and cross-platform measurement.


- Ability to translate complex analytical and technical concepts into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.


- Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, with experience working with senior marketing, media, analytics, operations, and technology stakeholders.


- Proven ability to work through ambiguous problems, identify practical solutions, and collaborate across disciplines to improve analytics capabilities and delivery.


- Experience managing and developing analytics talent, including coaching individual contributors and supporting skill development.


- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively with Strategy, Media, Marketing Technology & Operations, Creative, Client Success, and other teams.


- Experience supporting new business, organic growth, or solution-scoping efforts.


Our Culture

Marketbridge supports Fortune 50 companies and global brands in redefining how they go to market.

How we work together matters just as much as the work itself. Our values shape how we operate day to day. Be Kind means treating teammates with respect and showing up for one another. Be Open reflects how we collaborate, share perspectives, and give clear, honest feedback. Be Real speaks to a culture of authenticity, where people can speak up and be themselves. Be Brave pushes us to challenge assumptions, think critically, and pursue ideas that lead to real results.

You’ll join a collaborative team focused on solving real problems for complex clients. From day one, you’ll gain hands-on experience, work closely with supportive leaders, and continue developing through meaningful client work and ongoing learning. We value accountability, curiosity, and ownership, and we trust people to take initiative and follow through.

Here, you’ll do meaningful work, alongside smart people, with room to grow as the business grows.

Benefits & Perks

At Marketbridge, we support our team with benefits that prioritize well-being, flexibility, and growth. Here’s what you can look forward to:

- 🏖️ Time Off & Flexibility – Flexible PTO, summer Fridays, and paid parental leave (up to 16 weeks for birthing parents). Plus, we’re closed from Christmas to New Year’s so you can fully unplug.


- 💙 Health & Wellness – Comprehensive medical benefits and free premium access to the Calm app for relaxation and mindfulness.


- 💰 Financial Security – 401(k) with a 3% company contribution\* (US Only), life insurance, long-term disability, and AD&D coverage for extra peace of mind.


- 📚 Learning & Growth – A professional development fund ($500) and continuous learning programs to invest in your career.


- 💻 Tech & Perks – Company-provided laptop & accessories, monthly Wi-Fi & cell stipend, and exclusive discounts through Perkopolis.


Note: This position requires candidates to be eligible to work in the United States or Canada without visa sponsorship. Marketbridge is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours.

We aim to offer competitive and fair compensation based on experience, location, and market benchmarks. The salary range for this role is $125,000 – $130,000.

Final compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s qualifications, and additional flexibility may be considered for candidates whose experience and expertise significantly exceed the role’s core requirements.

The Director will help clients and internal teams establish the data and measurement foundations needed to understand marketing performance, identify meaningful trends and anomalies, and quickly surface areas that warrant deeper investigation. </p><p>The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in B2B performance marketing, web analytics, tag management, reporting, and measurement with a practical understanding of how marketing data is captured and moves across media, web, marketing automation, CRM, ABM, and business intelligence platforms and environments. </p><p>This role is not responsible for owning the client performance narrative or determining the strategic “so what” from the data. Instead, Marketing Analytics provides the reliable reporting, analytical evidence, trend identification, and investigative support that enables strategy, media, creative and account management teams assess and explain performance, identify contributing factors, and recommend what to do next. </p><p>Success in this role requires strong analytical judgment, technical fluency, curiosity, collaborative problem-solving, and a demonstrated ability to use AI and automation to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of analytics work. </p><p></p><p>Key Responsibilities </p><ul><li><p>Serve as the Analytics partner to Strategy in the development of measurement approaches and KPI frameworks, providing guidance on data availability, technical feasibility, tracking requirements, and alternative KPIs where appropriate, then translating the agreed framework into actionable reporting, measurement, and technical requirements </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Support B2B marketing performance analysis across paid media, web, CRM, marketing automation, email, and other ABM and demand-generation channels, ensuring teams have accurate and consistent views of campaign and funnel performance. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Surface meaningful trends, anomalies, correlations, and areas for deeper investigation across marketing data to accelerate the identification of potential insights and performance questions. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Partner with Strategy teams to support performance storytelling by providing accurate reporting, analytical evidence, trend identification, hypothesis validation, and targeted analysis, while Strategy retains ownership of the client-facing performance narrative and optimization recommendations. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Define and oversee web analytics tracking requirements, including event and conversion tracking, tagging plans, data layer requirements, taxonomy standards, consent considerations, implementation QA, troubleshooting, and ongoing measurement governance. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Provide expertise across web analytics and tag management platforms, including CRM, web, ABM, and other sources in a way that is accurate, scalable, and useful to internal and external stakeholders. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Partner with Marketing Technology & Operations, and client technical teams to define the data requirements and integrations needed for reporting and analytics, ensuring required data is accessible, reliable, and fit for analytical use. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Establish and maintain data quality and analytics QA standards that improve the consistency, accuracy, and reliability of reporting and measurement outputs. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Apply AI-enabled tools and workflows to Marketing Analytics, using AI to improve areas such as data exploration, anomaly detection, reporting, QA, visualization, analytical investigation, documentation, and workflow efficiency. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Identify, test, and operationalize AI and automation opportunities that improve the speed, consistency, scalability, and quality of analytics delivery while maintaining appropriate human oversight and data governance. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Collaborate with leaders and subject-matter experts across Marketing Technology & Operations, Strategy, Media, Creative, and other practice areas to design and deliver more robust and scalable analytics and measurement solutions for internal teams and clients. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Identify recurring analytics challenges and opportunities and bring an innovative, solutions-oriented mindset to improving tools, workflows, reporting approaches, measurement practices, and reusable analytical frameworks. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, helping define measurement requirements, reporting approaches, analytical needs, and opportunities to improve marketing-data visibility. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Lead discovery and solution-design discussions for analytics and measurement engagements, translating business questions into clear reporting, tracking, and analytical requirements. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Develop and coach Marketing Analytics talent, providing technical guidance, performance feedback, career development, and support for continued growth in measurement, reporting, digital analytics, AI, and marketing performance analysis. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Support team resourcing and delivery quality across analytics engagements, helping ensure work is appropriately staffed and delivered against established analytical and technical standards. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Support new business and organic growth by contributing to analytics discovery, solution design, scoping, estimation, proposals, capabilities presentations, and client conversations. </p></li></ul><p></p><p></p><p>Qualifications </p><ul><li><p>8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, digital analytics, performance analytics, marketing measurement, business intelligence, marketing operations, or a related discipline, ideally within an agency, consulting, or complex client-service environment. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Deep understanding of B2B performance marketing and media measurement, with experience analyzing performance across channels such as paid search, paid social, programmatic/display, email, web, and other ABM and demand-generation programs. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Strong understanding of B2B funnel and performance metrics, including lead generation, conversion rates, MQL/SQL/MQA progression, pipeline contribution, account engagement, CPL/CAC, attribution, and the relationship between media, web, marketing automation, CRM, and revenue data. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Deep expertise in web analytics and tag management, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Adobe Analytics, with experience assessing measurement frameworks and defining tagging plans, data layer requirements, event taxonomies, conversion tracking, implementation standards, QA processes, and governance. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Experience working with data from major performance marketing and demand-generation platforms, such as Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta, programmatic/DSP platforms, 6sense, Demandbase, CRM (e.g. Salesforce) systems, and marketing automation platforms (e.g. HubSpot, cross-functional collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively with Strategy, Media, Marketing Technology & Operations, Creative, Client Success, and other teams. </p></li></ul><ul><li><p>Experience supporting new business, organic growth, or solution-scoping efforts. </p></li></ul><p>Our Culture </p><p>Marketbridge supports Fortune 50 companies and global brands in redefining how they go to market.  </p><p></p><p>How we work together matters just as much as the work itself. Our values shape how we operate day to day. Be Kind means treating teammates with respect and showing up for one another. Be Open reflects how we collaborate, share perspectives, and give clear, honest feedback. Be Real speaks to a culture of authenticity, where people can speak up and be themselves. Be Brave pushes us to challenge assumptions, think critically, and pursue ideas that lead to real results.  </p><p>You’ll join a collaborative team focused on solving real problems for complex clients. raw.title: Field Marketing Manager
raw.description:
# ABOUT THE ROLE

The Field Marketing Manager bridges the gap between national brand strategy and local business performance. As the local marketing advisor for a portfolio of franchise owners, you'll help owners understand how marketing influences every stage of their business—from lead generation and sales conversion to profitability, market share, and long-term growth.

Working alongside Franchise Business Consultants (FBCs), Digital Marketing partners, Operations, and Brand Leadership, you'll help franchise owners interpret performance data, identify opportunities, prioritize investments, and develop action plans that improve measurable business results.

 

LOCATION: Richmond, VA (preferred) or Remote (U.S.)

TRAVEL: Approximately 50% 

# WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Marketing is one of the largest investments our franchise owners make. Every recommendation we provide should help owners:

- Protect their bottom line.

- Maximize return on marketing investment.

- Generate sustainable, profitable growth.

- Make confident, data-informed business decisions.

As a franchisee-first organization, we believe our success is directly tied to the success of the owners we serve. The Field Marketing Manager is one of the most important advocates for that success.

# CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

## Drive Local Business Performance

Support the localized performance strategy for your assigned franchise owners by connecting marketing investments to measurable business outcomes.

- Analyze business performance, marketing KPIs, local market trends, and competitive activity to identify growth opportunities.

- Evaluate marketing ROI using metrics such as cost per lead, lead quality, appointment conversion, sales conversion, average ticket, revenue contribution, and customer acquisition costs.

- Facilitate quarterly local business reviews focused on improving local business performance.

- Help owners align marketing investments with revenue goals, operational capacity, seasonality, and local market conditions.

- Recommend strategic priorities that improve profitability—not simply increase lead volume.

- Support owners and drive accountable to agreed-upon growth plans and execution.

## Marketing Performance Analytics

Use marketing intelligence to help owners make better business decisions.

- Interpret performance across Google Ads, Local Services Ads, SEO, Google Business Profile, Paid Social, websites, reputation management, and other demand generation programs.

- Translate complex reporting into practical business insights.

- Identify opportunities, risks, and trends across assigned markets.

- Benchmark performance against comparable franchise locations.

- Recommend strategic adjustments based on business performance—not assumptions.

## Partner Across the Franchise Support Team

Marketing doesn't operate in a vacuum. You'll work side-by-side with Franchise Business Consultants to provide coordinated support throughout the franchise owner's journey. Together you'll support:

- New owner onboarding and market launches.

- Local performance improvement initiatives.

- Territory expansion and multi-location growth.

- Long-term business planning.

Our franchise owners experience one support team with one shared objective: helping them build exceptional businesses.

## Optimize Marketing Investments

While you won't manage campaigns directly, you'll ensure franchise owners are maximizing the value of their local marketing:

- Review campaign performance alongside digital marketing partners.

- Help owners understand vendor recommendations and ask better business questions.

- Identify funnel breakdowns and opportunities for improvement.

- Recommend optimization strategies grounded in performance data.

- Advocate for solutions that protect the owner's investment and drive stronger business outcomes.

# QUALIFICATIONS

### Required

- Bachelors degree in marketing, business, or a related discipline

- 5+ years of experience in franchise marketing, field marketing, business consulting, marketing strategy, or digital marketing.

- Experience working directly with business owners or executive-level clients.

- Strong understanding of marketing analytics and business performance metrics.

- Experience facilitating strategic business reviews and presenting recommendations to stakeholders.

- Excellent communication, relationship management, and consulting skills.

### Preferred

- Franchise, Home services or multi-location experience a plus

- Agency or client strategy experience.

- Experience working with digital marketing vendors.

 

The estimated compensation range for this position is a base salary of $90,000 to $105,000. Actual compensation for the position is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to years of experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. 

 

WHO WE ARE:

Empower Brands was founded in 2022 as a product of the integration of Lynx Franchising and Outdoor Living Brands. Empower encompasses ten industry-leading brands across commercial and residential services: JAN-PRO, FRSTeam, Archadeck Outdoor Living, Outdoor Lighting Perspectives (OLP), Conserva Irrigation, Koala Insulation, Wallaby Windows, Superior Fence and Rail, Bumble Roofing and Canopy Lawn Care. Empower is dedicated to providing its customers with the highest quality products and services in the commercial and home services industry while simultaneously delivering its franchise owners committed personal support, tools and empowerment to pursue their own success. Empower Brands is a portfolio company of MidOcean Partners, a leading private equity firm with an excellent track record investing in successful, growth-focused franchise businesses. For more about Empower Brands, visit the company’s new website at EmpowerFranchising.com.

 

Note: 

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. All duties and responsibilities are essential functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. To perform this job successfully, the incumbents will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health or safety of themselves or others. The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, or abilities. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an “at will” relationship.  

Empower Brands is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Empower Brands makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time. #LI-Remote

raw.title: Partner Success Manager — Growth & Performance Marketing
raw.description:
Location: Remote — United States or Canada
Preferred time zones: Eastern or Central
US: Full-time employment with health, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), flexible PTO, and flexible hours
Canada: Full-time contractor engagement
Compensation: 115,000–125,000 USD annually
Travel: Approximately 5–10%

Our client is a global, tech-enabled growth company that helps businesses solve complex digital marketing challenges and connect marketing performance with measurable business outcomes.

We are looking for a proactive Partner Success Manager who knows how to own the customer journey, understand what clients really need, and move quickly to resolve problems. The strongest candidates will come from a MarTech, AdTech, marketing analytics, or related SaaS environment and will also understand the language of growth and performance marketing.

You will serve as the primary strategic contact for a focused portfolio of approximately 2–6 high-touch partners. This is not a sales role, a high-volume Customer Success position, or a campaign-execution role. You will own the post-sale partner relationship, establish goals and priorities, identify risks and opportunities, and coordinate internal teams to keep work moving and deliver meaningful results.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the post-sale partner journey for approximately 2–6 high-touch accounts.

  • Become a trusted strategic partner to Marketing and Growth Leads, founders, and other senior stakeholders.

  • Listen carefully to partners, understand their business model and challenges, and turn their needs into clear goals, priorities, and action plans.

  • Establish success goals, milestones, and ways to measure progress for each partnership.

  • Lead strategic and performance conversations using marketing, customer, and business data.

  • Identify problems, risks, and blockers early and take ownership of driving them toward resolution.

  • Translate partner priorities into clear direction for paid media, creative, CRM/email, analytics, campaign management, and production teams.

  • Coordinate cross-functional delivery without relying on formal authority.

  • Keep partners and internal teams aligned through clear communication, follow-up, and accountability.

  • Help partners use a proprietary growth intelligence platform that connects marketing performance with financial goals.

  • Identify opportunities to improve adoption, partner outcomes, retention, and long-term value.

  • Work effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities may change and not every problem has an established playbook.

What We’re Looking For

  • Approximately 5–8 years of relevant professional experience.

  • Strong experience in Customer Success, Client Success, Account Management, Partner Success, or strategic client services.

  • Experience working in a MarTech, AdTech, marketing analytics, marketing automation, attribution, CRM, lifecycle marketing, paid media technology, or related SaaS company.

  • Proven ownership of important post-sale customer or partner relationships.

  • Experience guiding customers through a journey rather than responding only to requests or providing status updates.

  • A proactive, resourceful approach to solving problems and keeping initiatives moving.

  • Experience defining customer goals, managing expectations, identifying risks, and coordinating resolutions across multiple teams.

  • Confidence leading strategic conversations with marketing leaders, founders, and executives.

  • A strong working understanding of digital and performance marketing, including acquisition channels, funnels, paid media, CRM/email, and analytics.

  • Ability to discuss CAC, ROAS, LTV, conversion, retention, attribution, and marketing efficiency and connect these metrics to business goals.

  • Experience translating customer needs into clear priorities for cross-functional teams.

  • Exposure to marketing budgets of $100,000+ per month.

  • Strong communication, listening, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Comfort working with urgency, ambiguity, and a high degree of personal ownership.

What This Role Is Not

  • It is not a prospecting or new-business sales role.

  • There is no sales quota.

  • It is not a high-volume Customer Success role focused on managing a large number of transactional customers.

  • It is not a reactive account coordination role centered on meetings, status updates, and recaps.

  • It is not a hands-on media buying position.

You do not need to launch or optimize campaigns yourself. However, you must understand how performance marketing works, feel comfortable working with data, and be able to turn insights into meaningful recommendations and action for partners.

 - Translate partner priorities into clear direction for paid media, creative, CRM/email, analytics, campaign management, and production teams.

 - Coordinate cross-functional delivery without relying on formal authority.

 - Keep partners and internal teams aligned through clear communication, follow-up, and accountability.

 - Help partners use a proprietary growth intelligence platform that connects marketing performance with financial goals.

 - Identify opportunities to improve adoption, partner outcomes, retention, and long-term value.

 - Work effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities may change and not every problem has an established playbook.



What We’re Looking For

 - Approximately 5–8 years of relevant professional experience.

 - Strong experience in Customer Success, Client Success, Account Management, Partner Success, or strategic client services.

 - Experience working in a MarTech, AdTech, marketing analytics, marketing automation, attribution, CRM, lifecycle marketing, paid media technology, or related SaaS company.

 - Proven ownership of important post-sale customer or partner relationships.

 - Experience guiding customers through a journey rather than responding only to requests or providing status updates.

 - A proactive, resourceful approach to solving problems and keeping initiatives moving.

 - Experience defining customer goals, managing expectations, identifying risks, and coordinating resolutions across multiple teams.

 - Confidence leading strategic conversations with marketing leaders, founders, and executives.

 - A strong working understanding of digital and performance marketing, including acquisition channels, funnels, paid media, CRM/email, and analytics.

 - Ability to discuss CAC, ROAS, LTV, conversion, retention, attribution, and marketing efficiency and connect these metrics to business goals.

 - Experience translating customer needs into clear priorities for cross-functional teams.

 - Exposure to marketing budgets of $100,000+ per month.

 - Strong communication, listening, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills.

 - Comfort working with urgency, ambiguity, and a high degree of personal ownership.



What This Role Is Not

 - It is not a prospecting or new-business sales role.

 - There is no sales quota.

 - It is not a high-volume Customer Success role focused on managing a large number of transactional customers.

 - It is not a reactive account coordination role centered on meetings, status updates, and recaps.

 - It is not a hands-on media buying position.



You do not need to launch or optimize campaigns yourself. However, you must understand how performance marketing works, feel comfortable working with data, and be able to turn insights into meaningful recommendations and action for partners.

raw.title: Senior Paid Media Channel Manager (Enterprise Marketing)
raw.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Paid Media Channel Manager to lead the strategy, execution, optimization, and performance of enterprise paid media channels across paid social, paid search, and programmatic advertising.

This highly visible role will own paid media channel roadmaps, oversee campaign measurement and technical integrations, manage agency partnerships, and drive performance across multiple business lines.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in paid social advertising at scale, strong technical knowledge of digital advertising infrastructure, and a demonstrated ability to translate marketing objectives into measurable business results.

This opportunity offers the chance to help shape paid media operations within a fast paced, evolving enterprise technology marketing organization focused on innovative AI powered business solutions.

## Key Responsibilities

Paid Media Strategy & Channel Optimization

- 

Own paid media channel roadmaps and quarterly optimization strategies across paid social, paid search, and programmatic advertising.

- 

Identify performance gaps, prioritize optimization opportunities, and implement improvements to drive measurable results.

- 

Translate business objectives into channel performance targets, KPIs, and execution guidelines.

- 

Establish testing strategies to evaluate new channels, ad formats, audience approaches, and measurement capabilities.

Campaign Management & Portfolio Oversight

- 

Oversee paid media investment across multiple products, campaigns, and business priorities.

- 

Manage campaign budgets, spending, pacing, and performance reporting.

- 

Develop and maintain a centralized paid media calendar covering campaigns, launches, and regional initiatives.

- 

Coordinate campaign timelines, resource allocation, and prioritization across concurrent workstreams.

Ad Technology, Tracking & Measurement

- 

Oversee campaign trafficking, tracking implementation, conversion APIs, pixels, UTM governance, and naming conventions.

- 

Establish campaign quality assurance standards to ensure accurate tracking, targeting, and measurement.

- 

Manage audience segmentation, activation, governance, and ongoing optimization.

- 

Partner with marketing technology and operations teams to support advertising platform integrations, CRM connectivity, and marketing data flows.

- 

Identify and resolve technical or measurement challenges impacting campaign performance.

Testing, Analytics & Performance Reporting

- 

Design and execute structured testing roadmaps with defined success criteria.

- 

Analyze campaign effectiveness, audience performance, bidding strategies, creative performance, and conversion optimization.

- 

Provide actionable performance reporting covering campaign efficiency, budget pacing, lead generation, and pipeline contribution.

- 

Translate performance data into strategic recommendations for marketing leadership and cross functional stakeholders.

- 

Develop best practices, benchmarks, and playbooks to improve campaign effectiveness.

Cross Functional Collaboration & Agency Management

- 

Partner with integrated marketing, product marketing, marketing operations, analytics, web, SEO/SEM, and organic social teams.

- 

Align paid media initiatives with broader marketing strategies and business objectives.

- 

Oversee agency and vendor execution, including campaign briefs, timelines, deliverables, quality standards, and service expectations.

- 

Support account based marketing (ABM) initiatives, including account list activation and targeted media campaigns.

- 

Coordinate regional campaigns while maintaining consistent brand standards and measurement practices.

## Required Qualifications

- 

8+ years of paid media experience with direct ownership of channel strategy, roadmaps, and performance.

- 

Extensive experience managing paid social advertising at scale, with working knowledge of paid search and programmatic advertising.

- 

Strong technical expertise in campaign trafficking, conversion tracking, pixels, conversion APIs, UTM parameters, audience onboarding, and campaign QA.

- 

Experience managing paid media calendars, competing priorities, budgets, and resources across multiple stakeholders.

- 

Demonstrated success developing and executing structured testing and optimization strategies.

- 

Hands on experience collaborating with marketing technology and marketing operations teams on system integrations, marketing data flows, and campaign measurement.

- 

Experience overseeing external advertising agencies or vendors, managing deliverables and performance expectations.

- 

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and communicate actionable insights to leadership.

- 

Excellent organizational, project management, and written communication skills.

- 

Ability to operate independently in a dynamic, fast paced environment with evolving priorities.

## Preferred Qualifications

- 

Experience in enterprise B2B technology marketing, particularly AI, SaaS, cloud computing, or technology platforms.

- 

Experience managing paid media portfolios across multiple products, business units, or regions.

- 

Strong understanding of integrated marketing strategies connecting paid media, organic social, website performance, and search.

- 

Familiarity with marketing automation platforms, CRM systems, and lead to pipeline attribution.

- 

Experience establishing audience governance frameworks, tracking standards, or campaign taxonomy.

- 

Experience supporting account based marketing (ABM) campaigns and account level targeting.

- 

Experience managing advertising budgets across multiple regions or currencies.

- 

Background working within large, complex technology organizations or rapidly evolving marketing teams.

## Ideal Candidate Profile

The strongest candidate is a strategic, technically sophisticated paid media leader who combines hands on channel expertise with broader portfolio management capabilities.

This individual understands how to scale paid social campaigns, optimize advertising infrastructure, implement rigorous measurement standards, and coordinate multiple marketing initiatives simultaneously.

Candidates with primarily brand marketing, creative strategy, or content marketing experience without substantial paid media ownership are unlikely to align with the requirements of this position.

Join an innovative enterprise technology marketing organization during a period of significant growth and transformation. This role offers the opportunity to shape paid media strategy, develop scalable marketing operations, collaborate with cross functional teams, and directly influence enterprise marketing performance.

Location: Remote (NY preferred)

Role type: Contract 12 Month Position (up to a 30 month contract w/potential to convert to FTE)

Expected hours: 40 per week 

Benefits:

- Dental insurance

- Health insurance

- Health savings account

- Life insurance

- Paid time off

- Retirement plan

- Vision insurance

Schedule:

- 8 hour shift

- Monday to Friday

Application Question(s):

- Do you or will you in the future require any sponsorship to work in the US?

Language:

- English  (Required)

We are seeking an experienced Senior Paid Media Channel Manager to lead the strategy, execution, optimization, and performance of enterprise paid media channels across paid social, paid search, and programmatic advertising.

This highly visible role will own paid media channel roadmaps, oversee campaign measurement and technical integrations, manage agency partnerships, and drive performance across multiple business lines.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in paid social advertising at scale, strong technical knowledge of digital advertising infrastructure, and a demonstrated ability to translate marketing objectives into measurable business results.

This opportunity offers the chance to help shape paid media operations within a fast paced, evolving enterprise technology marketing organization focused on innovative AI powered business solutions.

## Key Responsibilities

Paid Media Strategy & Channel Optimization

- 

Own paid media channel roadmaps and quarterly optimization strategies across paid social, paid search, and programmatic advertising.

- 

Identify performance gaps, prioritize optimization opportunities, and implement improvements to drive measurable results.

- 

Translate business objectives into channel performance targets, KPIs, and execution guidelines.

- 

Establish testing strategies to evaluate new channels, ad formats, audience approaches, and measurement capabilities.

Campaign Management & Portfolio Oversight

- 

Oversee paid media investment across multiple products, campaigns, and business priorities.

- 

Manage campaign budgets, spending, pacing, and performance reporting.

- 

Develop and maintain a centralized paid media calendar covering campaigns, launches, and regional initiatives.

- 

Coordinate campaign timelines, resource allocation, and prioritization across concurrent workstreams.

Ad Technology, Tracking & Measurement

- 

Oversee campaign trafficking, tracking implementation, conversion APIs, pixels, UTM governance, and naming conventions.

- 

Establish campaign quality assurance standards to ensure accurate tracking, targeting, and measurement.

- 

Manage audience segmentation, activation, governance, and ongoing optimization.

- 

Partner with marketing technology and operations teams to support advertising platform integrations, CRM connectivity, and marketing data flows.

- 

Identify and resolve technical or measurement challenges impacting campaign performance.

Testing, Analytics & Performance Reporting

- 

Design and execute structured testing roadmaps with defined success criteria.

- 

Analyze campaign effectiveness, audience performance, bidding strategies, creative performance, and conversion optimization.

- 

Provide actionable performance reporting covering campaign efficiency, budget pacing, lead generation, and pipeline contribution.

- 

Translate performance data into strategic recommendations for marketing leadership and cross functional stakeholders.

- 

Develop best practices, benchmarks, and playbooks to improve campaign effectiveness.

Cross Functional Collaboration & Agency Management

- 

Partner with integrated marketing, product marketing, marketing operations, analytics, web, SEO/SEM, and organic social teams.

- 

Align paid media initiatives with broader marketing strategies and business objectives.

- 

Oversee agency and vendor execution, including campaign briefs, timelines, deliverables, quality standards, and service expectations.

- 

Support account based marketing (ABM) initiatives, including account list activation and targeted media campaigns.

- 

Coordinate regional campaigns while maintaining consistent brand standards and measurement practices.

## Required Qualifications

- 

8+ years of paid media experience with direct ownership of channel strategy, roadmaps, and performance.

- 

Extensive experience managing paid social advertising at scale, with working knowledge of paid search and programmatic advertising.

- 

Strong technical expertise in campaign trafficking, conversion tracking, pixels, conversion APIs, UTM parameters, audience onboarding, and campaign QA.

- 

Experience managing paid media calendars, competing priorities, budgets, and resources across multiple stakeholders.

- 

Demonstrated success developing and executing structured testing and optimization strategies.

- 

Hands on experience collaborating with marketing technology and marketing operations teams on system integrations, marketing data flows, and campaign measurement.

- 

Experience overseeing external advertising agencies or vendors, managing deliverables and performance expectations.

- 

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and communicate actionable insights to leadership.

- 

Excellent organizational, project management, and written communication skills.

- 

Ability to operate independently in a dynamic, fast paced environment with evolving priorities.

## Preferred Qualifications

- 

Experience in enterprise B2B technology marketing, particularly AI, SaaS, cloud computing, or technology platforms.

- 

Experience managing paid media portfolios across multiple products, business units, or regions.

- 

Strong understanding of integrated marketing strategies connecting paid media, organic social, website performance, and search.

- 

Familiarity with marketing automation platforms, CRM systems, and lead to pipeline attribution.

- 

Experience establishing audience governance frameworks, tracking standards, or campaign taxonomy.

- 

Experience supporting account based marketing (ABM) campaigns and account level targeting.

- 

Experience managing advertising budgets across multiple regions or currencies.

- 

Background working within large, complex technology organizations or rapidly evolving marketing teams.

## Ideal Candidate Profile

The strongest candidate is a strategic, technically sophisticated paid media leader who combines hands on channel expertise with broader portfolio management capabilities.

This individual understands how to scale paid social campaigns, optimize advertising infrastructure, implement rigorous measurement standards, and coordinate multiple marketing initiatives simultaneously.

Candidates with primarily brand marketing, creative strategy, or content marketing experience without substantial paid media ownership are unlikely to align with the requirements of this position.

Join an innovative enterprise technology marketing organization during a period of significant growth and transformation. This role offers the opportunity to shape paid media strategy, develop scalable marketing operations, collaborate with cross functional teams, and directly influence enterprise marketing performance.

Location: Remote (NY preferred)

Role type: Contract 12 Month Position (up to a 30 month contract w/potential to convert to FTE)

Expected hours: 40 per week 

Benefits:

- Dental insurance

- Health insurance

- Health savings account

- Life insurance

- Paid time off

- Retirement plan

- Vision insurance

Schedule:

- 8 hour shift

- Monday to Friday

Application Question(s):

- Do you or will you in the future require any sponsorship to work in the US?

Language:

- English  (Required)

# ![](https://app.gusto.com/companies/0afe5a87-a643-485f-9471-d2c2e2da6131/logo?v=1774531565)    Allure Security TalentMarketing Manager, Campaigns  Remote  ·   Full time  [Company website](https://alluresecurity.com/)    [Apply for Marketing Manager, Campaigns](https://jobs.gusto.com/postings/allure-security-talent-marketing-manager-campaigns-74297c7f-a912-4902-985d-84df9bfd16d1/applicants/new)

This is a hands-on role at the center of how Allure turns marketing investment into pipeline. You'll own our paid programs on Google, Bing, and LinkedIn, build and run our email campaigns in HubSpot, and design the nurture programs that turn content engagement into sales conversations. The strategy, the execution, and the numbers all live in this seat. You'll report to the Head of Demand Generation and work closely with our sales and BDR teams. This is an individual contributor role with broad scope and a direct line to revenue.

### About Allure Security Talent

Account Takeover Fraud costs businesses nearly 7 Billion a year.

We address the root cause.

Our AI catches the scams that other vendors miss by visually examining millions of sites every day to detect online impersonation of your brand. Our solution finds credential theft (phishing), identity theft, payment data theft, personal information theft, and content re-publishing; and responds to mitigate the risk before your customers and your brand become victims.

Our unique deception technology takes the fight back to the scammers. We stop them in their tracks by injecting realistic decoy data right into their attack sites. That breaks the scammers’ business model and helps to expose their real identities. Allure also provides best-in-class traditional responses via automated takedowns and blocklisting and a through our seasoned takedown team.

### Description

## **What You'll Do**

## **Own paid search and paid social**

Run our Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and LinkedIn campaigns end to end: account structure, keywords, bidding, audiences, ad copy, and conversion tracking. These channels need regular, hands-on attention, and keeping that rhythm is a core part of this job. You'll manage the budget, test relentlessly, and drive awareness and pipeline more efficiently every month.

## **Build and run email campaigns and nurture programs**

Take email programs from idea to send: new asset launches, post-event follow-ups, and topical nurture tracks triggered by what people engage with (someone downloads our retail fraud guide, a short retail-specific sequence kicks off to help them raise their hand). You'll shape the touches, sharpen the copy, and build the campaigns yourself, including segmentation, workflows, emails, forms, and landing pages. You'll help build the narratives and stories that connect our product to the people we serve, measure what converts, and bring your own ideas for what we should build next.

## **Own the goals and the reporting**

Set channel-level targets, own them publicly, and report on performance against pipeline, not just clicks. You'll build the reporting rhythm that tells us what's working, what isn't, and where the next dollar should go.

# **What You'll Bring (Requirements)**

- 3 to 5 years of hands-on digital marketing campaign ownership
- Direct experience managing Google Ads and LinkedIn campaigns, including budget ownership and optimization
- **The ability to build campaigns in HubSpot yourself**: segmentation, workflows, nurture logic, emails, forms, and landing pages
- Working familiarity with Salesforce: campaigns, reporting, and how marketing activity connects to pipeline
- A track record of setting targets and hitting them, with the reporting to prove it
- Startup pace. You've worked somewhere lean, you self-start, and you don't wait for a brief
- **Comfort working with AI tools as part of your daily workflow, and curiosity about doing more with them**
- Clear, direct communication. You can explain what happened, why, and what you're doing about it in plain language
- Comfort across our stack: HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Semrush, GA4, Claude

# **Bonus Points**

- Experience marketing to security, fraud, or risk buyers
- SEO/SEM experience, and familiarity with where search is heading (GEO/AEO)
- Experience managing external agencies or vendors
- You don't need to come from cybersecurity. Some of the best ideas in our space are going to come from outside it.

# **What We Offer**

- Competitive base salary with performance-based incentive
- Equity in a growing cybersecurity company
- Medical, dental, and vision coverage
- 401(k) with company match
- Flexible PTO and paid company holidays
- Fully remote work environment
- A high-trust, low-ego team that ships and celebrates wins together
- Real room to grow: this role's scope will expand as the company does

[Apply for Marketing Manager, Campaigns](https://jobs.gusto.com/postings/allure-security-talent-marketing-manager-campaigns-74297c7f-a912-4902-985d-84df9bfd16d1/applicants/new)

## What You'll Do

## Build and run email campaigns and nurture programs

## Own the goals and the reporting

# What You'll Bring (Requirements)

- The ability to build campaigns in HubSpot yourself: segmentation, workflows, nurture logic, emails, forms, and landing pages

- Comfort working with AI tools as part of your daily workflow, and curiosity about doing more with them

# Bonus Points

# What We Offer
