# Founding Performance Marketing Lead

## Location

United States

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Remote

## Department

Marketing

**About Neuroscale**

Neuroscale AI is building an AI Recruiting Operating System - one unified platform for the talent organization, from first touch through evaluation and hire. Our flagship platform, Arbi, helps companies discover, engage, screen, and evaluate talent at scale using AI-native intelligence, automation, and data. We have invested deeply in the product. Now we are building the repeatable growth engine that brings it to market.

**About the Role**

We are hiring a Founding Performance Marketing Lead to own performance and growth marketing from the ground up. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to build the machine - not inherit one.

You will own the path from first impression to click to conversion to qualified pipeline to closed ARR. That includes paid acquisition, creative testing, landing pages, attribution, funnel instrumentation, conversion-rate optimization, audience discovery, and early product-led growth experiments.

You will work directly with Neuroscale's founders and partner closely with Product, Design, Sales, and Revenue Operations. You will have the autonomy to test quickly, scale what works, stop what does not, and turn learning into repeatable playbooks.

**What You'll Own**

1\. Build and scale the paid acquisition engine

Launch, manage, and optimize acquisition across LinkedIn, Meta, Google, retargeting, and emerging channels. Personally manage meaningful media spend and make channel decisions based on pipeline quality, acquisition economics, and revenue - not vanity metrics.

2\. Turn creative into a growth system

Build a high-velocity testing engine across short-form video, UGC, founder-led creative, static ads, customer proof, use-case creative, case studies, and landing-page concepts. Develop a repeatable process for creative briefs, production, testing, learning, and iteration.

3\. Own the conversion funnel

Build and continuously improve the journey from ad to landing page to demo or trial to activation. Create and ship landing pages without waiting on a large web team, and work with Product and Design to remove friction from high-intent conversion paths.

4\. Make measurement and attribution decision-grade

Own campaign tracking, UTMs, pixels, events, conversion APIs, CRM campaign logic, attribution models, dashboards, and funnel reporting. Create a clear view of what is producing qualified pipeline, what is wasting spend, and where conversion is breaking down.

5\. Run a disciplined experimentation program

Design and execute continuous A/B and multivariate tests across hooks, creative, copy, audiences, offers, landing pages, CTAs, forms, demo flows, and channel mix. Maintain an experiment backlog and use data to decide what to scale, iterate, or kill.

6\. Discover and codify our best audiences

Identify the ICP signals, personas, use cases, pain points, messages, offers, and targeting strategies that consistently produce high-quality opportunities. Turn those findings into reusable audience and messaging playbooks for Marketing and Sales.

7\. Help shape product-led growth

Partner with Product and Revenue on activation, self-serve conversion, trial-to-paid pathways, in-product prompts, lifecycle nudges, and other early PLG loops that can complement the sales-led motion.

8\. Automate for leverage

Use AI, no-code/low-code tools, enrichment, workflow automation, and light scripting to increase testing velocity and reduce repetitive work. Build a marketing operating system that can test 20 thoughtful ideas where a traditional team might test two.

**The Numbers You'll Care About**

1. Qualified Pipeline

2. CAC / CAC Payback

3. CPL / Cost per Qualified Lead

4. ARR Sourced / Influenced

5. Conversion Rate

6. LTV / CAC

7. Pipeline Velocity

8. Experiment Win Rate


Clicks, CTR, engagement, and reach matter only when they help explain the economics of acquiring customers and creating revenue.

**Who We're Looking For**

- 4-8+ years of hands-on performance marketing, growth marketing, or demand generation experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, AI, HR Tech, recruiting technology, or another high-growth technology category.

- A track record of personally managing and scaling approximately $50K-$250K+ per month in paid media across LinkedIn, Meta, Google, or comparable channels - and translating that spend into qualified pipeline and revenue.

- Deep hands-on experience inside ad platforms. You can build campaigns, audiences, conversion tracking, creative tests, budgets, bids, and optimization logic yourself.

- Demonstrated ability to connect channel spend to downstream funnel performance, opportunity creation, pipeline, and ARR.

- Strong command of funnel economics, including CPL, CAC, LTV, CAC payback, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and marginal acquisition efficiency.

- Experience building and improving landing pages, forms, demo flows, or trial experiences with a strong CRO mindset.

- Strong creative instincts and copy judgment. You can diagnose why a message or creative concept is working - not merely report that CTR changed.

- Experience testing video, UGC, creator-led, founder-led, or short-form paid creative.

- Comfort with analytics, dashboards, CRM data, experimentation, attribution, and imperfect early-stage datasets.

- Ability to move quickly from hypothesis to launch to data to insight to the next test.

- Strong written communication and the ability to translate customer pain into clear, high-converting messaging.

- A builder mentality: high ownership, low ego, strong judgment, and a preference for creating the playbook rather than waiting for one.


**Bonus Points If You Have**

- Built performance marketing from near-zero at an early-stage or high-growth B2B SaaS company.

- Scaled one or more paid channels into a predictable source of qualified pipeline while maintaining disciplined acquisition economics.

- Experience in HR Tech, recruiting technology, AI, developer tools, enterprise SaaS, or another complex B2B category.

- Built a UGC, creator, customer-proof, or founder-led creative program that materially improved paid performance.

- Hands-on experience with platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce; Webflow or Framer; GA4; Segment; Mixpanel or Amplitude; Clay; Zapier or Make; and modern attribution or ad-tracking tools.

- Built lightweight automations, scripts, dashboards, or AI-assisted workflows yourself.

- Worked with Product teams on PLG, free-trial, self-service, lifecycle, or activation experiments.

- Used AI tools systematically to accelerate research, creative production, analysis, personalization, and experimentation.


**You'll Thrive Here If**

- You want meaningful ownership and are energized by a blank sheet of paper.

- You enjoy being in the campaigns, creative, landing pages, dashboards, and funnel - not only managing vendors.

- You are comfortable being accountable for qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes.

- You prefer fast, instrumented experiments over long planning cycles.

- You can balance speed with analytical rigor and know when the data is strong enough to act.

- You are resourceful and can ship with a small team while building systems that scale.


**What Success Looks Like**

- A repeatable paid acquisition engine is producing qualified demand at increasingly predictable economics.

- Campaign-to-CRM attribution provides a credible view from spend through opportunity, pipeline, and revenue.

- Creative and landing-page experiments are shipping every week with documented learnings.

- Neuroscale has a clear picture of its highest-converting ICPs, personas, messages, offers, and channel combinations.

- Landing-page, demo/trial, and funnel conversion rates are improving through systematic experimentation.

- CAC and payback are understood by channel and audience, with clear thresholds for scaling spend.

- A measurable content and creative engine supports paid acquisition rather than operating as a separate activity stream.

- Marketing, Product, Sales, and Revenue Operations share a common funnel definition and growth scorecard.

- A documented growth playbook compounds as spend, headcount, and market coverage increase.


**Why Neuroscale**

**Build at the moment growth becomes the priority.** The product foundation is in place. The opportunity now is to build the acquisition engine that can turn strong technology into a category-defining company.

**Founding-level ownership.** You will not be optimizing someone else's mature playbook. The systems, experiments, and operating cadence you create can become the foundation of Neuroscale's future growth organization.

**Direct access to the founders.** Work closely with company leadership with very little organizational friction between a strong idea and testing it in market.

**AI-native environment.** You will market an AI company inside a team that expects AI to be embedded in how research, creative, analysis, automation, and decision-making get done.

**High autonomy with clear accountability.** This is a high-trust role for someone who wants the freedom to move quickly and the responsibility to own measurable outcomes.

**A path to broader growth leadership.** This role is designed to expand with results, with a fast path toward Head of Growth as the company scales.

**The Opportunity**

Most performance marketing roles ask you to improve an existing engine by 10-20%. This role gives you the chance to build the engine.

The campaigns you launch, audiences you discover, creative systems you create, attribution infrastructure you establish, and growth loops you uncover can define how Neuroscale acquires customers for years.

**Compensation & Growth**

This is a founding-level, high-impact role with compensation designed to align with measurable growth and long-term value creation. Specific base compensation, performance incentives, equity or long-term participation, and benefits will be discussed with qualified candidates and finalized based on experience, location, and employment structure.

The role is designed to create a path toward broader Head of Growth leadership as Neuroscale scales.

**How We Hire**

We value evidence of outcomes over polished marketing language. Strong candidates should be prepared to walk through campaigns they personally built, the economics behind them, what they tested, what failed, what they changed, and how those decisions affected pipeline or revenue.

- Introductory conversation focused on fit, ownership, and growth-stage experience.

- Deep dive into one or two performance programs you personally operated.

- Practical working session or case discussion focused on audience, creative, funnel, and measurement strategy.

- Final conversation with the founders on scope, operating style, and growth mandate.


**Equal Opportunity**

Neuroscale AI is committed to building a team based on capability, potential, and impact. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates who need them during the hiring process.

4. Make measurement and attribution decision-grade

5. Run a disciplined experimentation program

6. Discover and codify our best audiences

7. Help shape product-led growth

8. Automate for leverage

Now we are building the repeatable growth engine that brings it to market.

About the Role

We are hiring a Founding Performance Marketing Lead to own performance and growth marketing from the ground up. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to build the machine - not inherit one.

You will own the path from first impression to click to conversion to qualified pipeline to closed ARR. That includes paid acquisition, creative testing, landing pages, attribution, funnel instrumentation, conversion-rate optimization, audience discovery, and early product-led growth experiments.

You will work directly with Neuroscale's founders and partner closely with Product, Design, Sales, and Revenue Operations. You will have the autonomy to test quickly, scale what works, stop what does not, and turn learning into repeatable playbooks.

What You'll Own

1. Build and scale the paid acquisition engine

Launch, manage, and optimize acquisition across LinkedIn, Meta, Google, retargeting, and emerging channels. Personally manage meaningful media spend and make channel decisions based on pipeline quality, acquisition economics, and revenue - not vanity metrics.

2. Turn creative into a growth system

Build a high-velocity testing engine across short-form video, UGC, founder-led creative, static ads, customer proof, use-case creative, case studies, and landing-page concepts. Develop a repeatable process for creative briefs, production, testing, learning, and iteration.

3. Own the conversion funnel

Build and continuously improve the journey from ad to landing page to demo or trial to activation. Create and ship landing pages without waiting on a large web team, and work with Product and Design to remove friction from high-intent conversion paths.

4. Make measurement and attribution decision-grade

Own campaign tracking, UTMs, pixels, events, conversion APIs, CRM campaign logic, attribution models, dashboards, and funnel reporting. Create a clear view of what is producing qualified pipeline, what is wasting spend, and where conversion is breaking down.

5. Run a disciplined experimentation program

Design and execute continuous A/B and multivariate tests across hooks, creative, copy, audiences, offers, landing pages, CTAs, forms, demo flows, and channel mix. Maintain an experiment backlog and use data to decide what to scale, iterate, or kill.

6. Discover and codify our best audiences

Identify the ICP signals, personas, use cases, pain points, messages, offers, and targeting strategies that consistently produce high-quality opportunities. Turn those findings into reusable audience and messaging playbooks for Marketing and Sales.

7. Help shape product-led growth

Partner with Product and Revenue on activation, self-serve conversion, trial-to-paid pathways, in-product prompts, lifecycle nudges, and other early PLG loops that can complement the sales-led motion.

8. Automate for leverage

Use AI, no-code/low-code tools, enrichment, workflow automation, and light scripting to increase testing velocity and reduce repetitive work. Build a marketing operating system that can test 20 thoughtful ideas where a traditional team might test two.

The Numbers You'll Care About

  1. Qualified Pipeline

  2. CAC / CAC Payback

  3. CPL / Cost per Qualified Lead

  4. ARR Sourced / Influenced

  5. Conversion Rate

  6. LTV / CAC

  7. Pipeline Velocity

  8. Experiment Win Rate

Clicks, CTR, engagement, and reach matter only when they help explain the economics of acquiring customers and creating revenue.

Who We're Looking For

  • 4-8+ years of hands-on performance marketing, growth marketing, or demand generation experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, AI, HR Tech, recruiting technology, or another high-growth technology category.

  • A track record of personally managing and scaling approximately $50K-$250K+ per month in paid media across LinkedIn, Meta, Google, or comparable channels - and translating that spend into qualified pipeline and revenue.

  • Deep hands-on experience inside ad platforms. You can build campaigns, audiences, conversion tracking, creative tests, budgets, bids, and optimization logic yourself.

  • Demonstrated ability to connect channel spend to downstream funnel performance, opportunity creation, pipeline, and ARR.

  • Strong command of funnel economics, including CPL, CAC, LTV, CAC payback, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and marginal acquisition efficiency.

  • Experience building and improving landing pages, forms, demo flows, or trial experiences with a strong CRO mindset.

  • Strong creative instincts and copy judgment. You can diagnose why a message or creative concept is working - not merely report that CTR changed.

  • Experience testing video, UGC, creator-led, founder-led, or short-form paid creative.

  • Comfort with analytics, dashboards, CRM data, experimentation, attribution, and imperfect early-stage datasets.

  • Ability to move quickly from hypothesis to launch to data to insight to the next test.

  • Strong written communication and the ability to translate customer pain into clear, high-converting messaging.

  • A builder mentality: high ownership, low ego, strong judgment, and a preference for creating the playbook rather than waiting for one.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Built performance marketing from near-zero at an early-stage or high-growth B2B SaaS company.

  • Scaled one or more paid channels into a predictable source of qualified pipeline while maintaining disciplined acquisition economics.

  • Experience in HR Tech, recruiting technology, AI, developer tools, enterprise SaaS, or another complex B2B category.

  • Built a UGC, creator, customer-proof, or founder-led creative program that materially improved paid performance.

  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce; Webflow or Framer; GA4; Segment; Mixpanel or Amplitude; Clay; Zapier or Make; and modern attribution or ad-tracking tools.

  • Built lightweight automations, scripts, dashboards, or AI-assisted workflows yourself.

  • Worked with Product teams on PLG, free-trial, self-service, lifecycle, or activation experiments.

  • Used AI tools systematically to accelerate research, creative production, analysis, personalization, and experimentation.

You'll Thrive Here If

  • You want meaningful ownership and are energized by a blank sheet of paper.

  • You enjoy being in the campaigns, creative, landing pages, dashboards, and funnel - not only managing vendors.

  • You are comfortable being accountable for qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes.

  • You prefer fast, instrumented experiments over long planning cycles.

  • You can balance speed with analytical rigor and know when the data is strong enough to act.

  • You are resourceful and can ship with a small team while building systems that scale.

What Success Looks Like

  • A repeatable paid acquisition engine is producing qualified demand at increasingly predictable economics.

  • Campaign-to-CRM attribution provides a credible view from spend through opportunity, pipeline, and revenue.

  • Creative and landing-page experiments are shipping every week with documented learnings.

  • Neuroscale has a clear picture of its highest-converting ICPs, personas, messages, offers, and channel combinations.

  • Landing-page, demo/trial, and funnel conversion rates are improving through systematic experimentation.

  • CAC and payback are understood by channel and audience, with clear thresholds for scaling spend.

  • A measurable content and creative engine supports paid acquisition rather than operating as a separate activity stream.

  • Marketing, Product, Sales, and Revenue Operations share a common funnel definition and growth scorecard.

  • A documented growth playbook compounds as spend, headcount, and market coverage increase.

Build at the moment growth becomes the priority. The product foundation is in place. The opportunity now is to build the acquisition engine that can turn strong technology into a category-defining company.

Founding-level ownership. You will not be optimizing someone else's mature playbook. The systems, experiments, and operating cadence you create can become the foundation of Neuroscale's future growth organization.

AI-native environment. You will market an AI company inside a team that expects AI to be embedded in how research, creative, analysis, automation, and decision-making get done.

# Founding Performance Marketing Lead

## Location

United States

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Remote

## Department

Marketing

**About Neuroscale**

Neuroscale AI is building an AI Recruiting Operating System - one unified platform for the talent organization, from first touch through evaluation and hire. Our flagship platform, Arbi, helps companies discover, engage, screen, and evaluate talent at scale using AI-native intelligence, automation, and data. We have invested deeply in the product. Now we are building the repeatable growth engine that brings it to market.

**About the Role**

We are hiring a Founding Performance Marketing Lead to own performance and growth marketing from the ground up. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to build the machine - not inherit one.

You will own the path from first impression to click to conversion to qualified pipeline to closed ARR. That includes paid acquisition, creative testing, landing pages, attribution, funnel instrumentation, conversion-rate optimization, audience discovery, and early product-led growth experiments.

You will work directly with Neuroscale's founders and partner closely with Product, Design, Sales, and Revenue Operations. You will have the autonomy to test quickly, scale what works, stop what does not, and turn learning into repeatable playbooks.

**What You'll Own**

1\. Build and scale the paid acquisition engine

Launch, manage, and optimize acquisition across LinkedIn, Meta, Google, retargeting, and emerging channels. Personally manage meaningful media spend and make channel decisions based on pipeline quality, acquisition economics, and revenue - not vanity metrics.

2\. Turn creative into a growth system

Build a high-velocity testing engine across short-form video, UGC, founder-led creative, static ads, customer proof, use-case creative, case studies, and landing-page concepts. Develop a repeatable process for creative briefs, production, testing, learning, and iteration.

3\. Own the conversion funnel

Build and continuously improve the journey from ad to landing page to demo or trial to activation. Create and ship landing pages without waiting on a large web team, and work with Product and Design to remove friction from high-intent conversion paths.

4\. Make measurement and attribution decision-grade

Own campaign tracking, UTMs, pixels, events, conversion APIs, CRM campaign logic, attribution models, dashboards, and funnel reporting. Create a clear view of what is producing qualified pipeline, what is wasting spend, and where conversion is breaking down.

5\. Run a disciplined experimentation program

Design and execute continuous A/B and multivariate tests across hooks, creative, copy, audiences, offers, landing pages, CTAs, forms, demo flows, and channel mix. Maintain an experiment backlog and use data to decide what to scale, iterate, or kill.

6\. Discover and codify our best audiences

Identify the ICP signals, personas, use cases, pain points, messages, offers, and targeting strategies that consistently produce high-quality opportunities. Turn those findings into reusable audience and messaging playbooks for Marketing and Sales.

7\. Help shape product-led growth

Partner with Product and Revenue on activation, self-serve conversion, trial-to-paid pathways, in-product prompts, lifecycle nudges, and other early PLG loops that can complement the sales-led motion.

8\. Automate for leverage

Use AI, no-code/low-code tools, enrichment, workflow automation, and light scripting to increase testing velocity and reduce repetitive work. Build a marketing operating system that can test 20 thoughtful ideas where a traditional team might test two.

**The Numbers You'll Care About**

1. Qualified Pipeline

2. CAC / CAC Payback

3. CPL / Cost per Qualified Lead

4. ARR Sourced / Influenced

5. Conversion Rate

6. LTV / CAC

7. Pipeline Velocity

8. Experiment Win Rate


Clicks, CTR, engagement, and reach matter only when they help explain the economics of acquiring customers and creating revenue.

**Who We're Looking For**

- 4-8+ years of hands-on performance marketing, growth marketing, or demand generation experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, AI, HR Tech, recruiting technology, or another high-growth technology category.

- A track record of personally managing and scaling approximately $50K-$250K+ per month in paid media across LinkedIn, Meta, Google, or comparable channels - and translating that spend into qualified pipeline and revenue.

- Deep hands-on experience inside ad platforms. You can build campaigns, audiences, conversion tracking, creative tests, budgets, bids, and optimization logic yourself.

- Demonstrated ability to connect channel spend to downstream funnel performance, opportunity creation, pipeline, and ARR.

- Strong command of funnel economics, including CPL, CAC, LTV, CAC payback, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and marginal acquisition efficiency.

- Experience building and improving landing pages, forms, demo flows, or trial experiences with a strong CRO mindset.

- Strong creative instincts and copy judgment. You can diagnose why a message or creative concept is working - not merely report that CTR changed.

- Experience testing video, UGC, creator-led, founder-led, or short-form paid creative.

- Comfort with analytics, dashboards, CRM data, experimentation, attribution, and imperfect early-stage datasets.

- Ability to move quickly from hypothesis to launch to data to insight to the next test.

- Strong written communication and the ability to translate customer pain into clear, high-converting messaging.

- A builder mentality: high ownership, low ego, strong judgment, and a preference for creating the playbook rather than waiting for one.


**Bonus Points If You Have**

- Built performance marketing from near-zero at an early-stage or high-growth B2B SaaS company.

- Scaled one or more paid channels into a predictable source of qualified pipeline while maintaining disciplined acquisition economics.

- Experience in HR Tech, recruiting technology, AI, developer tools, enterprise SaaS, or another complex B2B category.

- Built a UGC, creator, customer-proof, or founder-led creative program that materially improved paid performance.

- Hands-on experience with platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce; Webflow or Framer; GA4; Segment; Mixpanel or Amplitude; Clay; Zapier or Make; and modern attribution or ad-tracking tools.

- Built lightweight automations, scripts, dashboards, or AI-assisted workflows yourself.

- Worked with Product teams on PLG, free-trial, self-service, lifecycle, or activation experiments.

- Used AI tools systematically to accelerate research, creative production, analysis, personalization, and experimentation.


**You'll Thrive Here If**

- You want meaningful ownership and are energized by a blank sheet of paper.

- You enjoy being in the campaigns, creative, landing pages, dashboards, and funnel - not only managing vendors.

- You are comfortable being accountable for qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes.

- You prefer fast, instrumented experiments over long planning cycles.

- You can balance speed with analytical rigor and know when the data is strong enough to act.

- You are resourceful and can ship with a small team while building systems that scale.


**What Success Looks Like**

- A repeatable paid acquisition engine is producing qualified demand at increasingly predictable economics.

- Campaign-to-CRM attribution provides a credible view from spend through opportunity, pipeline, and revenue.

- Creative and landing-page experiments are shipping every week with documented learnings.

- Neuroscale has a clear picture of its highest-converting ICPs, personas, messages, offers, and channel combinations.

- Landing-page, demo/trial, and funnel conversion rates are improving through systematic experimentation.

- CAC and payback are understood by channel and audience, with clear thresholds for scaling spend.

- A measurable content and creative engine supports paid acquisition rather than operating as a separate activity stream.

- Marketing, Product, Sales, and Revenue Operations share a common funnel definition and growth scorecard.

- A documented growth playbook compounds as spend, headcount, and market coverage increase.


**Why Neuroscale**

**Build at the moment growth becomes the priority.** The product foundation is in place. The opportunity now is to build the acquisition engine that can turn strong technology into a category-defining company.

**Founding-level ownership.** You will not be optimizing someone else's mature playbook. The systems, experiments, and operating cadence you create can become the foundation of Neuroscale's future growth organization.

**Direct access to the founders.** Work closely with company leadership with very little organizational friction between a strong idea and testing it in market.

**AI-native environment.** You will market an AI company inside a team that expects AI to be embedded in how research, creative, analysis, automation, and decision-making get done.

**High autonomy with clear accountability.** This is a high-trust role for someone who wants the freedom to move quickly and the responsibility to own measurable outcomes.

**A path to broader growth leadership.** This role is designed to expand with results, with a fast path toward Head of Growth as the company scales.

**The Opportunity**

Most performance marketing roles ask you to improve an existing engine by 10-20%. This role gives you the chance to build the engine.

The campaigns you launch, audiences you discover, creative systems you create, attribution infrastructure you establish, and growth loops you uncover can define how Neuroscale acquires customers for years.

**Compensation & Growth**

This is a founding-level, high-impact role with compensation designed to align with measurable growth and long-term value creation. Specific base compensation, performance incentives, equity or long-term participation, and benefits will be discussed with qualified candidates and finalized based on experience, location, and employment structure.

The role is designed to create a path toward broader Head of Growth leadership as Neuroscale scales.

**How We Hire**

We value evidence of outcomes over polished marketing language. Strong candidates should be prepared to walk through campaigns they personally built, the economics behind them, what they tested, what failed, what they changed, and how those decisions affected pipeline or revenue.

- Introductory conversation focused on fit, ownership, and growth-stage experience.

- Deep dive into one or two performance programs you personally operated.

- Practical working session or case discussion focused on audience, creative, funnel, and measurement strategy.

- Final conversation with the founders on scope, operating style, and growth mandate.


**Equal Opportunity**

Neuroscale AI is committed to building a team based on capability, potential, and impact. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates who need them during the hiring process.

raw.title: Senior Director, Marketing Operations
raw.description:
Atlas HXM is the global workforce platform built on compliance. We help companies determine how to engage each member of their workforce and then execute with accountability built in — direct Employer of Record (EOR), Agent of Record (AOR), payroll, and compliance capabilities backed by a decade of practitioner-led expertise. Recognized as a category Leader by NelsonHall and Everest Group, Atlas HXM builds Human Experience Management into everything we do, guided by our "For People, by People" principle.

The future of work is borderless, and so are we. Our people are located around the globe — in the U.S., the UK, India, Colombia, China, and beyond. Diversity and belonging are not just values; they are who we are. 

We are also committed to making a positive impact. Through our Environment, Social, and Governance (ESG) impact initiative, we are addressing our environmental footprint and promoting social responsibility. Our impact program is central to our vision and culture, focusing on employee wellness, diversity, charitable work, and ethical corporate governance.

Reports To: Vice President, Global Growth Marketing

About the Role

       Our Company is seeking a strategic and results-driven Senior Director, Marketing Operations to lead the technology, automation, digital platforms, analytics, and operating processes that power our global marketing organization.

       Reporting to the Vice President, Global Growth Marketing, this role will build and optimize the infrastructure that enables Marketing to operate efficiently, deliver strong digital experiences, and connect marketing investments to measurable business outcomes.

       The Senior Director will own our marketing technology ecosystem, AI and automation strategy, website operations, data and measurement capabilities, and operational processes. This leader will partner closely with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Sales, Product, Technology, Data, Finance, and Legal to create a scalable, data-driven marketing organization.

       The ideal candidate combines strategic leadership with strong technical and operational expertise and is equally comfortable advising executives, leading transformation, and turning technology and data into measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Operations & Technology

- Develop and lead the global Marketing Operations strategy, operating model, and roadmap aligned with business priorities.

- Establish scalable processes, governance, workflows, and performance standards across Marketing.

- Own the marketing technology ecosystem, including CRM, marketing automation, digital platforms, analytics, customer data, and systems integrations.

 

- Evaluate and optimize technology investments, system performance, adoption, and ROI.

- Lead major technology implementations and operational transformation initiatives.

- Build and lead a high-performing Digital Marketing & Operations team.

AI & Automation

- Develop and execute Marketing’s AI and automation roadmap in alignment with the broader enterprise AI strategy.

- Identify and implement opportunities to automate campaign execution, lead management, reporting, content operations, and customer lifecycle activities.

- Establish governance and measurement for AI and automation solutions.

- Lead the process redesign and change management needed to embed new technologies and ways of working.

Website & Digital Experience

- Provide strategic leadership for website operations and the broader digital experience function.

- Own prioritization of the website roadmap based on acquisition, conversion, pipeline, and customer experience goals.

- Establish governance for website access, releases, quality assurance, and experimentation.

- Define the testing and optimization strategy and measure the business impact of digital investments.

Analytics, Data & Measurement

- Lead Marketing’s measurement, attribution, analytics, and reporting strategy.

- Establish executive dashboards, KPIs, and performance review processes that connect marketing activity to pipeline, revenue, and ROI.

- Partner with Revenue Operations, Finance, Data, and Technology to improve forecasting, customer insights, and decision-making.

- Establish standards for marketing data quality, governance, privacy, security, and appropriate use.

- Build the data foundation required for segmentation, personalization, targeting, and lifecycle marketing.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Business Management

- Serve as a senior partner across Marketing, Revenue Operations, Sales, Product, Technology, Data, Finance, and Legal.

- Align marketing technology, digital, data, and operational priorities with broader commercial objectives.

- Influence senior stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, and drive cross-functional initiatives to successful outcomes.

- Own the Marketing Operations and Technology budget and manage key technology providers, agencies, and implementation partners.

- Develop business cases and investment recommendations for future technology and operational initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems, Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.

- 12+ years of progressive experience in Marketing Operations, Marketing Technology, Digital Marketing, Revenue Operations, or related disciplines.

- 7+ years of leadership experience, including responsibility for global or enterprise-level teams, functions, or programs.

- Deep expertise in marketing automation, CRM, website technologies, analytics, customer data, systems integrations, and marketing technology environments.

- Demonstrated experience building marketing operating models, technology strategies, governance frameworks, and roadmaps.

- Experience implementing AI, automation, and workflow solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

- Strong experience leading complex technology investments and transformation initiatives.

- Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget management and business case development.

- Ability to influence executive leaders and align cross-functional stakeholders around complex priorities.

- Experience working effectively in a global, fully remote environment.

Preferred

- Experience in a global SaaS, technology, or high-growth organization.

- Experience modernizing a Marketing Operations function or leading a significant marketing technology transformation.

- Experience implementing AI and automation across multiple marketing disciplines.

- Experience overseeing complex websites and digital platforms.

- Experience developing marketing attribution, forecasting, and investment measurement capabilities.

- Experience managing global technology providers, agencies, and implementation partners.

This position description may not describe all duties, responsibilities, and skills associated with this position. It is intended to portray the major aspects of the job. Other duties or skills may be required.

What We Offer 

- The opportunity to work with a purpose — simplifying global expansion across borders and cultures

- A diverse and inclusive environment

- Country-specific benefits

- Flexible PTO

- Your birthday off and a day for you to volunteer and give back to the organization of your choice

- Generous Parental Leave Program

- Growth and development opportunities with access to a top learning content provider

- The opportunity to challenge yourself in a high-performing organization and leave each day knowing you have made an impact.

Atlas Technology Solutions, Inc. (Atlas HXM) is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind: Atlas HXM is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Atlas HXM are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Atlas HXM will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Atlas HXM encourages applicants of all ages.

Atlas HXM will provide accommodation on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities.

Hiring decisions are based upon Atlas HXM’s operating needs, and applicant merit including, but not limited to, qualifications, experience, ability, availability, and location.

This role will be subject to a background check under local law after an employment offer has been made. Employment may be subject to results. In addition, references may be requested at the final stage of the process.

Atlas HXM will only email candidates from an “@atlashxm.com” email address. Candidates should ignore communications purporting to be from Atlas HXM that originate from any other email address. Atlas HXM will never ask candidates or employees to purchase gift cards or otherwise make payments in connection with applying for a job with Atlas HXM.

Atlas HXM is the global workforce platform built on compliance. We help companies determine how to engage each member of their workforce and then execute with accountability built in — direct Employer of Record (EOR), Agent of Record (AOR), payroll, and compliance capabilities backed by a decade of practitioner-led expertise. Recognized as a category Leader by NelsonHall and Everest Group, Atlas HXM builds Human Experience Management into everything we do, guided by our "For People, by People" principle.

The future of work is borderless, and so are we. Our people are located around the globe — in the U.S., the UK, India, Colombia, China, and beyond. Diversity and belonging are not just values; they are who we are. 

We are also committed to making a positive impact. Through our Environment, Social, and Governance (ESG) impact initiative, we are addressing our environmental footprint and promoting social responsibility. Our impact program is central to our vision and culture, focusing on employee wellness, diversity, charitable work, and ethical corporate governance.

Reports To: Vice President, Global Growth Marketing

About the Role

       Our Company is seeking a strategic and results-driven Senior Director, Marketing Operations to lead the technology, automation, digital platforms, analytics, and operating processes that power our global marketing organization.

       Reporting to the Vice President, Global Growth Marketing, this role will build and optimize the infrastructure that enables Marketing to operate efficiently, deliver strong digital experiences, and connect marketing investments to measurable business outcomes.

       The Senior Director will own our marketing technology ecosystem, AI and automation strategy, website operations, data and measurement capabilities, and operational processes. This leader will partner closely with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Sales, Product, Technology, Data, Finance, and Legal to create a scalable, data-driven marketing organization.

       The ideal candidate combines strategic leadership with strong technical and operational expertise and is equally comfortable advising executives, leading transformation, and turning technology and data into measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Operations & Technology

- Develop and lead the global Marketing Operations strategy, operating model, and roadmap aligned with business priorities.

- Establish scalable processes, governance, workflows, and performance standards across Marketing.

- Own the marketing technology ecosystem, including CRM, marketing automation, digital platforms, analytics, customer data, and systems integrations.

 

- Evaluate and optimize technology investments, system performance, adoption, and ROI.

- Lead major technology implementations and operational transformation initiatives.

- Build and lead a high-performing Digital Marketing & Operations team.

AI & Automation

- Develop and execute Marketing’s AI and automation roadmap in alignment with the broader enterprise AI strategy.

- Identify and implement opportunities to automate campaign execution, lead management, reporting, content operations, and customer lifecycle activities.

- Establish governance and measurement for AI and automation solutions.

- Lead the process redesign and change management needed to embed new technologies and ways of working.

Website & Digital Experience

- Provide strategic leadership for website operations and the broader digital experience function.

- Own prioritization of the website roadmap based on acquisition, conversion, pipeline, and customer experience goals.

- Establish governance for website access, releases, quality assurance, and experimentation.

- Define the testing and optimization strategy and measure the business impact of digital investments.

Analytics, Data & Measurement

- Lead Marketing’s measurement, attribution, analytics, and reporting strategy.

- Establish executive dashboards, KPIs, and performance review processes that connect marketing activity to pipeline, revenue, and ROI.

- Partner with Revenue Operations, Finance, Data, and Technology to improve forecasting, customer insights, and decision-making.

- Establish standards for marketing data quality, governance, privacy, security, and appropriate use.

- Build the data foundation required for segmentation, personalization, targeting, and lifecycle marketing.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Business Management

- Serve as a senior partner across Marketing, Revenue Operations, Sales, Product, Technology, Data, Finance, and Legal.

- Align marketing technology, digital, data, and operational priorities with broader commercial objectives.

- Influence senior stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, and drive cross-functional initiatives to successful outcomes.

- Own the Marketing Operations and Technology budget and manage key technology providers, agencies, and implementation partners.

- Develop business cases and investment recommendations for future technology and operational initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems, Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.

- 12+ years of progressive experience in Marketing Operations, Marketing Technology, Digital Marketing, Revenue Operations, or related disciplines.

- 7+ years of leadership experience, including responsibility for global or enterprise-level teams, functions, or programs.

- Deep expertise in marketing automation, CRM, website technologies, analytics, customer data, systems integrations, and marketing technology environments.

- Demonstrated experience building marketing operating models, technology strategies, governance frameworks, and roadmaps.

- Experience implementing AI, automation, and workflow solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

- Strong experience leading complex technology investments and transformation initiatives.

- Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget management and business case development.

- Ability to influence executive leaders and align cross-functional stakeholders around complex priorities.

- Experience working effectively in a global, fully remote environment.

Preferred

- Experience in a global SaaS, technology, or high-growth organization.

- Experience modernizing a Marketing Operations function or leading a significant marketing technology transformation.

- Experience implementing AI and automation across multiple marketing disciplines.

- Experience overseeing complex websites and digital platforms.

- Experience developing marketing attribution, forecasting, and investment measurement capabilities.

- Experience managing global technology providers, agencies, and implementation partners.

- A diverse and inclusive environment

- Country-specific benefits

- Generous Parental Leave Program

- Growth and development opportunities with access to a top learning content provider

- The opportunity to challenge yourself in a high-performing organization and leave each day knowing you have made an impact.

Atlas HXM is the global workforce platform built on compliance. We help companies determine how to engage each member of their workforce and then execute with accountability built in — direct Employer of Record (EOR), Agent of Record (AOR), payroll, and compliance capabilities backed by a decade of practitioner-led expertise. Recognized as a category Leader by NelsonHall and Everest Group, Atlas HXM builds Human Experience Management into everything we do, guided by our "For People, by People" principle.

The future of work is borderless, and so are we. Our people are located around the globe — in the U.S., the UK, India, Colombia, China, and beyond. Diversity and belonging are not just values; they are who we are. 

We are also committed to making a positive impact. Through our Environment, Social, and Governance (ESG) impact initiative, we are addressing our environmental footprint and promoting social responsibility. Our impact program is central to our vision and culture, focusing on employee wellness, diversity, charitable work, and ethical corporate governance.

Reports To: Vice President, Global Growth Marketing

About the Role

       Our Company is seeking a strategic and results-driven Senior Director, Marketing Operations to lead the technology, automation, digital platforms, analytics, and operating processes that power our global marketing organization.

       Reporting to the Vice President, Global Growth Marketing, this role will build and optimize the infrastructure that enables Marketing to operate efficiently, deliver strong digital experiences, and connect marketing investments to measurable business outcomes.

       The Senior Director will own our marketing technology ecosystem, AI and automation strategy, website operations, data and measurement capabilities, and operational processes. This leader will partner closely with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Sales, Product, Technology, Data, Finance, and Legal to create a scalable, data-driven marketing organization.

       The ideal candidate combines strategic leadership with strong technical and operational expertise and is equally comfortable advising executives, leading transformation, and turning technology and data into measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Operations & Technology

- Develop and lead the global Marketing Operations strategy, operating model, and roadmap aligned with business priorities.

- Establish scalable processes, governance, workflows, and performance standards across Marketing.

- Own the marketing technology ecosystem, including CRM, marketing automation, digital platforms, analytics, customer data, and systems integrations.

 

- Evaluate and optimize technology investments, system performance, adoption, and ROI.

- Lead major technology implementations and operational transformation initiatives.

- Build and lead a high-performing Digital Marketing & Operations team.

AI & Automation

- Develop and execute Marketing’s AI and automation roadmap in alignment with the broader enterprise AI strategy.

- Identify and implement opportunities to automate campaign execution, lead management, reporting, content operations, and customer lifecycle activities.

- Establish governance and measurement for AI and automation solutions.

- Lead the process redesign and change management needed to embed new technologies and ways of working.

Website & Digital Experience

- Provide strategic leadership for website operations and the broader digital experience function.

- Own prioritization of the website roadmap based on acquisition, conversion, pipeline, and customer experience goals.

- Establish governance for website access, releases, quality assurance, and experimentation.

- Define the testing and optimization strategy and measure the business impact of digital investments.

Analytics, Data & Measurement

- Lead Marketing’s measurement, attribution, analytics, and reporting strategy.

- Establish executive dashboards, KPIs, and performance review processes that connect marketing activity to pipeline, revenue, and ROI.

- Partner with Revenue Operations, Finance, Data, and Technology to improve forecasting, customer insights, and decision-making.

- Establish standards for marketing data quality, governance, privacy, security, and appropriate use.

- Build the data foundation required for segmentation, personalization, targeting, and lifecycle marketing.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Business Management

- Serve as a senior partner across Marketing, Revenue Operations, Sales, Product, Technology, Data, Finance, and Legal.

- Align marketing technology, digital, data, and operational priorities with broader commercial objectives.

- Influence senior stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, and drive cross-functional initiatives to successful outcomes.

- Own the Marketing Operations and Technology budget and manage key technology providers, agencies, and implementation partners.

- Develop business cases and investment recommendations for future technology and operational initiatives.

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems, Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.

- 12+ years of progressive experience in Marketing Operations, Marketing Technology, Digital Marketing, Revenue Operations, or related disciplines.

- 7+ years of leadership experience, including responsibility for global or enterprise-level teams, functions, or programs.

- Deep expertise in marketing automation, CRM, website technologies, analytics, customer data, systems integrations, and marketing technology environments.

- Demonstrated experience building marketing operating models, technology strategies, governance frameworks, and roadmaps.

- Experience implementing AI, automation, and workflow solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

- Strong experience leading complex technology investments and transformation initiatives.

- Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget management and business case development.

- Ability to influence executive leaders and align cross-functional stakeholders around complex priorities.

- Experience working effectively in a global, fully remote environment.

Preferred

- Experience in a global SaaS, technology, or high-growth organization.

- Experience modernizing a Marketing Operations function or leading a significant marketing technology transformation.

- Experience implementing AI and automation across multiple marketing disciplines.

- Experience overseeing complex websites and digital platforms.

- Experience developing marketing attribution, forecasting, and investment measurement capabilities.

- Experience managing global technology providers, agencies, and implementation partners.

raw.title: Senior Paid Search Manager
raw.description:
- [![Pearmill](https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/org-theme-wordmark/e9eb54b7-38dd-437c-9d6a-aefa3367a6b7/db9cdced-05f0-43c1-bc8e-f4f10551e549/b0c70ece-c411-4454-b29a-fbf5ac14af26.png)](https://pearmill.com/)
- [Back to Pearmill’s Job Listings](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/pearmill)

# Senior Paid Search Manager

## Location

Remote (+/- 3 hours of ET); Remote (Canada); Remote (US)

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Remote

## Department

Growth Team

## Compensation

- $75K – $95K • Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our remote working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

We’re a fully remote company, with team members living in many countries around the world. Each country has different market rates for roles, and we strive to offer competitive salaries indexed to your specific local market. Rather than matching salaries for each role across the organization, our goal is to offer similar standards of living for the same level of work, no matter where you live.

This approach allows us to grow sustainably as a company, and gives us the ability to hire from wherever the best talent lives. On top of your salary, we believe in directly rewarding you for your hard work through a twice-annual performance bonus. We also review salaries every year (and more often with consistently outstanding work!), with a goal of keeping our long-standing team as fairly compensated as our new hires.

## About the role

As a Senior Paid Search Manager you run 2 to 3 client accounts that need significant oversight, and you manage the people running the rest.

A large part of this job now runs through AI, and that has changed what the role spends its time on. If that's not how you want to work, this won't be the right fit.

We're a small, growing team. Your responsibilities will grow and change with the company and you'll have an enormous impact on the business.

## What you'll own

### Your accounts

- Run 2 to 3 client accounts that need significant oversight, across Google Ads (Search, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Shopping) and Microsoft Ads.

- Set the strategy, and own the bidding and account structure calls.

- Run budget pacing off a forecast you built, and say where the month lands before the client asks.

- Write the weekly client report, and the story that goes with the numbers.


### Your team

- Manage a few Paid Search Managers. Weekly 1:1s, growth plans, and honest reviews.

- Review work before it reaches a client. You own the quality bar across the team's accounts, not only your own.

- Sit in hiring loops.

- Step onto an account yourself when one is off track.


### Thought leadership

- Write for our blog, and build out the paid search playbooks the rest of the team works from.

- Track what's changing across the platforms, and say what it means for our accounts before a client asks.

- Run internal sessions and webinars on the things you know best.


### AI and tooling (this part is not optional)

- Run reporting and analysis through Claude using our skills and MCP connectors.

- Build skills and workflows the whole team uses, not only your own.

- Judge AI output critically, and hold the team to the same standard.


### New business and measurement

- Lead audits for prospects, and present them in pitches.

- Reconcile platform numbers against attribution tools and the client's own reporting.

- Catch tracking problems before they show up in a report.


## About you

- 5+ years hands-on in Google Ads, including time at an agency. Microsoft Ads experience is a plus.

- You've managed people, or you've been the person others came to and you're ready to make it official.

- Deep on SEM fundamentals, with opinions you can defend using data.

- Familiarity with GA4, GTM, and conversion tracking setups.

- You've built with AI, not only prompted it. A workflow automation, a reporting tool, a script that took a manual step out of your week.

- Comfortable in spreadsheets: pacing models, pivot tables, audit sheets.

- You write and speak clearly for a specific reader, and you can hold a room with a founder or an exec.

- Proactive by default. You raise things before anyone asks, and you take ownership of performance outcomes.

- Bonus: Shopping feeds, YouTube, cross-channel context (Meta, TikTok), or hands-on tracking implementation.


## What you'll find here

- Competitive salary with bonus structure

- 99% coverage for health, dental, and vision

- Distributed, remote, and global culture

- Unlimited vacation with 3 weeks required vacation

- Unlimited mental health or physical health leave

- Remote work budget to make it easier to work from wherever you feel most productive!

- Monthly physical activity budget to get your body moving

- 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

- Stipend for laptop and other home office equipment

- Indoor plant budget

- Annual company-wide retreat

- Yearly stipend for books, seminars, courses, and coaches

- Matching for charitable donations


## Flourishing at Pearmill

We get an unreasonable amount of satisfaction out of making the things around us better at their jobs. Clients who arrived wanting a channel fixed and left with a system. People who joined to run ad accounts and left able to build a team that runs global strategy. And most recently, our little AI agents running around our Notion docs and giving us super powers.

We're a fast growing, diverse group of goofy yet dedicated marketers, creatives, engineers, and analysts, running over $500M in ad spend across 15+ platforms. Join us!

Compensation Range: $75K - $95K

[Apply for this Job](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/pearmill/440f8872-7723-4849-ae41-fbb59ade1a60/application)

# Head of Growth & Marketing (VP)

## Location

North America \| Newport Beach (Remote)

## Employment Type

Full time

## Department

Marketing

# **Maximus** is looking for a **Head of Growth & Marketing (VP)**.

**Company:** Maximus \| **Location:** Remote (US) \| **Reports to:** CEO \| **Type:** Full-time, Executive

## **About Maximus**

Maximus ( [https://www.maximustribe.com/](https://www.maximustribe.com/)) is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year — with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors and operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, and Shopify.

## **The Role**

We’re hiring a VP of Growth to run the growth engine. The core of the job is high-velocity, highly analytical experiment design: finding new levers that work, across advertising, creative, pricing, and the digital product, and finding them faster than the current ones fatigue. You set the testing agenda and hold the bar on what counts as a good experiment.

The defining requirement is the ability to think in connected customer journeys, not siloed channels: how a persona is defined, how creative and messaging speak to that persona, how that creative shows up differently on Meta versus paid search versus influencers versus affiliates, what landing experience each arrival deserves, and how we ultimately convert and retain that customer. Channel, creative, and site experience are one system — and you own the system.

Two things come with this role that growth leaders almost never get to own. First, the conversion flow: not just the landing page — the entire quiz flow, every step from first click through credit-card entry. Second, pricing: price points, offers, discounts, and plan structure across the portfolio, where there’s enormous leverage waiting for someone with the analytical chops to find it. If you’ve spent your career optimizing ads against a funnel somebody else controlled, this is the opposite of that job.

This is a hands-on job. You’ll inherit a team and an agency roster and reshape both as the strategy requires — hiring where there are gaps, holding the agencies to outcomes. You’ll also spend lots of time in spreadsheets and Ads Manager, and lately in Claude, looking at the nitty-gritty yourself. You’ll report directly to the CEO and hold the senior-most marketing seat in the company. The role is revenue-accountable: you take the company’s revenue target and build the strategy across the product portfolio (Testosterone, Weight Loss, Growth Hormone, and future verticals) to hit it.

## **What You’ll Own**

**The experimentation engine: the core of the job.** Design and run a high-velocity testing program across advertising, creative, pricing, and the digital product: hypothesis quality, test design, statistical rigor, and the speed from insight to rollout. Build the team’s operating rhythm (planning, budgeting, creative reviews, reporting) around that cadence.

**Money allocation, decided by incrementality and LTV.** Own where the money goes, and back every allocation with data: incrementality and lifetime value, not last-click ROAS. That means knowing how to measure mid-funnel and upper-funnel activity, how to evaluate discounts analytically, and how LTV differs by product and channel in a business where the LTV math gets complicated. FP&A owns the forecast model; you own the levers inside it — spend, CAC, conversion, LTV by product line — and the results against it.

**The conversion flow, end to end.** The entire quiz flow through credit-card entry, not just the landing pages in front of it: messaging continuity from ad through intake to purchase, experimentation inside the flow itself in partnership with product and engineering, and the test discipline that keeps the wins real.

**Pricing.** Price points, coupons, offers, discount architecture, and plan structure across the portfolio, including long-term commitments — and the margin-versus-CAC tradeoff every one of these decisions moves. Discounting here is an analytical problem.

**Lifecycle and CRM.** Email and SMS as a real growth channel: cart-abandonment recovery, nurture for hesitant buyers, cross-sell across the portfolio, revival of lapsed customers. Run it with the same rigor as paid — experiments, holdouts, measured LTV impact. The customer should never feel a handoff, from ad to quiz or from checkout to inbox.

**Persona-driven acquisition, creative, and the channel portfolio.** The channel is a persona signal: the research-heavy buyer coming from branded search isn’t the validation-seeker coming from cold social. Define the persona for each channel and let it drive everything downstream. Own paid media, influencers, and affiliates, with enough diversification that no one platform dominates; own creative built for each persona, native to each channel, and judged on funnel outcomes. This is creative as a growth lever, not a brand job.

## **What You’ll Need**

**The bar, in one question.** Be ready, at any point, to say where the next incremental dollar should go — more Meta spend, a deeper discount, a new quiz branch, an untested channel — and why. “I think it’ll lift the funnel” isn’t an answer; we want the test you’d run, the LTV math behind it, and what you’d cut to fund it.

- **Command of incrementality and LTV: this is what we’re hiring for.** You can design the incrementality test and defend the math; you can explain how you’d measure mid-funnel and upper-funnel activity, and how you’d evaluate a discount analytically; and you’ve dealt with a complex-LTV business firsthand — subscription, multi-product, or both.

- **Still hands-on.** You get into the weeds yourself (the ad account, the funnel data, the models) and did so this quarter, not three jobs ago.

- **Connected-journey thinking.** You can walk a funnel you owned end to end — persona, channel, creative, landing experience, conversion — and explain how each step informed the next.

- Direct ownership of post-click conversion: landing experiences, quiz- or intake-style funnels, checkout, lifecycle (email and SMS) — with structured experimentation and results to show for it.

- Pricing and offer experience: you’ve designed pricing, discount, or plan-structure tests and owned the revenue outcome.

- 10+ years in growth or performance marketing, including 5+ years leading teams, with a track record scaling a DTC subscription business built on a high-consideration product — a premium-priced purchase people research before buying.

- Ownership of a revenue number, not just a media budget — you built the plan tying spend to revenue and defended it to a CEO or a board.

- A builder profile: you’ve restructured or built a marketing org, hired senior channel leads, and managed agencies to outcomes.

- **Nice to have:** telehealth, regulated health, or wellness experience (health-claim ad policies, compliance-constrained creative), and experience marketing a multi-product portfolio with a distinct buyer per product.


## **What Success Looks Like**

This role moves fast; we expect the engine to be running within the first quarter. Specific targets get set together in your first 30 days.

**By month 3:** there’s a real testing cadence live across ads, creative, pricing, and the quiz flow; CAC, conversion, and LTV are instrumented by product so we trust the numbers; and you’ve made the first budget reallocations based on measured incrementality.

**By month 6:** conversion through the full quiz-to-credit-card flow is up; persona-matched journeys are shipping (right creative, right landing experience, right quiz flow for each buyer type); the first pricing wins are banked; and at least one channel beyond Meta has scaled past the test phase.

**By month 12 and beyond:** you’ve delivered the revenue target, CAC and LTV have both moved the right way, the team and agency roster fit the strategy, and the CEO and board trust your numbers because they hold.

**Maximus Offers World-Class Benefits:**

- At-cost employee access (50% off discount) to all Maximus protocols

- Full Suite Insurance: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance

Premium Blue Shield Platinum PPO & HMO Health Plans (up to 80% coverage)

- Best-in-class 401K options

- Fully remote work. Flexible vacation/time-off policies

- Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)


_Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity._

_Note: We utilize AI note-taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note-takers for their own records if they wish._

[Apply for this Job](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/maximustribe/cf7b7f66-3760-423e-9691-6d0c6b960a70/application)

Maximus is looking for a Head of Growth & Marketing (VP).

Company: Maximus | Location: Remote (US) | Reports to: CEO | Type: Full-time, Executive


About Maximus

Maximus (https://www.maximustribe.com/) is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year — with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors and operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, and Shopify.

The Role

We’re hiring a VP of Growth to run the growth engine. The core of the job is high-velocity, highly analytical experiment design: finding new levers that work, across advertising, creative, pricing, and the digital product, and finding them faster than the current ones fatigue. You set the testing agenda and hold the bar on what counts as a good experiment.

The defining requirement is the ability to think in connected customer journeys, not siloed channels: how a persona is defined, how creative and messaging speak to that persona, how that creative shows up differently on Meta versus paid search versus influencers versus affiliates, what landing experience each arrival deserves, and how we ultimately convert and retain that customer. Channel, creative, and site experience are one system — and you own the system.

Two things come with this role that growth leaders almost never get to own. First, the conversion flow: not just the landing page — the entire quiz flow, every step from first click through credit-card entry. Second, pricing: price points, offers, discounts, and plan structure across the portfolio, where there’s enormous leverage waiting for someone with the analytical chops to find it. If you’ve spent your career optimizing ads against a funnel somebody else controlled, this is the opposite of that job.

This is a hands-on job. You’ll inherit a team and an agency roster and reshape both as the strategy requires — hiring where there are gaps, holding the agencies to outcomes. You’ll also spend lots of time in spreadsheets and Ads Manager, and lately in Claude, looking at the nitty-gritty yourself. You’ll report directly to the CEO and hold the senior-most marketing seat in the company. The role is revenue-accountable: you take the company’s revenue target and build the strategy across the product portfolio (Testosterone, Weight Loss, Growth Hormone, and future verticals) to hit it.

What You’ll Own

The experimentation engine: the core of the job. Design and run a high-velocity testing program across advertising, creative, pricing, and the digital product: hypothesis quality, test design, statistical rigor, and the speed from insight to rollout. Build the team’s operating rhythm (planning, budgeting, creative reviews, reporting) around that cadence.

Money allocation, decided by incrementality and LTV. Own where the money goes, and back every allocation with data: incrementality and lifetime value, not last-click ROAS. That means knowing how to measure mid-funnel and upper-funnel activity, how to evaluate discounts analytically, and how LTV differs by product and channel in a business where the LTV math gets complicated. FP&A owns the forecast model; you own the levers inside it — spend, CAC, conversion, LTV by product line — and the results against it.

The conversion flow, end to end. The entire quiz flow through credit-card entry, not just the landing pages in front of it: messaging continuity from ad through intake to purchase, experimentation inside the flow itself in partnership with product and engineering, and the test discipline that keeps the wins real.

Pricing. Price points, coupons, offers, discount architecture, and plan structure across the portfolio, including long-term commitments — and the margin-versus-CAC tradeoff every one of these decisions moves. Discounting here is an analytical problem.

Lifecycle and CRM. Email and SMS as a real growth channel: cart-abandonment recovery, nurture for hesitant buyers, cross-sell across the portfolio, revival of lapsed customers. Run it with the same rigor as paid — experiments, holdouts, measured LTV impact. The customer should never feel a handoff, from ad to quiz or from checkout to inbox.

Persona-driven acquisition, creative, and the channel portfolio. The channel is a persona signal: the research-heavy buyer coming from branded search isn’t the validation-seeker coming from cold social. Define the persona for each channel and let it drive everything downstream. Own paid media, influencers, and affiliates, with enough diversification that no one platform dominates; own creative built for each persona, native to each channel, and judged on funnel outcomes. This is creative as a growth lever, not a brand job.

What You’ll Need

The bar, in one question. Be ready, at any point, to say where the next incremental dollar should go — more Meta spend, a deeper discount, a new quiz branch, an untested channel — and why. “I think it’ll lift the funnel” isn’t an answer; we want the test you’d run, the LTV math behind it, and what you’d cut to fund it.

  • Command of incrementality and LTV: this is what we’re hiring for. You can design the incrementality test and defend the math; you can explain how you’d measure mid-funnel and upper-funnel activity, and how you’d evaluate a discount analytically; and you’ve dealt with a complex-LTV business firsthand — subscription, multi-product, or both.

  • Still hands-on. You get into the weeds yourself (the ad account, the funnel data, the models) and did so this quarter, not three jobs ago.

  • Connected-journey thinking. You can walk a funnel you owned end to end — persona, channel, creative, landing experience, conversion — and explain how each step informed the next.

  • Direct ownership of post-click conversion: landing experiences, quiz- or intake-style funnels, checkout, lifecycle (email and SMS) — with structured experimentation and results to show for it.

  • Pricing and offer experience: you’ve designed pricing, discount, or plan-structure tests and owned the revenue outcome.

  • 10+ years in growth or performance marketing, including 5+ years leading teams, with a track record scaling a DTC subscription business built on a high-consideration product — a premium-priced purchase people research before buying.

  • Ownership of a revenue number, not just a media budget — you built the plan tying spend to revenue and defended it to a CEO or a board.

  • A builder profile: you’ve restructured or built a marketing org, hired senior channel leads, and managed agencies to outcomes.

  • Nice to have: telehealth, regulated health, or wellness experience (health-claim ad policies, compliance-constrained creative), and experience marketing a multi-product portfolio with a distinct buyer per product.


What Success Looks Like

This role moves fast; we expect the engine to be running within the first quarter. Specific targets get set together in your first 30 days.

By month 3: there’s a real testing cadence live across ads, creative, pricing, and the quiz flow; CAC, conversion, and LTV are instrumented by product so we trust the numbers; and you’ve made the first budget reallocations based on measured incrementality.

By month 6: conversion through the full quiz-to-credit-card flow is up; persona-matched journeys are shipping (right creative, right landing experience, right quiz flow for each buyer type); the first pricing wins are banked; and at least one channel beyond Meta has scaled past the test phase.

By month 12 and beyond: you’ve delivered the revenue target, CAC and LTV have both moved the right way, the team and agency roster fit the strategy, and the CEO and board trust your numbers because they hold.

Maximus Offers World-Class Benefits:

  • At-cost employee access (50% off discount) to all Maximus protocols

  • Full Suite Insurance: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance
    Premium Blue Shield Platinum PPO & HMO Health Plans (up to 80% coverage)

  • Best-in-class 401K options

  • Fully remote work. Flexible vacation/time-off policies

  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.

Note: We utilize AI note-taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note-takers for their own records if they wish.
